title: How does Initial Occupation Rewards work?
description: Understanding one of the most misunderstood reward systems in Legion of Frostborne
html:
Understanding one of the most misunderstood reward systems in Legion of Frostborne

If you’ve ever participated in Legion of Frostborne (KvK) or other large-scale server events, you’ve seen the “Initial Occupation Reward” pop up when cities, citadels, or gates are captured. But here’s the thing — many players, especially on younger servers, are still unclear about how these rewards actually work.

Do you have to be in the top 10 contributors to earn them? Do you need to be in the winning alliance? Or do you just need to tag the city once?

Let’s break it down clearly because these rewards are massive — and understanding them will make you rethink how you approach city sieges.

What Are Initial Occupation Rewards?

Whenever your alliance captures a city, citadel, or gate for the first time in Legion of Frostborne, the game grants Initial Occupation Rewards.

These rewards typically include:

  • Millions of resources (scaled by city level)
  • Gold
  • Gems
  • Occasionally, speedups or other special items

For example, capturing a Level 13 City in Frostborne rewards each participant:

  • 22M mixed resources
  • 1.3M gold
  • 200 gems

That’s for every single player who contributed — not just the top 10.

Who Gets the Rewards?

Here’s where the confusion comes in.

Do you need to be in the top 10?
No.

Do you need to do a ton of damage?
No.

Do you need to be in the winning alliance?
Yes — but only during the siege.

So how do you qualify?
Anyone who sends at least one march to hit the city while it’s being captured gets the reward.

That’s it.

If your alliance successfully takes the city, and you sent even a single march, you’ll receive the full Initial Occupation Reward.

Why This Is a Big Deal

The beauty of this system is that small players, free-to-play users, and even alts can benefit enormously.

  • F2P Growth Boost: For a low-level castle, getting 22M resources + 1.3M gold + 200 gems just for tagging a city is huge.
  • Alt Farming: Many players use their alt accounts to tag cities for easy resources, helping them keep up with main-account growth.
  • Alliance-Wide Value: It encourages every member to participate in city sieges, making teamwork more rewarding.

How to Maximize These Rewards

  1. Always Tag the City
    Even if you can’t do much damage, send at least one march to every city your alliance is capturing. Don’t sit idle.
  2. Join All Major Sieges
    Make a habit of joining sieges for gates, citadels, and high-level cities — the bigger the city, the bigger the reward.
  3. Use Your Alts
    If you have alt accounts in the same alliance or kingdom, send their marches too. It’s free resources and gems for accounts that need them most.
  4. Coordinate with Alliance Leadership
    Ask your R4/R5 when sieges are happening so you don’t miss out.

TL;DR – The Quick Version

  • Initial Occupation Rewards go to any player who sends at least one march to help capture a city.
  • It’s not just for the top 10 contributors.
  • Huge for small players and alts: A Level 13 city gives 22M resources, 1.3M gold, and 200 gems each.
  • Always tag cities during sieges — it’s free, easy, and worth it.

Final Thoughts

This is one of the most efficient ways to farm resources and gems in Infinity Kingdom, especially in Legion of Frostborne. Whether you’re a top-tier spender or a F2P grinder, there’s no excuse not to tag every city your alliance goes for.

It’s free growth — don’t leave it on the table.

Read more about rallying and garrisons.

Shield hives to play around Bloody Rage debuff

You want to setup with your fellow alliance players, let’s say you found a whale you need to kill as a team since he is much more powerful than any one of you. What can you do? You can setup a shield-hive.

My Territory is the one leading the rallies and my fellow BKU castles are assisting me in my rallies and garrisoning me to defend against the whales counter attacks.

Your rallies and garrisons are fighting the enemy player 1 at a time right after each other. The power of a rally comes from the buffs (alliance tech) and from the fact that the whales army defending at his gates, does not get to refresh troop count from training grounds in between attacks. This means that you slowly grind him down untill one of your marches (you can have 5 in each rally) is able to beat the stronger player.

This also means, that the first maybe 2-4 marches you send in your rally will likely be absolutely murdered and you will incur heavy losses. Likewise, the target will gain a ton of honor since he is killing a lot of troops before you finally defeat him.

This makes it a double edged sword. It is still very powerful to fight in rally-clusters, and you are able to zero very big whales in this way. But it is by no means easy or cheap and you should expect big losses when you go whale-hunting!

html:
Alliance technology is a crucial aspect of Infinity Kingdom that can significantly increase the power and development of an alliance. By investing in the right technology, alliances can gain important buffs and upgrades that can help them in both growth and war aspects of the game. In this article, we will provide you with a tier list of the most important growth technologies that alliances should prioritize.

Having rapid tech development in a new alliance on new servers is absolutely crucial and all members should be encourage to gem alliance technology daily. For new alliances gemming is cheap and should be done by everyone to get a nice boost at the beginning of a new server/alliance.

Technology tiers

S Tier:

The top tier of growth technologies includes Big Family, Brothers-In-Arms, AP Recovery, Rapid March, Lower Attack Cost, Knife Through Butter, and Garrison Attack. These technologies are essential for any alliance looking to grow quickly and effectively.

Big Family: This technology increases the maximum number of alliance members, allowing for a larger pool of players to help with development and defense.

Brothers-In-Arms: This technology increases the speed at which alliance members can help each other. This is particularly important for speeding up construction and research tasks.

AP Recovery: This technology increases the speed at which alliance members can recover their action points, allowing for more tasks to be completed each day.

Rapid March: This technology increases the marching speed of alliance members, making it easier to move troops around the map and respond to threats quickly.

Lower Attack Cost: This technology reduces the amount of attack resources required to attack other players, making it easier to launch attacks and gain resources.

Knife Through Butter: This technology increases the damage dealt by troops to enemy walls, making it easier to penetrate enemy defenses.

Garrison Attack: This technology increases the damage dealt by troops defending a garrison, making it harder for enemies to capture your buildings.

A tier:

The second tier of growth technologies includes Wall Breaker, Quick Response, Assembly Charge, and Bowmen Load. These technologies are also important for alliance growth, but not as essential as those in the S tier.

Wall Breaker: This technology increases the damage dealt by troops to enemy walls, making it easier to penetrate city defenses.

Quick Response: This technology reduces the time it takes for troops to return to the city after an attack or defense, allowing for quicker recovery and response times.

Assembly Charge: This technology increases the marching speed of troops, making it easier to move troops around the map and respond to threats quickly.

Bowmen Load: This technology increases the number of resources bowmen can carry. Since we are running two bowmen in every march you get double value from this load tech.

B tier:

The third tier of growth technologies includes SP Recovery, Iron, Food, Wood, Stone Gatherer, Shieldmen Load, Spearmen Load, and Cavalry Load. These technologies are helpful for alliance growth, but not as essential as those in the S and A tiers.

SP Recovery: This technology increases the speed at which SP are recovered, allowing for more Well of Time raids to be completed each day.

Resource Gatherer: These technologies increase the amount of resources gathered from resource nodes, making it easier to accumulate resources for development.

Shieldmen Load, Spearmen Load, and Cavalry Load: These technologies increase the carrying capacity of different types of troops, allowing for more resources to be gathered or more troops to be deployed.

C tier:

The fourth tier of growth technologies includes Iron, Food, Wood, and Stone Tax, Lower Garrison Cost, and Fast Garrison. These technologies are not as important as those in the S, A, and B tiers, but can still be useful for alliance growth.

Iron, Food, Wood, and Stone Tax: These technologies increase the amount of resources gained from taxes, providing a small boost to overall resource accumulation.

Lower Garrison Cost: This technology reduces the resources required to place troops in a friendly players garrison.

Fast Garrison: This technology increases the speed at which troops are garrisoned. It is a nice quality-of-life improvement, but not a top priority.

F tier:

Fortification Damage: This technology increases the damage dealt by your alliance’s structures when defending against enemy attacks. While it may seem useful, it is not a high priority. It is better to focus on improving the power of your troops through other technologies.

Win the Peace: This technology provides a small increase city shields after a siege. It is not a high priority, and should only be invested in if there are no other more important technologies left to research.

Guard the Peace: This technology provides a small increase in the rewards gained from defending a city siege. It is also not a high priority, and should only be invested in if there are no other more important technologies left to research.

Conclusion

In conclusion, investing in the right Alliance Development Technology is crucial for both the growth and success of your alliance in Infinity Kingdom. By prioritizing the S and A tiers, your alliance will see significant improvements in various areas, including troop power, resource management, and battle effectiveness. It is important to communicate with your alliance members and come up with a plan for which technologies to prioritize based on your alliance’s specific needs and goals. With the right strategy, your alliance can become a force to be reckoned with in the world of Infinity Kingdom.

The first step towards progress for a main alliance is to unlock and upgrade the Alliance Core tech: Big Family. Once the Alliance tech Big Family is upgraded, the focus should be on upgrading alliance troop technology. The goal is to improve the combat power of the alliance, which will come in handy during battles. The troop technology that should be prioritized are bowmen, shieldmen, and cavalry.

Bowmen should be the first priority as they are used by two immortal types in any army. Shieldmen and cavalry are the next most commonly used troops and should be the focus after bowmen.

The alliance leader should also recruit new members and work on increasing the overall power of the alliance.

We recommend progressing in two stages:

Stage 1: Focus on upgrading the Alliance core and unlocking all alliance territories and the full roster size. Donate resources towards upgrading the Alliance.

Stage 2: Focus on upgrading troop technology, starting with bowmen, then shieldmen and cavalry.

Alliance Technology is a key aspect of Infinity Kingdom, and the War Technology section is no exception. Having the right technology in your alliance can make a huge difference in combat, providing crucial buffs that increase your power significantly and improve the chances of victory. In this article, we will take a closer look at the War Technology tier list, and provide some tips on how you can invest in the right technology to make your alliance a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield.

S-Tier:

Bowmen Attack and HP: These technologies provide a significant boost to your Bowmen, which are one of the most important units in the game. A strong Bowmen unit can easily decimate enemy armies, making this technology a must-have for any alliance that wants to dominate in combat. This is the only S-tier war technology simply because you always run two bowmen Immortals in any army composition.

A-Tier:

Cavalry and Shieldmen Attack and HP: These technologies are similar to Bowmen Attack and HP, but for Cavalry and Shieldmen instead. Cavalry and Shieldmen are also essential units in any army, and these technologies will help them deal more damage and last longer in combat.

Bowmen Defense: While offense is important, defense is equally important in any battle. Bowmen Defense technology will help your Bowmen units survive enemy attacks and deal damage in return.

Cavalry and Shieldmen Defense: Like Bowmen Defense, this technology provides a boost to your cavalry and shieldmen units, making them more resilient in battle.

B-Tier:

Home Turf: This technology provides a significant increase to the power of your Immortals when defending your own city. This is a great technology to have when you are under attack, as it can help you fend off enemy armies more easily.

Fight Side by Side: This technology provides a buff to your troops when fighting alongside allies, making it a must-have for any alliance that wants to dominate in team battles.

C-Tier:

Spearmen HP, Attack, and Defense: Spearmen are not as commonly used as Bowmen, Cavalry, and Shieldmen, so these technologies are not as important as others. However, if your alliance relies heavily on spearmen Immortals, then investing in these technologies may be worthwhile.

F-Tier:

Quick Response: This technology provides a significant boost to the speed of your marches, which can be incredibly useful for both attacking and defending.

Assembly Charge: This technology increases the damage dealt by your troops when they charge into battle, making it a great choice for aggressive alliances.

Garrison Defense: This technology provides a significant boost to your Immortals when defending your city’s garrison, making it easier to fend off enemy attacks.

Minimize Losses: This technology reduces the amount of troops lost in battle, which can be a lifesaver if you are struggling to maintain your army’s numbers.

Wall Durability: This technology increases the durability of your city walls, making it harder for enemies to breach them and attack your city.

Overall, investing in the right War Technology is essential for any alliance that wants to be successful in combat. By prioritizing the right technologies, you can make your troops more powerful, resilient, and deadly, increasing your chances of victory on the battlefield.

In conclusion, investing in war technology is crucial for an alliance’s success in Infinity Kingdom. Choosing which technology to prioritize can be a difficult decision, but with this tier list as a guide, alliances can ensure they are putting their resources into the most effective areas. Remember, focusing on a few key technologies rather than trying to level everything up at once can lead to faster overall growth and improvement. So work together with your alliance, strategize, and prioritize wisely to become a dominant force on the battlefield!

Guide to Provincial Capitals and Their Provincial Orders in Norheim

Understanding Provincial Capitals and Orders

In Infinity Kingdom, every city is part of a province, and each province has a Capital City. These capitals hold immense strategic importance as they grant access to Provincial Orders, powerful buffs that apply throughout the entire province. Utilizing these orders effectively can provide significant advantages in both resource generation and war strategy.

The Three Provincial Orders

These orders are on quite long Cooldown (10 hours of War Tax and 1day + for the others). They last for 1 hour and provide quite powerful buffs for the duration.

1. War Tax (Best Order – Always Use!)

  • Effect: Increases tax speed (gold production in dwellings) by 20%.
  • Why It’s Essential: Gold is the backbone of your economy. More gold means faster upgrades, stronger armies, and a better war economy.
  • Strategy: This order should always be active and on cooldown. The increased gold generation massively outweighs any other benefits from alternative orders.
  • Alliance Tactics: Alliances should mark territories where War Tax is active and ensure members stay within Capital Province Territory to benefit from this buff.

2. Quick Repair (Situational – Use During KE if Necessary)

  • Effect: Reduces Bloody Rage duration by 50%.
  • Use Case: Primarily useful during Kill Events (KE) where faster recovery is needed.
  • Why It’s Less Favored: Reducing Bloody Rage is good, but gold production is far more valuable. In KE situations, most experienced players will relocate rather than rely on shorter rage durations.
  • When to Use: If your alliance is under heavy attack and needs shorter rage durations, this can be activated briefly, but War Tax should still be the priority.

3. Hold All Territory (Situational – Use for Extended Shields)

  • Effect: Increases Truce (Shield) duration by 50%.
  • Use Case: Useful when defending key locations or preparing for an extended absence.
  • Why It’s Less Favored: Shield extensions are nice, but War Tax is the true powerhouse. If you are actively managing your city, you should not need to rely on this as much.
  • When to Use: If expecting a massive invasion or during major downtime, this could be useful, but again, gold trumps everything.

Alliance Strategy: Maximizing War Tax Benefits

To optimize the benefits of War Tax:

  1. Always be within Capital Province Territory.
    • The provincial buff applies to the entire province, not just the immediate area around the Capital City.
  2. Place Alliance Markers for Guidance.
    • R5 and R6 leaders should mark active War Tax territories to guide members.
  3. Encourage Province Control.
    • Prioritize capturing and holding Provincial Capitals to ensure constant access to War Tax.

Conclusion: War Tax Reigns Supreme

While the other orders have their uses, War Tax should always be the go-to choice. The additional gold generation fuels progress, ensuring faster upgrades and a stronger economy. Alliances should coordinate their movements, placing markers to help members remain within capital-controlled provinces.

Stay within War Tax provinces, maximize your gold, and dominate Norheim!

html:
City Buffs in Infinity Kingdom are a powerful but often underutilized tool that can significantly impact the progression speed of an alliance. With the right coordination, alliances can optimize building speed, technology research, and dragon upgrades, allowing their members to advance faster while saving valuable speedups. In this guide, we’ll cover how and why alliances should coordinate these buffs efficiently to maximize progression.

Understanding City Buffs and Their Importance

Across Norheim, there are multiple cities that provide buffs to enhance progression efficiency. While some cities offer combat buffs, we’ll focus on the ones that grant economic progression buffs, which include:

  • Building Speed Buff (+3%) – Reduces the time required for construction upgrades.
  • Technology Research Speed Buff (+3%) – Speeds up research, allowing faster unlocks and upgrades.
  • Dragon Upgrade Speed Buff (+3%) – Reduces the time needed for leveling up dragons.

Buff Distribution in Norheim

  • Dragon Upgrade Speed Buff Cities: 19 total, 3 also provide combat buffs.
  • Building Speed Buff Cities: 13 total, 4 also provide combat buffs.
  • Technology Research Speed Buff Cities: 11 total, 3 also provide combat buffs.

See complete list of all cities and buffs on the bottom of this guide.

Since combat buffs apply to all alliance members, but economic buffs only apply to the mayor, strategic distribution is essential for efficiency.

Strategic Coordination of City Buffs

1. Distributing Cities Among Alliances

To ensure all active alliances benefit from city buffs, the strongest alliances should control cities with combat buffs, while the remaining cities should be distributed among other active alliances. This ensures:

  • Top alliances retain an edge in combat while maintaining economic efficiency.
  • Mid-tier alliances have access to valuable speed buffs, improving server-wide progression.
  • No single alliance hoards all buff cities, promoting server balance.

2. Setting Up Communication for City Buff Requests

To maximize the use of buffs, alliances should establish a dedicated communication channel for city buff management. This ensures that:

  • Players can request a buff before major upgrades.
  • Officers can quickly assign mayorship to the requesting player.
  • Players return the position after activating their upgrade.

A simple chat format could be:

📢 Request: “Please assign me Dragon Buff for my upgrade.”

🔄 Officer Action: Assigns mayor position and tags the player.

✅ Player Response: Starts upgrade and immediately steps down from mayorship.

3. Assigning and Rotating City Mayors

Since only one player at a time benefits from the mayor’s buff, quick transitions are key.

  • Officers should check requests regularly and promptly assign mayorship.
  • Players must release the role immediately after initiating an upgrade.
  • Officers now have the ability to remove inactive mayors, ensuring smooth rotation.

4. Understanding Buff Activation Timing

Unlike combat buffs that apply continuously, economic buffs only need to be active at the start of an upgrade. This means:

  • Players do not need to hold mayorship for the entire duration of an upgrade.
  • Once the upgrade starts, the buff locks in, and the player can vacate the position.
  • Another player can then request the buff, ensuring maximum efficiency.

5. Leadership Responsibility and Long-Term Benefits

While this requires some attention from officers, it is not difficult to manage. The long-term benefits include:

  • Consistently saving speedups for every alliance member.
  • Faster individual progression, leading to stronger alliances overall.
  • Better coordination between alliances, strengthening server-wide cooperation.

New Officer Controls: Removing Mayors

Previously, players had to manually step down from mayorship, leading to bottlenecks when someone forgot. However, a recent game update now allows officers to remove players from the mayor position, ensuring a smooth transition when another player requests the buff.

Final Thoughts

Properly managing City Buffs can provide a huge advantage for alliances willing to coordinate. By setting up efficient communication channels, distributing cities strategically, and rotating mayors quickly, alliances can drastically reduce upgrade times, save speedups, and grow stronger together.

🔥 A well-organized alliance is a powerful alliance! 🔥

City Buffs List

A detailed list of all cities and their buffs can be seen below to help alliances plan their strategies effectively.

🏰 Coordinate, optimize, and dominate Norheim! 🏰

html:
Hey Lords! Have you ever wanted to keep your key positions and buffs without broadcasting your login status to the entire server? Whether you’re fighting for Contention of Relics, locked in a Kill Event, or caught in a server-wide Civil War, keeping your activity hidden can be crucial for strategy. Enter the new Mute function!

Many players haven’t noticed this feature yet, but it can make a huge difference. If you or your key players want to enjoy the powerful combat buffs from Capital positions without revealing when you’re online, here’s how it works.

The Problem: Key Players Need Buffs, But Also Privacy

The issue is simple:

  1. Capital positions provide massive combat buffs that can turn the tide of battle.
  2. Logging in with a Capital position displays your name in a banner for the whole server.
  3. Enemies use this to track your activity, especially in war situations.
  4. Some players refuse Capital positions just to keep their login times secret.

This puts teams in a tough spot: do you give up the buffs for privacy, or risk exposure?

The Solution: Use the Mute Function!

Great news! A “Mute” button has been added to Capital Cities. Here’s how it works:

  • Untick the mute box in the Capital city settings.
  • This prevents the system from displaying your login banner to the entire server.
  • You still keep all the buffs from the position!

Does It Work Server-Wide?

One of the biggest questions I’ve heard is:

“Does the mute function only hide the banner for me, or does it work for everyone?”

I’ve tested it, and yes—it works for everyone on the server! Once you activate the mute setting, no one sees your login banner, making it the perfect way to stay hidden while keeping your buffs.

Summary & Final Thoughts

The mute function is a game-changer for competitive play. Now, key players can hold Capital positions and benefit from the buffs without exposing their activity to the entire server. If you’re a leader or strategist, make sure your top players are aware of this and start using it!

Stay smart, stay hidden, and keep dominating! ⚔️🔥

title: Magic-Merlin Madness
description: Infinity Kingdom recently added a new mini-game, Battle Chess, which offers a refreshing chess-like format that features familiar Immortals and spells. Since the game mode is still in its early stages, the meta is yet to settle. However, we have found an extremely strong and fun build that has been
html:
Infinity Kingdom recently added a new mini-game, Battle Chess, which offers a refreshing chess-like format that features familiar Immortals and spells. Since the game mode is still in its early stages, the meta is yet to settle. However, we have found an extremely strong and fun build that has been delivering excellent results.

The build

IMMORTALS

In this build, we have selected five Immortals, each with unique abilities to offer. The first is Merlin, whose magical proc-damage ability can deal massive damage to opponents. Every time we spend 2 arcane cards, we can proc his skill and deal 50 x 5 damage.

The second Immortal is Lancelot, who is a cost-effective meat-shield that can soak up damage and win 1:1 against weaker solo Immortals.

The third Immortal is Amanitore, whose ability is to reduce the cost of arcane cards by 1 on every cast. This makes it possible for us to spam all our spells instantly and infinitely once we get a couple of her on the field.

The fourth Immortal, Moctezuma I, is an essential part of this build. He provides extra Energy Marks, but at the cost of his own HP. Nevertheless, we can heal him, keeping him alive for a long time and getting a ton of free Energy Marks.

The fifth and final Immortal is Zenobia, who has excellent healing abilities. We can spawn a couple of her to keep our Monte’s at higher levels at the cost of her own HP. This mechanic helps us level out the health loss across multiple Immortals, making it easier to keep everyone alive using a healing spell card.

ARCANE SPELL CARDS

Our arcane spell cards consist of four options that serve different purposes. Blizzard is an excellent skill that deals 180 damage in a large area of effect, making it suitable for clearing out weaker immortals and dealing with summoners like Edward and Cleo.

Tsunami is another spell that deals 100 damage but only costs two Energy Marks, making it a suitable spell for getting initial Merlin procs and add-clear ability. It also kills YSG Immortals and the pets of Cleo and Edward, which many players are currently using.

Healing Wave is a crucial spell that can heal every Immortal in a large area of effect, costing only 3 Energy Marks. This means we can place Healing Wave on top of our army of Monte’s and Zeno’s, keeping all of them alive.

The final spell in our build is Blast, which deals 100 damage in a small area of effect and applies a damage over time effect (DoT Burn) that causes an additional 50 damage per second for three seconds, making it a total of 250 damage. Although Blast is an expensive spell, that’s not a problem for us because we have an army of Monte’s and Amanitore’s, enabling us to spam Blast at no cost.

Gameplay

The core gameplay strategy behind this build is to get an exponential growth in Energy Mark income, which, in turn, is used to spam spells, proccing Merlin’s ability to deal massive damage. The weakness of this build is that if you’re up against someone with a lot of clear spells, you may have to spread out further to avoid losing your army of Monte’s and Amanitore’s.

Looking ahead, we plan to swap out Zenobia with Dido to further boost the damage output of Merlin’s ability. This will mean we will need to stay more on top of healing our Monte’s ourselves, but we believe that with the right timing, this build could become even more potent. In conclusion, Battle Chess is an exciting and refreshing addition to Infinity Kingdom, and with the right build, it can be a fun and rewarding experience.

title: Roar of Thunder w. El Cid
description: Infinity Kingdom Battle Chess Guide: Monctezuma’s Energy Regen Combo
html:
Infinity Kingdom Battle Chess Guide: Monctezuma’s Energy Regen Combo

Welcome to the world of Battle Chess in Infinity Kingdom, where strategy, tactics, and the right card combinations can lead you to victory. This is what I am personally using to fight in season 12 of the Battle Chess League.

In this guide, we’ll explore a unique and powerful deck build centered around an energy regen combo featuring the formidable Monctezuma, a key piece in a winning strategy.

Deck Overview:

  • Monctezuma: The energy regen powerhouse that fuels your strategy.
  • Attila: A versatile card to counter backliners strategically.
  • El Cid: A tanky card with counter-attack potential.
  • Cleopatra: A high-damage card capable of spawning numerous units.
  • Dido: A slowing card that complements the steady strategy.

Spell Cards:

  • Heal: Sustain your Monctezuma and keep the energy regen going.
  • Blizzard: A situational card to clear annoying units.
  • Blast: Fire AoE spell to clear slightly bigger units than blizzard and their adds.
  • Call of Thunder: Your key to countering unit spam strategies. Excellent skill to wipe the board when you have all enemies below the threshold.

Deck Strategy:

The core of this strategy revolves around Monctezuma’s exceptional energy regeneration capability. Here’s how to play it:

  1. Priority on Monctezuma: Whenever you have an opportunity to summon Monctezuma, seize it. Monctezuma’s energy regeneration gets you ahead in the energy game, and having multiple Monctezumas on the field is your ticket to success.
  2. Utilize Attila Strategically: Attila is a valuable card, especially against opponents who place smaller cards in the backlines for safety. Attila’s ability to target the backliners directly is powerful, and you should use it strategically to counter these smaller, vulnerable cards.
  3. Deploy El Cid for Counter-Attacks: El Cid is a key card in this deck due to his high HP, decent damage, and the ability to apply counter-attack to three friendly units. This ensures that you can reflect a substantial amount of damage back at the attacker, making it a strong choice against various opponent builds, including both swarm strategies and single-card heavy hitters. Moreover, El Cid plays an important role in countering enemy Lightning Call of Thunder spell cards. He natively has a high HP of 500 which makes him a good tank for Call of Thunder to disable it from continuing through all your units. Keeping a healthy Cid will enable you to interrupt Call of Thunders ability to wipe the board.
  4. Unleash Cleopatra’s Snakes: Cleopatra deals significant damage and has the potential to spawn numerous small snakes on the map. Left unchecked, she can quickly devastate the enemy tower. Keep her on the field to create a swarm of dangerous snakes. Make sure to deploy her in a way that enemies will struggle to AoE kill both her and her snakes.
  5. Slow Down with Dido: While Dido may be considered the weakest card in this build, her ability to slow down enemy attacks can be beneficial. It helps slow the game’s pace, allowing you to build up energy and execute your strategy methodically.

Spell Cards:

  1. Heal: Use the Heal card on Monctezuma when he’s low on HP to get a full 300 healing, effectively spending 2 energy to keep him healthy and regenerating more energy for you. This slow and steady energy regen keeps you ahead in the game.
  2. Blizzard & Blast: These spell cards are situational. Use it to clear troublesome units like Attila or when many low-health enemy units are grouped together. It can be a powerful counter against certain threats. The main difference between the two is the speed at which damage is dealt. To quickly clear an enemy Attila or Monctezuma, use Blizzard, otherwise Blast will do the job as well if you are killing units with add spawns.
  3. Call of Thunder: This spell is your counter to unit spam strategies. It can quickly clear the map, forcing your opponents to have higher HP immortals on the field, which aligns with your strategy, as they’ll still take damage from your Cid’s counter-attacks.

To see how I play this Deck, checkout the video below.

In-Game Tips:

  • Prioritize summoning Monctezuma whenever possible.
  • Keep an eye out for opportunities to deploy Attila strategically.
  • Ensure El Cid, Cleopatra, and Dido are on the field.
  • Use Heal to sustain Monctezuma and maintain energy regen. Make sure to deploy Monctezuma so that your heal benefits other units or your king. Beware that if the enemy relies on spell cards to clear your units in AoE you may want to reserve heal just for Monctezume to avoid setting up enemy AoE wipes.
  • Consider Blizzard to clear enemy threats if needed.
  • Save Call of Thunder for countering unit spam strategies.

This Battle Chess deck provides a unique and steady approach to victory, combining energy regen with powerful unit combinations. Master the strategy, adapt to your opponents, and watch as your forces rise to the top of the chessboard in Infinity Kingdom. Good luck and may your moves be strategic and victorious!

description: Battle Chess is a unique and exciting feature available in the popular mobile strategy game Infinity Kingdom. Combining the strategic gameplay of chess with thrilling action, Battle Chess offers an engaging and challenging experience for players of all skill levels.
html:
Battle Chess is a unique and exciting feature available in the popular mobile strategy game Infinity Kingdom. Combining the strategic gameplay of chess with thrilling action, Battle Chess offers an engaging and challenging experience for players of all skill levels.

To start playing Battle Chess, players must first understand the basic rules. Each player has one King and nine other pieces that can be recycled. The objective of the game is to defeat the other player’s King to achieve victory. There are three types of pieces in Battle Chess: King, Immortal, and Arcane Card. Each piece has its own unique abilities and requirements to use.

The King is the most important piece on the board and has HP. Each side will generate a King at the beginning of the game, and the King will continuously generate Stamina Points. The King can use Stamina Points to move within its side. Immortal pieces also have HP and require Energy Marks to use. Immortal pieces will automatically attack enemy pieces and cast skills. Immortal pieces have their own conduct (normal, fixed point, follow, patrol, charge, etc.), passive skills, and energy skills. The Arcane Card has no HP and requires Energy Marks to use. Players can move it to any position to use it to cast a King’s skill, producing various effects.

Modes

Players can participate in various modes of Battle Chess, including the recently introduced Entertainment Mode. In Entertainment Mode, players can be auto-matched with opponents or invite friends from their alliance to play with.

How it works

Before a game starts, players must select nine pieces from the Immortal and Arcane decks. Energy Marks are required to use these pieces, which will automatically generate once the game starts. Chess pieces will randomly be sorted into the battle zone or the waiting zone, and players can use Energy Marks to put pieces into the battle zone. After a piece is defeated, it will be sent to the waiting zone.

Speed-up Mode will be activated two minutes after a game begins, where the Kings of both sides will begin to lose HP, and the rate of Energy Mark generation will increase. The game will end when the HP of a King reaches zero. The King who survives is the winner.

How to begin

To access Battle Chess, players must tap on the Well of Time icon at the lower right of the main page, where they will be able to find Battle Chess listed. Players must also meet certain participation requirements, including completing “Royal Ambition” in the Chronicle and being at least level 11.

Overall, Battle Chess is an exciting and challenging feature that offers a unique way to experience the classic game of chess. With various modes and participation requirements, players are sure to find themselves coming back for more. So, if you are a fan of chess and strategy games, Battle Chess is definitely worth trying out in Infinity Kingdom.

html:
Beginners’ Guide to Sieging Cities and Capitals in Infinity Kingdom

Sieging cities and capitals is a fundamental part of the Infinity Kingdom experience, whether you’re fighting for control of Norheim, engaging in the Contention of Relics (CoR), or participating in the Legion of Frostborne (LoF). These battles require strategy, teamwork, and careful preparation to ensure success. This guide will provide new players with the essential information needed to master sieging cities, capitals, and larger objectives like the World Heart.

Understanding Siege Mechanics

City sieges are an alliance-wide effort to capture key territories on the map. Successfully capturing a city grants your alliance benefits such as additional resources, buffs, and control over strategic areas. The size and layout of cities vary depending on their type, and understanding these layouts is crucial for effective sieging.

  • Norheim Cities and CoR Relics: These are designed in a 4×4 grid, making them relatively straightforward to siege. Proper positioning of castles ensures efficiency and minimizes travel time.
  • Norheim Capitals, CoR World Heart, and LoF Cities: These targets are larger and use a 5×5 grid, requiring more careful planning due to the odd dimensions. Incorrectly placed castles can create gaps, increasing march times and weakening your siege.

Siege Schematics: The Blueprint for Success

1. 4×4 Cities

For 4×4 cities, position your castles tightly around the city in a grid formation, leaving no gaps. This reduces march times and ensures all alliance members can contribute effectively.

2. 5×5 Cities

The larger 5×5 cities are more challenging to siege because their odd dimensions don’t align perfectly with the 2×2 size of castles. To minimize gaps, plan your placements meticulously:

  1. Assign specific spaces to each member participating in the siege.
  2. Ensure castles are positioned as close to the city as possible, filling the grid efficiently.
  3. Avoid random placements, as they can create inefficiencies that strain the alliance.

Adjusting Talents for Sieging

Your talent setup can significantly impact your siege performance, especially during difficult battles. Before engaging in a siege, switch to military talents that enhance your offensive and defensive capabilities.

  • Ruin: Boosts your siege attack power, making it easier to break through defenses.
  • Survival Methods: Increases troop durability, helping them survive longer against city defenses.
  • Shock: Enhances the damage output of your troops, ensuring maximum efficiency in combat.

Always activate buffs before a siege to further strengthen your army. These buffs can be applied individually or through alliance-wide bonuses.

Strategic Considerations for Sieging

1. Communication and Coordination

Effective sieges rely on teamwork. Communicate with your alliance to coordinate placements, decide who will lead the siege, and plan attack waves. A well-organized alliance can capture even the most fortified cities.

2. Siege Timing

Choose the right time to launch your siege. Avoid attacking when your alliance is spread thin or during off-peak hours when fewer members are online.

3. Maximizing Rewards

Focus on cities that provide the greatest strategic or resource benefits for your alliance. Capturing capitals and relic cities can significantly boost your alliance’s influence and economy.

Contention of Relics and Legion of Frostborne

As your server progresses new cities become available during the PvP events Contention of Relics and Legion of Frostborne.

  • Contention of Relics (CoR): This event introduces relic cities and the World Heart, which require large-scale coordination. The World Heart’s 5×5 layout makes precise castle placement essential for reducing downtime and maximizing participation.
  • Legion of Frostborne (SvS): In later seasons, alliances will face even greater challenges sieging cities and capitals in the frozen lands of the gnomes. These sieges demand high levels of preparation, coordination, and talent optimization.

Final Tips for Beginners

  1. Plan Your Placements: Always use the appropriate schematic for the city you’re attacking. Proper planning prevents gaps and inefficiencies.
  2. Prepare in Advance: Adjust your talents and activate buffs before the siege begins. Small preparations can make a big difference.
  3. Work as a Team: Successful sieges require alliance-wide coordination. Communicate and cooperate to maximize your chances of success.
  4. Learn from Experience: Each siege provides an opportunity to refine your strategy. Pay attention to what works and improve your tactics over time.

By following this guide, you’ll be well-equipped to participate in city and capital sieges, paving the way for your alliance’s dominance in Infinity Kingdom. Good luck, and may your sieges be swift and victorious!

The Ultimate Guide to the Contention of Relics (CoR) Event in Infinity Kingdom

The Contention of Relics (CoR) is one of the most thrilling and rewarding events in Infinity Kingdom. This recurring event pits the three kingdoms against each other in an epic struggle for Energy Cubes within the Forbidden Zone. Successful participation not only advances your development but also grants access to exclusive rewards, including the coveted Fire Immortal. Let’s dive into the basics of CoR, its phases, strategies, and how to secure victory for your faction.

Understanding CoR: The Basics

The CoR event recurs approximately every two weeks. The objective is straightforward: compete to collect Energy Cubes by capturing relics and event nodes in the Forbidden Zone. However, success requires extensive preparation, teamwork, and strategy.

Preparation is Key:

  • Stockpile healing speedups and training speedups to sustain your army during the battles.
  • Ensure your Training Grounds are full of soldiers for your main march.
  • Gather enough resources for troop training, as there are no resource nodes within the Forbidden Zone during the event.

Event Phases

Day One: Preparation and PvP Begin

On the first day, alliances position themselves strategically along the borders of the Forbidden Zone.

  • Positioning: Group near the relic your alliance plans to capture first to ensure unity and prevent isolated attacks.
  • Golem Bosses: Farmable for event currency, these bosses are a good source of additional resources.
  • PvP Event: Engaging in battles within the Forbidden Zone contributes to the PvP ranking, so focus your fights in this area.

Day Two: Node Collection and Relic Sieging

The second phase marks the activation of nodes and relic cities, where alliances earn Energy Cubes and event currency.

  • Event Nodes: Capture and hold nodes to accumulate event points and Valor marks. Holding nodes for extended periods is critical for your alliance’s success.
  • Quests: Complete daily alliance and individual quests to earn gems and Valor marks. Expect about 600 gems daily and 5,000 Valor marks for reasonable quest completion.
  • Relic Cities: The outer relics become capturable, but expect heavy PvP combat while sieging these cities.
  • Pro Tip: Surround siege areas with your castles and use smaller, shielded castles to block enemy attacks effectively.

Day Three: The Final Push and World Heart Siege

The final phase of CoR revolves around maintaining relic control and capturing the World Heart.

  • World Heart Activation: The center of the Forbidden Zone becomes available for siege. Capturing it is mandatory for victory.
  • Multiple Sieges: Be prepared to retake the World Heart multiple times if needed to secure enough points for the win.
  • Relic Control: Continue to hold and defend relics, as they remain crucial for your alliance’s score.

Winning Conditions

To win CoR, your faction must:

  1. Score the highest points with a minimum of 200,000 points.
  2. Successfully capture the World Heart.

Victory allows your faction to appoint a king, who can distribute rewards to contributors.

Strategic Tips for Success

  1. Plan Positioning Carefully
    • Place your castles strategically around siege zones. Surround relics and the World Heart with green and yellow zones covered to minimize enemy access.
  2. Use Shields and Blocking Tactics
    • Deploy shielded smaller castles or alternate accounts around the siege area to block enemies from approaching. This forces them to take longer march routes, giving your alliance a critical edge.
  3. Prioritize Nodes and Relics
    • Assign players to hold nodes and relics while others focus on offense and defense. Efficient coordination ensures steady Energy Cube accumulation.
  4. Coordinate PvP Efforts
    • Communicate with your alliance to target key enemy players and alliances strategically. Focus on disabling their top performers while protecting your own.
  5. Manage Resources and Speedups
    • Ensure you have enough speedups and resources to sustain troops throughout the event. Training new units during downtime can keep your forces strong.

Conclusion

The Contention of Relics is a challenging but rewarding event that tests your alliance’s coordination, strategy, and endurance. By following this guide, preparing thoroughly, and executing your tactics effectively, you can lead your faction to victory and reap the rich rewards of this epic battle.

Best of luck in the Forbidden Zone! May your alliances stand strong and claim the relics for glory!

html:
The Rewards of Contention of Relics (CoR): A Treasure Trove for All

The Contention of Relics (CoR) event an epic event in Infinity Kingdom, most of all because of its insane rewards for players of ALL sizes. This is an amazing event for Free to Play players and whales alike. CoR isn’t just a competition—it’s a kingdom-wide opportunity for growth, progression, and unity. Whether you’re an individual player aiming for glory or a leader strategizing for your alliance, CoR offers a dazzling array of rewards that make every effort worthwhile.

Let’s break down the rewards from CoR, their significance, and how to maximize their benefits for yourself, your alliance, and your kingdom.

How Rewards Work in CoR

CoR rewards come in two main forms:

  1. Alliance Rewards (Energy Cubes):
    • Measured by the total Energy Cubes your alliance gathers during the event.
    • Energy Cubes are earned by:
      • Killing Chaos Beasts.
      • Farming Energy Nodes.
      • Occupying Relics in the Forbidden Zone.
  2. Individual Rewards (Honor):
    • Based on the Honor Points you personally earn during battles in the Forbidden Zone.
    • PvP combat within the zone is the key to racking up Honor Points.

Both types of rewards translate into Valor Marks, a currency that can be spent in the exclusive CoR Shop. Note: Alliance Valor Marks are distributed by R6 leaders, so maintaining good standing with your leadership is important!

The CoR Shop: Your Gateway to Progress

Depending on your faction’s placement in CoR (1st, 2nd, or 3rd), your shop’s offerings will differ. However, even for lower placements, the shop is a massive source of resources and key progression items.

Top-Tier Rewards

  1. Empress Wu Immortal Fragments:
    • First-place alliances gain access to Wu fragments, essential for building a powerful Fire march.
    • Wu is also available in Arena rewards during Season 1, but CoR provides a critical boost for players focusing on Fire.
  2. Philosopher’s Stones:
    • Regardless of your placement, these are available and invaluable for upgrading immortals and for simply melting into Purple Crystals to upgrade those vital Tower of Knowledge skills.
  3. Fragments for Ashoka or Frederik:
    • Even second- and third-place alliances can secure valuable fragments to strengthen Fire and other marches. These can perform fine to run in a fire-setup if you are short Trajan and Seondeok.

Kingdom Rewards: Buffs and Bonuses for All

Crowning a King

The faction that wins CoR appoints a King, who holds the power to:

  • Distribute exclusive gifts to alliance members.
  • Grant the Forbidden Zone Sovereign castle skin to a deserving player.

Royal Buffs

The King can activate Royal Orders, which provide buffs for the entire kingdom. These buffs can be used strategically during wars or server-wide events to ensure dominance.

Post-Event Special Nodes

Winning CoR triggers the appearance of special resource nodes in the Forbidden Zone.

These nodes are extreemly important as they offer:

  • Gold: Critical for technology upgrades and troop training.
  • Speedups: Essential for healing, training, and construction during and after intense battles.

TIP: The amount of Arcane Treasure Nodes made available after a CoR event is complete, is based on the winning factions collection of Energy Cubes. As such, even if you do pass the 300K mark for maximum event rewards, you should keep farming nodes and keep repeatedly sieging the World Heart for as many Energy Cubes as possible! These nodes make a huge difference, especially in younger servers!

Why CoR Rewards Are Vital

For Free-to-Play (F2P) Players

  • The CoR Shop is a vital source of fragments for building a second march, particularly the Fire march, which becomes essential as you progress.
  • Valor Marks allow access to resources that are otherwise challenging to acquire for F2P players.

For Alliances

  • Energy Cubes boost alliance progression and morale.
  • Winning alliances receive significant rewards, enabling them to stand stronger in future battles, including the Legion of Frostborne and Kingdom vs. Kingdom (KvK) events.

For the Kingdom

  • The event’s rewards help unify a server by fostering collaboration and growth.
  • Strategic management of CoR ensures all factions within the server grow stronger, an absolute necessity for succeeding in KvK.

Maximizing CoR Rewards

  1. Coordinate with Your Alliance
    • Work together to secure relics, nodes, and Energy Cubes. Unity is the key to victory.
  2. Farm Efficiently
    • Focus on Chaos Beasts and Energy Nodes to maximize contributions to alliance rewards.
  3. Prioritize Honor Farming
    • Engage in PvP combat within the Forbidden Zone to climb individual rankings.
      Tip: Use Honor Talents to farm Honor by sending talent-attacks against a castle where you have stacked maximum garrisons. Read more in my Honor Guides.
  4. Plan Ahead
    • Save resources, speedups, and healing items before CoR begins. Prepared players earn more rewards.

Final Thoughts

The Contention of Relics is not just about winning battles; it’s about building a stronger kingdom. The rewards—from exclusive Immortal fragments to special resource nodes—make it a cornerstone event for every player in Infinity Kingdom.

So, roll up your sleeves, rally your alliances, and take advantage of every opportunity CoR provides. Whether you’re chasing Empress Wu fragments, Philosopher’s Stones, or the glory of being crowned King, this event has something for everyone.

Don’t just participate—dominate. And remember, in CoR, every contribution counts.

⚔️ What Is the Contention of Relics (CoR)?

CoR is a kingdom-wide event where alliances compete to collect energy cubes by gathering mysterious energy nodes across the world map. These cubes translate into Valor Marks, which you can redeem in the CoR shop for powerful resources—chief among them, healing speed boosts crucial for preparing for IBL and KvK.

Without CoR Valor, players miss out on optimal healing speed, putting them at a disadvantage when wars begin.

TL;DR

  • CoR lets you collect energy cubes for Valor Marks.
  • Valor Marks are primarily used to buy healing speed-ups, essential for war readiness.
  • Valor points and healing speed are non-negotiable in IBL, KvK, and server-wide PvP.

🌟 Why Valor Marks Matter

The CoR shop offers high-value items like healing speed-ups—essential for rapidly regenerating troops post-battle. When wars hit, players with fully stocked healing boosts can relaunch attacks or defenses with minimal downtime. That edge can mean the difference between winning or losing a KVK or IBL.

Maxing out Valor ensures you’re never caught flat-footed.

TL;DR

  • Healing speed-ups from Valor are critical in war.
  • High Valor = faster healing = more fighting power.
  • CoR is your best chance to stockpile these ahead of KVK/IBL.

🚀 The Swarm Strategy: Farm Alliance Mastery

Once your main alliance reaches 300,000 energy cubes (max Valor), further farming yields no additional rewards. Enter the farm alliance swarm: setting up multiple small alliances to repeatedly earn the high-value 10K cube reward tier—boosting Valor drastically.

By cycling members through farm alliances just long enough to hit 10K, you can replicate this reward endlessly.

TL;DR

  • Main alliance hits cap at 300K cubes → no more Valor.
  • Small alliances that hit just 10K cubes unlock 40 Valor per cube (400K Valor per alliance).
  • You can repeat this across many alliances to top your Valor stock repeatedly.

🧩 How to Execute the Farm Alliance Swarm

  1. Primary “Main” Alliance: Use this alliance to hit 300K cubes, win CoR, and capture kingdom rewards.
  2. Many “Farm” Alliances: Create 10–20 mini-alliances specifically to farm just 10,000 cubes each.
  3. Cycle Members or Alts: Move players into a farm alliance, farm 10K cubes, claim Valor in main, get kicked, then join a new farm alliance.
  4. Repeat & Scale: Each cycle yields 400K Valor per alliance, multiplied by the number of farm alliances and participants.
  5. Bank in Main: After cycles, return to main alliance and redeem all Valor at once.

Magic Mage’s example: Watch here

“16 participants across 12 alliances…314,831 Valor in just farm alliances, on top of core alliance rewards.”

TL;DR

  • Form main alliance for initial cap.
  • Spin through mini-alliances hitting 10K each.
  • Claim Valor, bounce, repeat—with no cooldown penalties.
  • Every 10K mission = 400K Valor per player involved.

💸 A Closer Look: Numbers & ROI

Unbuffed Valor rates from alliance tiers:

  • 300K cubes → 3.6M Valor (12/cube)
  • 10K cubes → 400K Valor (40/cube)—the goldmine!

If your group runs 12 farm alliances with 16 participants:
Each player walks away with:

  • ~316K Valor from farms + 225K from main = ~540K Valor total per CoR cycle.

That’s enough to purchase multiple healing speed packs, fully preparing everyone for war.

TL;DR

  • 12 farm alliances × 16 players = ~316K Valor per player.
  • Add main alliance Valor → ~540K total per cycle.
  • Enough Valor to secure multiple healing speed-ups every CoR.

🔧 Tips for a Smooth Operation

  • Node Refresh Awareness: Energy nodes respawn hourly—time your node farming accordingly.
  • Communication is Key: Use Discord or alliance chat to coordinate which farm alliance is active.
  • Kick & Rejoin Smart: Kick players immediately after Valor claim to bypass cooldowns.
  • Monitor Alliance Capacity: 10–16 active members yield best results in mini-alliances.
  • Alt Account Use: Add more participation capacity and stagger farming schedules.
  • Assign Leadership Roles: Ensure someone oversees coordination and Valor distribution.

TL;DR

  • Track node resets and rotate participants.
  • Clear chat & leadership structure streamline the process.
  • Alt accounts increase throughput—but coordination is essential.

🔥 Why This Strategy Is a Game-Changer

  • Dramatically Increases Valor Output: Beyond standard farming, you unlock Valor scaling by moving into farm alliances.
  • War-Readiness Multiplier: Consistent access to healing boosts ensures you’re battle-ready at all times.
  • Access for All: Even small alliances lacking big PvP presence can farm high-value rewards.
  • Alternative to Main Alliance Limits: Avoid diminishing returns by farming strategically.

TL;DR

  • Boost Valor supply well beyond typical limits.
  • Ensure constant healing speed reserves for war.
  • Empowers small or casual alliances to remain competitive.
  • Works cycle after cycle for long-term gains.

✅ Final Thoughts

The farm alliance swarm is a revolutionary CoR tactic that supercharges your Valor earnings by exploiting reward tiers. With proper coordination, even a small team can generate half a million Valor per cycle, far exceeding what standard CoR farming offers.

Whether you use alts, real members, or a mix, this method ensures you’re not just participating in CoR—but dominating it. Use your more consistent Valor to gear up, speed-up, and outlast your kingdom rivals.

title: Arena rewards – Immortals and their rotation by season
description: The Arena in Infinity Kingdom is one of the most important features for progressing and strengthening your army. Each season, new Immortals become available as placement rewards and in the Arena Shop.
html:
The Arena in Infinity Kingdom is one of the most important features for progressing and strengthening your army. Each season, new Immortals become available as placement rewards and in the Arena Shop.

These Immortals are some of the most powerful units in the game, and planning ahead to obtain them is crucial for optimizing your gameplay. This guide will help you understand the seasonal rotation of Immortals and how to use the Arena effectively to build a top-tier army.

Why Arena Immortals Matter

Arena Immortals are unique units that can dramatically enhance your army’s performance. They are not only strong individually but often come with powerful synergies for specific elemental builds. Knowing when your desired Immortal will be available allows you to plan, save Arena coins, and make strategic decisions to improve your lineup.

Seasonal Immortal Rewards Overview

Each Arena season lasts a limited time, offering both placement rewards and Immortals for purchase in the Arena Shop. Here’s the breakdown of Immortals for each season:

Season 1

  • Placement Reward: Empress Wu
  • Arena Shop Slot 1: Harald
  • Arena Shop Slot 2: Hippolyta

Season 2

  • Placement Reward: Attila
  • Arena Shop Slot 1: Cleopatra
  • Arena Shop Slot 2: Harald

Season 3

  • Placement Reward: Alexander the Great
  • Arena Shop Slot 1: Richard I
  • Arena Shop Slot 2: Cleopatra

Season 4

  • Placement Reward: Peter the Great
  • Arena Shop Slot 1: Emperor Qin
  • Arena Shop Slot 2: Richard I

Season 5

  • Placement Reward: Hannibal Barca
  • Arena Shop Slot 1: Hippolyta
  • Arena Shop Slot 2: Emperor Qin

How to Earn Immortals in the Arena

1. Placement Rewards

At the end of each Arena season, your rank determines your placement reward. Immortals given as placement rewards are rare and often pivotal for specific elemental teams, so aiming for a high rank is essential.

2. Arena Coins and Arena Shop

  • Earn Arena Coins by participating in and winning Arena battles. You earn through the victory point bar in the bottom of the screen as well as 10x victory points as insignias per battle won.
  • Use these coins to purchase Immortals from the Arena Shop, where two Immortals are available for each season.
  • Immortals in the Arena Shop can often complement or enhance your elemental strategy, so prioritize those that fit your team’s needs.

Tips for Arena Immortal Selection

  1. Plan Ahead:
    Since the rotation of Immortals in the Arena is predictable, you can save Arena coins for when a specific Immortal you need becomes available. For example, if you’re building a hybrid team, you might want to save for Qin or Alexander the Great.
  2. Optimize for Your Elemental Build:
    Each Immortal aligns with a specific elemental affinity. Research how the Immortal synergizes with your current lineup. For instance:
    • Harald (water): Strong for physical damage based water teams.
    • Empress Wu (Fire): Must have for offensive Fire builds.
    • Hippolyta (fire): Must have for fire teams with her control and ability proc capabilities.
  3. Balance Offense and Defense:
    While some Immortals like Attila masters control and Hannibal Barca excel in offense, others like Richard I are better for defense and control. Think about your strategy and the role your desired Immortal will play in it when picking which immortals and fits with your setup. Read guides here on this website to see builds for all stages of development.
  4. Use Arena Coins Wisely:
    Avoid spending Arena coins impulsively. Immortals in the shop will rotate out, so having enough coins banked ensures you won’t miss out on key units.

How to Succeed in the Arena

  1. Build a Strong Lineup:
    Focus on strengthening your team to climb the Arena leaderboard. Maximize synergies between your Immortals and dragons to dominate battles.
  2. Participate Regularly:
    Consistent participation in Arena battles earns more Arena coins and improves your chances of securing high placement rewards.
    Tip: I would make sure to always get the 10 victory point bonus, even if that means spending gems for a ticket. Getting 240 Insignia + rewards from the ticket-win battle every day stacks up very quickly.
  3. Track Seasonal Immortals:
    Keep this guide handy to know which Immortals are coming up and when to aim for specific rewards or shop purchases.

Conclusion

Arena Immortals are a cornerstone of success in Infinity Kingdom. By carefully tracking their seasonal availability and planning your purchases, you can strengthen your elemental teams and dominate in both PvP and PvE content.

Save your Arena coins, aim for high placements, and target the Immortals that best fit your strategy. With the right approach, the Arena will become a key tool in building your dream army.

Happy battling, and may the Immortal rewards be ever in your favor! 🏆✨

title: Golden Path Shopping List for F2P or Spender
description: By Myrahk – July 2025
html:
Infinity Kingdom Guide: Best Shopping List for Golden Path (Patch 2.8.5 Edition)

By Myrahk – July 2025

Common Player Question throughout the many years of Golden Path: What should I prioritize? What should I buy?… lets answer that once in for all!

The Golden Path is, hands down, the best value feature in Infinity Kingdom. It gives access to meta immortals, unique artifacts, portals, purple crystals, and other high-value items at a better rate than any other system in the game. But with limited Golden Path Coins each season, what should you actually buy?

This guide breaks it down for Free-to-Play, Light Spenders, and Whales, helping you make the best shopping choices based on your playstyle and goals.

How to Complete a Golden Path Season

Levels and Runtime: To fully utilize the entire shop during the Golden Path Season, players need to reach level 50. The event spans a duration of 30 days, giving you ample time to immerse yourself in its challenges and reap the rewards.

Daily Quests: By completing the 18 daily quests you can earn a total of 216 EXP.

Total Gain Calculation: We have around 30 days to complete a season. 30 x 216 EXP = 6480 EXP = 64 levels. That means you get the 100 from clearing battle pass plus 15x 50 return reward = 450 coins for a total of 550 coins per season entirely free to play.

Buying the Battle Pass for 20$ you get 20 levels, meaning an additional 600 coins as you repeat the 50 level 20 more times plus 200 coins from the paid tier rewards as you level. Total of 550 + 600 + 200 = 1350 coins.

Step 1: Understand Your Coin Budget

Here’s how many coins you can expect:

  • Free-to-Play: ~500–600 coins (depending on activity and pass completion)
  • Light Spender (Premium Pass): ~1300-1400 coins (200 from the instant 20 levels + ~750 from progression)
  • Whale: No real limit — you’ll max the pass every season, just gem it…

Knowing your coin budget helps prioritize properly.

Best Buys in the Golden Path Shop

Before we make lists, here are the top-value items every player should consider:

  • Action Point Flasks (x10) – 1,000 AP each for just 10 coins — insane value for farming gnomes/events.
  • Unique Artifacts (NEW) – Now available for those immortals, 600 coins each (one per immortal per season).
  • Meta Immortal Fragments – Yi Sun-Shin, Matilda, Artemisia, Tokugawa, Trajan are game-changing.
  • Random Immortal Fragments (x5 per element) – 1500 total per season for 150,000 purple crystals (Best source for ToK growth).
  • Portals (x10) – Cheap migration tokens at 50 coins each.

Myrahk’s Best Shopping Lists

Let’s optimize based on player type:

Free-to-Play (500-600 coins)

If you’re F2P, your focus should be long-term progression. Goal: Get the core immortals that you are unable to obtain elsewhere due to pay-walls.

Priority Order:

  1. Immortal Fragments – Pick one meta immortal you’re building. Keep buying until core main march immortal is max.
  2. Action Point Flasks (x10) – 10,000 AP — 100 coins total.
  3. Elemental Selection Unique Artifacts – 480 coins. Use them to upgrade your core damage dealer in your main setup max.
  4. Random Immortal Fragments 60x fragments for 60 coins, buy as many as you can and turn them into Purple Crystals to upgrade your ToK skills.
  5. If you are considering migration, Portal (50 coins) or stockpile toward next season.

Light Spenders (1300-1400 coins with Premium Pass)

This is the sweet spot for efficiency. You get enough coins to make serious progress without spending hundreds.

Priority Order:

  1. Action Point Flasks (x10) – 100 coins for 10,000 AP for event farming efficiency.
  2. Elemental Selection Unique Artifacts – 480 coins. Very good value, make sure you buy both (2x) in stock and upgrade your core damage dealer in your main setup max.
  3. Unique Artifact – 600 coins. This is huge value if you need it. But you should only buy if you are using these immortals in your main or secondary march.
  4. Random Immortal Fragments (all 5 elements) – You gain 100 Purple Crystals worth of fragments for each coin spent here. Max 1500 coins for 150K Crystals.
  5. Portals – if you are doing migration prep.

Goal: Make one immortal artifact-ready, continue boosting your Tower of Knowledge, and stock up on migration flexibility.

Whales (No Budget Limit)

If you’re maxing, your shopping list is everything. But there’s still a smart order of operations:

Priority Order:

  1. All Unique Artifacts – 600 coins each — must-have for meta immortals.
  2. All Meta Immortal Fragments (5x each) – You’ll max their talents much faster.
  3. Random Immortal Fragments (all 5 elements) – Even whales need purple crystals for maxing ToK.
  4. Portals (x10) – Flexibility for cross-server migration.
  5. Action Point Flasks (x10) – Farm nonstop.
  6. Cosmetics (castle skins, frames) – If you care about aesthetics.

Goal: Max out your main team’s immortals and artifacts, prep for Conquest meta builds, and maintain server movement flexibility.

Why This Shopping Order Works

  • Purple Crystals are the hardest long-term bottleneck — get them every season.
  • Artifacts are now the biggest game-changer for meta immortals.
  • Meta Immortals like Yi Sun-Shin, Matilda, Trajan, and Tokugawa remain top Conquest picks.
  • Portals & AP future-proof your account for server politics and event farming.

TL;DR – Myrahk’s Golden Path Shopping Rules

  • F2P: Paywalled immortals for free here → Action Points → Random fragments for purples.
  • Light Spender: Action Points → Artifact for main → Paywalled immortals for free here → Random frags → Portals.
  • Whales: Buy everything in this order: AP → Artifacts → Immortal Frags → Random Frags → Portals → Cosmetics.

Final Thoughts

Even after the 2.8.5 adjustments (fragment limit reduction), the Golden Path is still the single best value purchase in Infinity Kingdom.

For Free-to-Play, it’s your primary path to Tower of Knowledge growth.
For Light Spenders, it’s the perfect mix of efficiency and power progression.
For Whales, it’s the fastest way to stay meta with artifacts and immortals.

If you take anything from this guide, it’s this: Never miss a season of Golden Path.

Infinity Kingdom Guide: How to Complete a Golden Path Season (and Maximize Your Rewards)

By Myrahk – July 2025

The Golden Path is one of the most rewarding systems in Infinity Kingdom, giving you access to meta immortals, unique artifacts, Tower of Knowledge fragments, portals, and more — all at the best value in the game.

But to make the most of it, you need to complete the season efficiently. Whether you’re Free-to-Play or spending for the premium track, this guide will show you how to reach the max level, maximize your coins, and get everything you want from the Golden Path shop.

Understanding the Golden Path Season

Length: 30 days per season.

Max Level: Endless. Level rewards until 50, then repeat level 50 for more coins. Fully completing the path unlocks all rewards and ensures you gain the maximum amount of Golden Path Coins.

Purpose: Completing the Golden Path each season gives you enough coins to buy high-value shop items like meta immortal fragments, Tower of Knowledge fragments, and now unique artifacts (added in the 2.8.5 update).

How Much EXP Do You Need?

To fully complete the Golden Path (reach level 50), you need:

  • 7,000 EXP

How Do You Earn EXP?

You earn EXP through daily quests:

  • 18 daily quests worth a combined 216 EXP per day.

Multiply that by the full 30-day season:

  • 216 EXP x 30 days = 6,480 EXP

That means even as a Free-to-Play player, completing all dailies every day will land you at least level 64, which overshoots the requirement for level 50.

From there, you can buy levels for 450 gems each (30 coins).

In short:
Even without spending, you can comfortably hit max level — if you do your dailies consistently.

Coin Earnings: Free-to-Play vs. Spender

The real reason to finish the Golden Path? Coins. Checkout my guides on what to buy here.

Here’s how the math breaks down:

Free-to-Play

  • Base Pass: 50 levels = 550 coins total.

Breakdown:

  • 100 coins from reaching level 50 (flat reward).
  • 15 x 50-coin return rewards (750 EXP increments after 50 levels) = 450 coins.

Total: 550 coins per season.

Premium Pass ($20)

Buying the Premium Pass instantly gives you 20 levels and additional coin rewards.

  • 20 instant levels = 600 extra coins (you repeat the 50-coin return reward cycle 20 times).
  • 200 bonus coins from premium-tier rewards as you level.

Total with Pass: 1,350 coins per season

Why It Matters

These coin amounts directly determine what you can afford in the shop each season. Whether you want to prioritize Tower of Knowledge purple crystals, meta immortal fragments, or unique artifacts, hitting these targets means you can actually buy them.


Step-by-Step: How to Complete the Golden Path

  1. Log in every day.
    • Consistency is everything. Missing too many days can drop you below level 50.
  2. Do all 18 daily quests.
    • This gives you 216 EXP daily, which is more than enough to max the pass.
  3. Track your progress.
    • Don’t wait until the last week to panic — check your level regularly.
  4. Buy the Premium Pass if you can.
    • For $20, you get +20 levels, 600 more coins, and better loot on the premium track.
    • Value-wise, this is the best single purchase in Infinity Kingdom.
  5. Plan your shop purchases early.
    • Coins earned from the Golden Path don’t roll over between seasons. Know what you want before you spend.

What Should You Buy With Your Coins?

This depends on your player type:

  • Free-to-Play: Get the core immortals and artifacts that you are unable to obtain elsewhere due to pay-walls
  • Light Spenders: Elemental Selection Unique Artifacts, UA’s, core paywall immortals and Purple Crystals.
  • Whales: Immortal frags, random frags for purples, Unique artifacts, AP… get it all!

(See my Golden Path Shopping Guide for a full breakdown).

TL;DR – Myrahk’s Completion Tips

  • Do all dailies (18 quests, 216 EXP/day) — you’ll easily exceed level 50.
  • F2P gets 550 coins each season.
  • Spend $20 for Premium Pass to jump to 1,350 coins total — the best purchase in the game.
  • Plan your shopping list early so you don’t waste coins on low-value items.

Final Thoughts

The Golden Path remains the single most valuable system in Infinity Kingdom, especially after the 2.8.5 update added unique artifacts.

Even if you’re Free-to-Play, completing the Golden Path each season will give you enough coins for meaningful upgrades. And for light spenders, the Premium Pass is the best bang for your buck in the entire game.

Bottom line:
Do your dailies. Finish the pass. Spend smart. Repeat every season.

That’s how you stay competitive — no matter your spending level.
