title: Farming Stardust during anniversary
description: Infinity Kingdom 3rd Anniversary Event Guide: Mastering Sweetness Guardian
html:
Infinity Kingdom 3rd Anniversary Event Guide: Mastering Sweetness Guardian

Hey, fellow lords and ladies of Infinity Kingdom! The 3rd Anniversary Event is here, bringing with it a whirlwind of excitement and the chance to bag heaps of rewards. Today, we’re diving deep into the “Sweetness Guardian” tab, your golden ticket to farming Stardust and event Dice, essential for maximizing your gains during this festive period. So, grab your gear, rally your Immortals, and let’s conquer this event like the legends we are!

Understanding the Event Mechanics

First off, “Sweetness Guardian” is all about completing missions to earn points. These points are your currency to unlock those sweet, sweet rewards. There are two types of missions:

  • Timed Missions: Send your Immortals on a long journey, and they’ll return with event points. This is highly inefficient and should only be done while you are taking a break from IK. As you see below, I am not stuck and cannot farm anything. Have to wait for the missions to complete.
  • Find Traces Missions: Here’s where the fun begins. These missions involve hunting down snowman bosses, and trust me, they’re the key to farming effectively.

Strategic Farming for Stardust and Dice

Here’s where strategy plays a crucial role. To maximize your rewards, follow this expertly crafted approach:

  • Timing is Everything: Only dispatch your Immortals on timed missions when you’re about to log off. Why? Because while you’re actively playing, you don’t want to clog your mission slots with long-wait missions.
  • Focus on Find Traces Missions: While playing, prioritize completing all “find traces” missions. These are your golden goose, leading you to snowman bosses which can be quickly defeated and refreshed.
  • The Refresh Strategy: After clearing the traces missions, hit that refresh button without starting any new timed missions. This increases the chances of more traces missions popping up, leading you to more snowman bosses to farm.
  • Rinse and Repeat: Complete all traces missions, refresh, and continue this cycle. This method ensures you’re farming snowman bosses efficiently, propelling you towards maxing out your event rewards.

Why This Strategy?

You might wonder, why all this fuss about avoiding timed missions? Here’s the deal: to complete the entire event and unlock the full spectrum of rewards (we’re talking about a whopping 1500 points), timed missions just don’t cut it. They’re slow, and their point yield isn’t enough to reach the event’s summit. Snowman bosses, on the other hand, are your express ticket to success, offering quick and repeatable missions that can be farmed for a consistent point influx.

Rewards Unlocked

By mastering this strategy, you’re looking at bagging 100 Stardust and 50 event Dice. And guess what? These Dice pair wonderfully with those you’ll collect in the Fireworks Party, setting you up for some major reward hauls!

Happy farming, and here’s to a bountiful 3rd Anniversary Event!

title: How many Dice do you need for Chaos rewards?
description: Rolling to Victory: Your Ultimate Guide to the 3rd Anniversary Dice Event in Infinity Kingdom
html:
Rolling to Victory: Your Ultimate Guide to the 3rd Anniversary Dice Event in Infinity Kingdom

Welcome to the highlight of the 3rd Anniversary Event in Infinity Kingdom—the Dice Event, where strategy meets luck, paving the way to incredible rewards including the much-desired Chaos Eyes and the exclusive Fu Fei fragments. This guide will not only walk you through the mechanics of this event but also provide a strategic blueprint to optimize your dice rolls for maximum gain.

Understanding the Event Mechanics

In this thrilling event, players use dice to navigate around a special board, collecting points to unlock rewards. The main prizes to eye are the Chaos Selection Chests and Fu Fei fragments, requiring 1500 and 3500 points, respectively.

Points Accumulation:

  • Flag Points: Each purple-marked flag you pass grants you 10 points.
  • Start Bonus: Circling back to the start nets you an additional 20 points.
  • With a total of 30 fields and utilizing a single six-sided die (1d6), let’s delve into the math to unveil the average dice rolls needed for those coveted rewards.

Strategic Point and Dice Calculation

For every complete round on the board, you amass 70 points. Given the average roll value of a 1d6 die is 3.5, it translates to approximately 8.6 dice needed per round to secure those 70 points.

To reach the 1500-point milestone for all Chaos Selection Chests:

  • You’ll need an estimated 184 dice, calculated as 1500 points divided by 70 points per round, then multiplied by 8.6 dice per round.

Aiming for the full 3500 points to claim all Fu Fei fragments:

  • It escalates to around 430 dice, following the same calculation method.

Acquiring Dice: The Path to Success

Wondering where to get enough dice to reach these milestones? A combination of event participation and strategic spending is your answer.

Free Dice Sources:

  • Daily Quests: Completing these can earn you 25 dice.
  • Sweetness Guardian Tab: Offers 50 dice.
  • Fireworks Tab: Provides a tiered reward system with 10 dice available for free and an additional 35 for engaging with the gem tier.

The Game Changer—$20 Tier in the Fireworks Tab:

  • Splurging $20 unlocks 100 dice, bringing the total to an astounding 220 dice when combined with free sources. This investment is touted as one of the best values in Infinity Kingdom’s history, especially for those aiming to integrate a powerhouse like Loki into their lineup.

Why This Matters

Securing 220 dice for a mere $20 not only propels you towards achieving the 80 Chaos Selection Chests but also demonstrates the unparalleled value offered by this event. This approach is highly recommended for players looking to significantly enhance their strategic options without breaking the bank.

Final Thoughts

The 3rd Anniversary Dice Event in Infinity Kingdom offers a blend of strategy, luck, and potential for significant gameplay advancements. By understanding the mechanics, carefully planning your dice acquisition, and perhaps making a calculated investment, you can maximize your rewards and potentially revolutionize your Immortal lineup.

Whether you’re a dedicated F2P player or willing to invest a bit for exponential gains, this event is your golden ticket to unlocking powerful rewards. So, roll wisely, strategize smartly, and may the dice fall in your favor!

html:
Infinity Kingdom’s 3rd Anniversary Event Guide

As Infinity Kingdom approaches a significant milestone, the 3rd Anniversary event, set to begin on February 18th and extend through March 4th, promises a grand celebration unlike any before. This detailed guide offers players an exclusive preview into the festivities, laying out the mechanics and rewards of each event segment. Designed to mirror the excitement and depth of seasonal events but with the added joy of a 15-day long celebration, this event is a treasure trove of opportunities for both new and veteran players.

This is the written guide for all of you who prefer reading over watching YouTube styled videos. Prefer video? Check out my post here

Anniversary Celebration

This segment is the cornerstone of the event, where players earn 3rd Anniversary Coins by engaging in a variety of missions. These coins are your ticket to unlocking special treasure chests filled with rewards. The more points you accumulate, the better the chests become, with the highest-tier chest offering coveted items such as the Fate Of Chaos Selection Chest and Stardust. This setup encourages daily participation, ensuring players have ample motivation to log in and complete missions throughout the event’s duration.

Sweet Guardian

In Sweet Guardian, players are tasked with dispatching immortals on missions or defeating limited-time anniversary snowmen, a novel enemy introduced for the celebration. Successful missions and battles reward players with Fireworks, a special currency used in the Fireworks Party event.

This section not only provides a unique challenge with the introduction of snowmen but also a direct link to earning rewards in another part of the anniversary event, showcasing the interconnected nature of the event’s design.

Happy Land

Happy Land offers players a chance to stumble upon Anniversary Celebration Chests through routine game activities such as collecting resources, gathering, or defeating Gnome Units or Bosses. These chests contain 3rd Anniversary Coins, further contributing to your ability to unlock special chests in the Anniversary Celebration segment. It emphasizes the event’s integration into all aspects of gameplay, allowing players to progress in the event by engaging with the game’s core mechanics.

Fireworks Party

The Fireworks Party is where players can let off the Fireworks collected in the Sweet Guardian event to claim an array of rewards. This part of the event introduces additional layers of strategy, as players must decide when and how to use their Fireworks to unlock rewards.

With tiers including free, gem, and a $20 option, players of all spending levels can participate and benefit from this celebratory activity, further enhancing the event’s inclusivity. We even get Eyes of Chaos here, amazing redeem rewards!

Long Live Friendship

An exciting addition to the anniversary event is the Long Live Friendship dice game. Players use dice to move Glyndwr across a board, collecting gifts at each stop. This game is a highlight, offering major rewards such as the Eye of Chaos, Ancient Spirits Selection Chest, and more.

The dice game also provides a pathway to obtaining Fu Fei chaos fragments and chaos selection chests, making it a focal point for players aiming to bolster their immortal lineup at a potentially great discount.

Gift Exchange

The Gift Exchange is a feature allowing players to use their 3rd Anniversary Coins to handpick rewards. This exchange offers strategic choices, including the Artifact Schematics Selection Chest and the Shadow and Light Selection Chest, among others. This element of the event empowers players to tailor their rewards to their specific needs and goals, providing a personalized celebration experience.

Exclusive Gift Pack

Marking the occasion, the Anniversary Festival Pack offers various levels of purchase options, each providing generous amounts of dice for the Long Live Friendship event. This pack is designed for those looking to maximize their event participation and rewards, catering to different levels of investment.

The Event Skin

The anniversary event introduces an exclusive skin, providing a 3% healing boost to seriously wounded troops in hospitals. While the buff might seem modest, the skin stands as a symbol of participation in the 3rd Anniversary celebration, offering both aesthetic and functional value to commemorate the occasion.

Conclusion: Celebrating in Style

The 3rd Anniversary event of Infinity Kingdom is a meticulously designed celebration, offering a comprehensive suite of activities and rewards that cater to a wide range of player interests and strategies. From battling snowmen in Sweet Guardian to strategic decision-making in the Fireworks Party, there’s something for everyone in this grand celebration. As we await the start of the festivities, this guide serves as your compass to navigate through the event, ensuring that you make the most of this once-a-year opportunity to celebrate, strategize, and win big. title: 4th Anniversary Celebration Event (feb. 2025)
description: Infinity Kingdom 4th Anniversary Celebration – Everything You Need to Know!
html:
Infinity Kingdom 4th Anniversary Celebration – Everything You Need to Know!

Wow, can you believe it? Four years of Infinity Kingdom already! This game has truly become one of the best castle builders out there, and this anniversary event is packed with amazing rewards, powerful new items, and some great ways to boost your account. Let’s go over everything you need to know so you can make the most of this event and maximize your progress.

Sign-In Rewards: Easy Gems & Token of Lights

The simplest way to start stacking rewards is by just logging in every day.

  • You’ll get 800 gems and 5 Token of Lights over the course of the event.
  • These Token of Lights are essential for summoning immortals in the Dazzling Wish tab, so don’t miss any days!

This is completely free, so make sure to collect everything!

Dazzling Wish: Summon Powerful Immortals

The Dazzling Wish is the event’s exclusive summoning system, and it’s where you’ll use your Token of Lights to pull immortals.

  • Each pull requires 1 Token of Light.
  • You can summon random immortals, including rare Holy and Shadow immortals.
  • If your server is still in the Preparation Stage, this is the only way to obtain Holy Immortals right now.
  • On Conquest servers, you can pull Chaos Immortals and even Chaos Selection Chests!

Maximizing Your Pulls

  • Save at least 14 Tokens of Light so you can do one summon per day for the Battle Pass daily quest.
  • If you’re in Conquest, prioritize pulling for Chaos Immortals – they are game-changing!
  • If you’re in a Preparation Stage server, save your fragments for later, as Holy is still developing.

Bottom line: Dazzling Wish is your best chance at getting powerful immortals. Use your Tokens wisely!

Celebration Battle Pass: Insane Value & Must-Have Rewards

If you’ve played the Golden Path event before, this will feel familiar. The Battle Pass is packed with valuable rewards, and it’s worth the effort whether you’re a free-to-play (F2P) or a spender.

What Do You Get?

  • Free Tier: Random immortal fragments, speed-ups, and resources.
  • Paid Tier ($50):
    • 10 Token of Lights
    • 60x random Holy/Shadow immortal fragments
    • 6,000 gems
    • The exclusive City of Glory castle skin!
      • 2% Troop HP buff
      • 5% Honor Gain buff

This skin is a must-have for combat, as Troop HP is rare and incredibly useful. Plus, the extra Honor Gain makes this perfect as your battle skin.

How to Complete It Efficiently

  • 30 levels total
  • 4500 EXP required to max it out
  • 8 daily quests available awarding 50 EXP each
  • Daily max EXP: 400
  • Takes ~12 days to complete (event lasts 14 days)

You can miss one quest per day or one full day and still finish on time. All the quests are simple and F2P-friendly, so there’s no excuse not to complete them!

👉 Verdict: If you can afford it, get the Battle Pass. Even if you aren’t focused on Holy immortals, the castle skin alone makes it worth it for any player.

Celebration Shop: Where to Spend Your Coins

During the event, you’ll earn 4th Anniversary Coins that can be spent in the Celebration Shop for some top-tier items.

Best Purchases:

  • 15x Token of Light (400 coins each) – Needed for summoning immortals.
  • 2x Unique Artifact Selection Chests (2000 coins each) – Top priority! These allow you to select an artifact for any element.
  • 500 Stardust (100 per 1000 coins) – Great if you have extra coins.
  • Speed-up Chest (80 coins for 4x 1-hour speed-ups) – Decent value if you have leftover currency.

🔑 Tip: Don’t spend your Token of Lights right away! One of the daily quests requires using Dazzling Wish, so make sure to save some to complete this every day.

How to Earn Coins:

  • Glorious Challenge: Complete and raid stages for coins.
  • Infinity Kingdom Profile Tab (Memories Section): Free 1000 coins just for checking it!
  • Buying Glorious Challenge tickets with gems:
    • 400 gems for 5 tickets (5 bundles available)
    • 100 gems for a single ticket (10 max available)
    • Total: 35 extra tickets possible

💡 Goal:

  • 15 Token of Lights
  • 2 Unique Artifact Chests
  • 500 Stardust

👉 First priority: Get the Unique Artifact Chests. Everything else is secondary!

Glorious Challenge: Push as Far as You Can!

This event works similarly to Well of Time, where you progress through stages and then raid the highest one you can clear.

  • Normal & Hard Mode available
  • Each completed stage increases your rewards
  • First-time clears also give 50 gems

I am not able to complete the normal mode with my 130K stp march in preparation but I think it will be a cake-walk for anyone in Conquest.

Regardless of completing the entire thing, we are basically just going to complete the highest possible level and earn as many Anniversary Coins we can. Each time you complete a new stage the rewards increase. So push as far as you can and then begin raiding.

First clear also rewards 50 gems, so the cost of getting extra tickets in the beginning is quite low.

For those in Conquest servers, this should be easy. If you’re in Preparation Stage, you’ll need a strong march to push higher.

Pinnacle Trial: Daily Rewards Up for Grabs

During the event you can challenge the trial once per day and earn quite powerful rewards if you can complete the trials. I have not been able to find a way to earn more Trial Tickets – but maybe im missing something. If so, please write to me on Discord (I’m Myrahk as always).

  • Challenge once per day.
  • Rewards include random immortal fragments, Token of Lights, and Holy/Shadow fragments.

Infinity Kingdom Profile Page: Free Rewards!

  • Click the red IK icon → Memories Tab
  • Earn a profile picture frame & 1,000 Anniversary Coins
  • Fun to check your game history, especially if you have an older account!

💡 Side Note: There’s a Returning Player Event, but we’re unsure about the rewards yet. If you know someone returning, have them check it out!

Final Strategy Guide

✅ Push as high as possible in Glorious Challenge ✅ Buy extra tickets if needed for Unique Artifact Chests ✅ Battle Pass is worth it, especially for the skin & fragments ✅ Complete at least 7/8 daily quests to finish Battle Pass ✅ Save Token of Lights for daily Battle Pass quests ✅ Prioritize Unique Artifacts in the shop ✅ If you’re on Conquest, invest in Chaos Immortals!

This 4th Anniversary Event is one of the best yet! Between the Battle Pass, Celebration Shop, and free sign-in rewards, now is the perfect time to power up your kingdom and get ready for bigger battles ahead.

🎉 Happy 4th Anniversary, Infinity Kingdom Lords! 🎉

Now get out there and dominate the event! 💪🔥

What is this event about?

There will be two types of missions:

  1. Individual Challenges
  2. Alliance Challenges

It basicly revolves around killing gnome camps.

Individual Challenges

Individual Challenges force you to fight Shadow Rogues. After each completed camp you progress into higher and higher camp levels and the
Shadow Rogues grow stronger. Shadow Rogues are capped at level 30.

TIP: You can use multi-unit-attack for a little more AP to beat strong opponents.

Alliance Challenges

Alliance Challenges gets unlocked after a certain amount of members succeed in their individual Challenges.
Alliances Challenges are Shadow Bosses which can be summoned by the Alliance R6 or R5. And must be killed by the Alliance.
Bosses are capped at level 6.

Important: Bosses die too fast for an entire alliance to hit it. Everyone must gather up in one location, summon the boss and hit it with a 1-unit march (see below). This way, everyone can get the juicy rewards!

1 unit march – remove immortals and allocate 1 soldier

Rewards

Rewards from this event are three-fold.

  1. First of all you get a reward based on your personal and individual progress in the event.
  2. In addition, you are given a reward based on the progress of your alliance when the event ends.
  3. Make sure to participate with atleast a 1 unit march when your alliance is killings its boss. Everyone who hits the boss are given additional participation rewards. These are artifact shards depending on the challenge level, but very good loot for minimal effort.

The “Blessings of Triss” event in Infinity Kingdom is a special event that offers a variety of rewards, including special artifacts, ability stones, resources, and materials for artifacts. Here’s a guide to help you navigate and make the most out of this event:

Event Mechanics

  1. Coin Toss: Players can throw a coin into a well to receive a random reward, such as schematic artifact fragments, ability stones, or resource items.
  2. Event Duration: Typically, this event lasts for three days.
  3. Free and Paid Participation: You get a free throw each day of the event. Additional coins for extra throws can be purchased, usually with better value in the lower-priced packages.
  4. Artifact Fragment Limit: You can limit the fragments to lock a specific artifact, increasing your chances of getting it faster, but this comes at a higher cost of (up to) 6 coins per throw.

Strategy Tips

  • Free to Play Limitations: Note that the event is not entirely free-to-play friendly. Using only the free coins provided daily will not get you very far. I am not sure if any player has been able to obtain a skill as a free to play yet – and we have had Triss for a long time now!
  • Purchasing Strategy: It’s recommended to buy the $20 packages multiple times to maximize value, as higher-priced packages offer lower value compared to the combined lower-priced ones. Read more here
  • Event Complexity: The mechanics of the event are quite intricate, so it’s essential to understand them well to optimize your chances of getting the rewards you’re aiming for.

Main aspects of the event

  • Max Skill Stone Strategy: A key part of the event involves strategies for acquiring skill stones. This aspect is crucial for players looking to maximize their benefits from the event. Read more here
  • Obtaining crucial unique artifacts: The Blessings of Triss event is the main source of the best unique artifacts available in the game. These greatly improve the Immortal they are designed for. Read more here

Concluding remarks

  • Stay Informed: Keep an eye on updates and guides from reliable sources and community members.
  • Community Engagement: Don’t hesitate to ask questions in community forums or directly contact experienced players for advice.

The Blessings of Triss event in Infinity Kingdom is an exciting and rewarding experience for players. Understanding its mechanics and strategizing your participation, especially regarding coin purchases and aiming for specific rewards, can significantly enhance your success in the event.

title: Max skill stone strategy
description: Mastering the Art of Skill Stone Farming in the Blessings of Triss Event
html:
Mastering the Art of Skill Stone Farming in the Blessings of Triss Event

Welcome, commanders, to the Blessings of Triss event—a realm of wishes, artifacts, and the elusive skill stones. In this guide, we will unravel the strategic approach to maximize your chances of acquiring skill stones efficiently, saving resources and ensuring success in your endeavors.

1. Event Overview:

The Blessings of Triss event offers commanders the opportunity to purchase wishes, which can be used to obtain various rewards, including artifact fragments, unique artifacts, and the highly sought-after skill stones. With 151 drops available in a single clear, understanding how to farm skill stones efficiently is paramount.

2. Resetting the Board:

After obtaining the desired rewards, commanders have the option to reset the Triss event, refreshing the board and cycling through artifacts and skill stones. This allows for targeted farming, enabling players to focus on specific artifacts or skill stones they need for their Immortals.

3. Farming Artifact Fragments:

While farming artifact fragments, commanders can strategically eliminate unwanted artifacts, increasing the drop rate for the desired ones. However, this approach comes at the cost of additional wishes. It is crucial to evaluate the trade-off between increased drop rates and efficient wish usage.

4. Skill Stone Drop Rates:

Unlike artifact drop rates, the drop chance for skill stones remains constant regardless of the number of wishes used. Whether a commander opts for a 1-wish draw or a 6-wish draw, the chance of obtaining a skill stone remains the same.

5. Efficient Skill Stone Farming Strategy:

To maximize efficiency in acquiring skill stones, commanders are advised to follow these steps:

  1. One-Wish Draws: Initiate one-wish draws until you obtain a skill stone. The drop chance remains consistent, making this the most resource-efficient method.
  2. Reset and Repeat: Once a skill stone is acquired, reset the board, and repeat the process. This ensures commanders focus on finishing one skill before moving on to the next.
  3. Wish Banking: To avoid inefficient wish usage, maintain an adequate reserve of wishes. Unlucky streaks may require multiple draws, and having enough wishes to complete a round even with bad luck is crucial.
  4. Estimated Cost: On average, commanders may spend around 55-60 wishes per skill stone. Considering the cost of wishes, approximately $137-$150 per skill stone draw can be expected.

6. Note on Drop Chance:

While the official drop chance for a skill stone is 1%, it’s essential to understand that the probability changes with each wish. The initial draw has a 1% chance, but subsequent draws see a slightly higher chance as the pool of unwanted items decreases.

7. Conclusion:

Mastering the art of skill stone farming in the Blessings of Triss event requires a strategic and resource-conscious approach. By adopting efficient wish usage, resetting the board judiciously, and maintaining a wish reserve, commanders can navigate the event with precision. May your wishes be granted, and your Immortals strengthened with the coveted skill stones. Best of luck, commanders!

title: Wisdom Well and Skill Stones in Season 1, 2 and Conquest
description: The Wisdom Well is one of the most important long-term progression systems in Infinity Kingdom. This is where you draw for skill stones, which are required to unlock and upgrade combat skills for your immortals.
html:
The Wisdom Well is one of the most important long-term progression systems in Infinity Kingdom. This is where you draw for skill stones, which are required to unlock and upgrade combat skills for your immortals.

While in Season 1–2 the focus is on farming Epic-quality skills, the game completely changes once you enter Conquest, where Legendary skills become available. These are far more powerful, but they are also vastly more expensive. Understanding the costs, drop rates, and expectations is key to budgeting your Wishes and resources wisely.

This guide breaks down:

  • How Wisdom Well works
  • Draw rates and expectations
  • Epic vs Legendary skills
  • Upgrade costs
  • Realistic planning for F2P vs Spenders

How Wisdom Well Works

  • You spend Wishes to draw.
  • Each draw has a 2% chance of giving 4x skill stones for the current skill on offer.
  • You need 60 stones to unlock a new skill (both Epic and Legendary).
  • In Conquest Wisdom Well, you also get two separate 1% chances to obtain an Epic+ Quality Skill Stone Selection Chest (these can contain premium Epics like Corrosive, etc.).

Key Differences by Season

  • Season 1–2: Focuses on Epic Skills. Once you’ve collected 60 stones, you unlock the skill and you’re done.

Note that, if you want to be as efficient as possible, you should actually never participate in Wisdom Well throughout season 1 and 2. As a moderate spender, value for every dollar matters a lot. With the same amount of money you are going to be able to obtain Legendary skills in Wisdom Well Conquest version and buy the Wisdom Well skills from season 1 and 2 in the Cinder Shop for the Cinders (which are obtained with every wish made).

Basically, in season 1 and season 2 you are going to be seeing skills like Blade Vortex, Guard, Purification, Weakening Curse and other very very good and top meta skills. You can buy them during seasons and get an competitive edge, but you should be aware, that once you enter Conquest these skills become MUCH cheaper and even available completly F2P as they are added to the Cinder Shop once the Wisdom Well rewards progress into Legendary Quality.

  • Conquest: Unlock Legendary Skills. These require 60 stones to unlock, but then additional stones to level up further needing 240 to max.

Legendary Skill Upgrade Costs

Unlocking is just the beginning. Legendary skills have 8 levels total, and each upgrade costs more stones:

👉 Total: 240 stones to fully max a Legendary skill.
Compare that with 60 for an Epic — Legendaries are literally 4x more expensive to complete.

Draw Rates and Expectations

Epic/Legendary Skill Stones (2% chance, 4 stones per hit)

  • Goal: 60 stones to unlock = 15 hits
  • Drop chance: 2% per draw
  • Average hits per draw: 0.02
  • Expected draws per hit: 50
  • Expected draws for unlock: 15×50=416 draws (on average)

👉 On average, it takes ~416 draws to unlock a skill.
90% confidence interval: 325 to 502 draws

Fully Maxing a Legendary (240 stones = 60 hits)

  • 60 successes needed
  • At 2% chance (i.e. probability = 0.02) to give 4 stones.
  • pity mechanic at 40 draws

To max a Legendary you need 60 successes (240 stones), so: E[Max]≈60×27.715 ≈ 1,663 draws average.

Side Reward: Epic+ Skill Stone Selection Chests (Conquest only)

  • Two separate 1% rolls per draw
  • Expected draws per chest: ~50.

Strategic Considerations

Epic Skills in Season 1–2

  • Much cheaper (60 stones = one unlock, no upgrades).
  • Epics like Vitality Touch, Purification, Guard are core meta skills.
  • Use early Seasons to stockpile these.

Legendary Skills in Conquest

  • Game-changing: skills like Knife Through Butter or Fountain of Life redefine builds.
  • But hugely expensive — one Legendary = four fully unlocked Epics.
  • Prioritize carefully; don’t spread your stones too thin.

Epic+ Selection Chests

  • These are a hidden gem of Conquest Wisdom Well.
  • Along the way you get some of the strongest Epic skills along the way.
  • Don’t underestimate these — many Epics remain meta-critical even into late Conquest.

The Cinder Shop

Every Wish spent in the Wisdom Well gives you Cinder(s), a currency you can use to buy skill stones directly. If you don’t like the stones you have, you can also sell them back for the same Cinder cost (1:1 refund).

This makes Cinders a powerful safety net: no Wish is ever wasted. Strategically, you can turn unwanted stones from KvK rewards into the exact skills you need, including buying back older Season 1–2 Epics during Conquest. Over time, this lets you patch holes in your skill library, guarantee progress even through bad RNG, and ensure every resource you put into the Wisdom Well eventually moves your account forward.

F2P vs Spenders

Free-to-Play (F2P)

  • You are not going to be playing with Legendary Skills. Focus on KvK and unlocking skills via the Cinder Shop.
  • Expect to spend many seasons collecting Cinders and slowly grind out the skills there.
  • Wisdom Well is a spender event, not much to do about that.

Moderate Spenders

  • If you want to be as efficient as possible, you should NEVER participate in Wisdom Well throughout season 1 and 2. As a moderate spender, value for every dollar matters a lot. With the same amount of money you are going to be able to obtain Legendary skills in Wisdom Well Conquest version and buy the Wisdom Well skills from season 1 and 2 in the Cinder Shop for the Cinders (which are obtained with every wish made).
  • Unlocking Key Legendary skills needs to be done carefully. Generally, Fountain, Knife Through Butter (if Alex based setup) or Energy Master for mage setups are going to be your first skills. But this is generally speaking, make sure you know which skill fits your main before you begin!
  • Tip: Fountain works well at level 1 making it an excellent skill for moderate spenders as it dosent NEED to be maxed.

Heavy Spenders/Whales

  • Can chase full Legendary lineups.
  • The real bottleneck becomes time, not wishes.
  • The strongest accounts will max multiple skills in parallel.

Practical Tips

  1. Budget realistically — 416 draws per unlock, 1663 draws per legendary max.
  2. Value Epics highly — they remain relevant and are cheaper.
  3. Pick your Legendaries carefully — focus on those that fit your build.
  4. Side rewards matter — Epic+ chests from Conquest Well can give you Corrosive, etc.
  5. Patience pays — Wisdom Well is a marathon, not a sprint.

Final Thoughts

The Wisdom Well is where power and patience meet. Epics form the backbone of strong Season 2 and early Conquest builds, while Legendaries unlock the highest ceiling for late Conquest and beyond.

For most players, the goal should be to unlock 1–2 key Legendaries per season while steadily building your Epic library. Spenders can go further, but even they will feel the stone crunch.

In Season 1–2, you mainly chase Epic skills and you’re done at 60. In Conquest, you unlock Legendary skills: far stron
html:
What the Wisdom Well Actually Is

Wisdom Well is the game’s long-arc progression lever. You spend Wishes (each Wish = one draw) to hit a low-chance (2%) payout that drops 4× skill stones. Skills unlock at 60 stones. In Season 1–2, you mainly chase Epic skills and you’re done at 60. In Conquest, you unlock Legendary skills: far stronger, but they keep asking for more stones to level up.

Conquest also adds two side rolls per draw: two independent 1% chances at an Epic+ Skill Stone Selection Chest. Those chests contain some of the best Epic skills (e.g., Corrosive, Malice, etc.) and materially improve the value of Conquest draws.

Legendary Upgrade Costs (total 240 stones)

You unlock at 60 stones, then climb to level 8:

A max Legendary costs 4× an Epic (240 vs 60 stones).

Draw Mechanics (why the numbers look big)

Lucky for us, there is a pity mechanic, so instead of spending an average 750 draws to obtain a full 60 stones for unlock (or around 3000 for a max chaos) we are getting a pity system to protect out max amount of draws. What this means is, that if you are not getting the main stone reward within 39 draws you are certain to get it on the 40th. Thus you can get a full 60 stones at the worst of luck in 15*40 = 600 draws.

But what is the actual number of draws required? Lets look at the maths.

We’re modifying the usual geometric (success prob p=0.02p=0.02p=0.02) so that if you fail 39 times in a row, the 40th draw is guaranteed. That means the number of draws TTT to your first success follows a truncated geometric:

  • Pr⁡[T=n] = p(1−p)^n−1
    for n = 1,2,…,39
  • Pr⁡[T=40]=(1−p)39\Pr[T=40] = (1-p)^{39}Pr[T=40]=(1−p)39 (the pity case)

Expected draws for one success:

With p=0.02p, this gives: E[T]≈27.71498

(Down from 1/p=501/p=501/p=50 without pity.)

To unlock a skill you need 15 successes (because 60 stones at 4 per hit), so the expected draws become: E[Unlock]≈15×27.715 ≈ 416 draws

To max a Legendary you need 60 successes (240 stones), so: E[Max]≈60×27.715 ≈ 1,663 draws

Where to Buy Wishes (and why it matters)

There are two storefronts:

In-game (3-day weekly event; combined stock)

  • $5 → 4 Wishes (max 6/week)
  • $10 → 6 Wishes (max 12/week)
  • $20 → 8 Wishes (max 18/week)
  • $50 → 12 Wishes (max 18/week)
  • $100 → 24 Wishes (max 18/week)

Value per $ (in-game): 0.80, 0.60, 0.40, 0.24, 0.24 Wishes per $ respectively.

Gtarcade (weekly stock)

  • $5 → 8 Wishes (max 10/week)
  • $10 → 12 Wishes (max 10/week)
  • $20 → 16 Wishes (max 8/week)
  • $50 → 24 Wishes (max 6/week)
  • $100 → 48 Wishes (max 5/week)

Value per $ (Gtarcade): 1.60, 1.20, 0.80, 0.48, 0.48 Wishes per $ respectively.

Bottom line: Gtarcade gives exactly double the Wishes per dollar at every tier.

Weekly stock caps:

  • Gtarcade total if you buy everything:
    80 + 120 + 128 + 144 + 240 = 712 Wishes/week for $1,110.
  • In-game total if you buy everything all three days:
    888 Wishes/day × 3 = 2,664 Wishes/week for $9,630 (terrible value).

Basically, always buy Gtarcade. Only buy in-game if you are in some absurd super rush. And spend on the cheap tier bundles which are FAR greater value.

The Real Cost to Unlock and Max (with stock caps respected)

This is the part everyone underestimates. Your cost depends on:

  1. How many Wishes you need (416 for unlock; ~1663 for max on average), and
  2. Which shop(s) you buy from (Gtarcade vs in-game), plus
  3. How quickly you want it (stock caps control the speed at which you can buy the cheapest bundles).

If you want the cheapest possible dollars per Wish (Gtarcade $5 then $10 first)

Buy Gtarcade $5 (0.625$ per wish) until you hit its weekly cap, then $10 (0.83$ per wish), then $20 (1.25$ per wish), then $50/$100 only if you must. Assuming you are buying 5, 10 and 20 out. We average a cost per wish of

  • Unlock (416 draws)
    • Buying only $5 and $10 Gtarcade bundles gives 200 Wishes/week for $150/week.
    • Time: 2-3 weeks to stockpile ~416 Wishes.
    • Estimated cost (avg. price 0.75$ with gtarcade 5 and 10 bundles): about $312 for 416 draws
  • Max Legendary (1663 draws)
    • Same plan (only $5 & $10): 200 Wishes/week at $150/week.
    • Time: ~8-9 weeks.
    • Estimated cost: about $1,247 on average.
    • If you want faster, you’ll step into the $20/$50/$100 tiers (worse value).

This “$5/$10 only” path is the best dollar efficiency and what I recommend to most spenders who are patient.

If you buy in-game bundles instead

Value is roughly half as good (or worse) as Gtarcade:

Effective Rate (only $5 & $10 packs)

  • $5 → 4 wishes = 0.8 wishes per $
  • $10 → 6 wishes = 0.6 wishes per $
  • Average (buying all stock of both):
    • 24 wishes ($30) + 72 wishes ($120) = 96 wishes for $150.
    • That’s 1.56 $ per wish.
  • Estimated cost: about $649 reach ~416 Wishes (on average unlock).

👉 In-game $5 and $10 bundles are much weaker value than GTarcade, but they are still better than the $20/$50/$100 bundles.

Upgrading a Legendary (240 stones = ~1663 wishes)

  • Needs ~1663 wishes on average.
  • Buying only $5 & $10 packs: 96 wishes/event for $150.
  • 1663 wishes / 96 wishes ≈ 17 events/weeks.
    • 17 events × $150 = $2,550. To obtain 240 stones.

Okay, then what should I buy???

Basically, you want to be buying the Gtarcade 5$ and 10$ bundle, after that the Gtarcade 20$ bundle and the in-game 5$ bundle becomes same value. These will get you 352 wishes per week for 340 dollars.

If you need even more wishes per week, you move into the yellow tiers beginning with in-game 10$ bundles and the Gtarcade 50$ and 100$ bundles. These will get you an additional 456 wishes per week for 920 dollars. Considerably worse value, but still better than the 20$ in-game which is your backup in case you are desperate for wishes.

Do not ever buy in-game 50$ or 100$ bundles, the value on those is just horrible!

Practical Playbook

1) Decide your goal before you spend

  • Unlock only? Or unlock + max?
  • Be honest about your budget and your server’s timeline.

2) Buy in this order every week (value first)

  • See above…

3) Stockpile before you roll
Wishes don’t spoil. Save for the skill you actually want, then fire them in one go to minimize half-finished projects.

4) Don’t ignore Epics
Even deep in Conquest, Epics like Guard, Purification (situational), Vitality Touch, Spring of Life, Weakening Curse, etc., are still core. You can get these in the Well in season 1 and 2 or in Cinder Shop during Conquest.
Conquest draws also give you Epic+ chests along the way—use them to finish essential Epics while you climb a Legendary.

FAQ (quick hits)

Q: Can I rely on the average (416/1663) exactly?
A: No. They are means. Real outcomes often deviate. If you must finish by a date, budget more.

Q: Should I ever buy in-game?
A: yes, once you have bought the Gtarcade 5 and 10 dollar bundles, the in-game 5 dollar bundle is on-par with the 20 dollar Gtarcade one.

Q: Is it ever correct to spread stones across multiple Legendaries?
A: Yes. Fountain of Life is a special case, as it gives you the control immunity at level 1. Moreover, legendary skills are strong enough to compete with top tier skills around level 4 and outperform them around maybe 5-6 by a decent enough margin to replace other top tier skills. This always depends on skill and setup, but the important thing is, that you do not need a level 8 Legendary to use it.

Greetings, fellow Infinity Kingdom commanders! Today, we bring you thrilling news that promises to reshape the landscape of our gaming experience. This event is not just another addition to our routine; it’s a game-changer, offering players from less active servers a golden opportunity to migrate to a new, predetermined server – all for free.

The Purpose of the Event:

The primary aim of the “Call of the New World” event is to breathe fresh life into servers that have been struggling with inactivity. Recognizing the importance of a vibrant player community, the developers have crafted a unique chance for commanders stuck in otherwise quiet realms to merge into a more active and bustling environment. In doing so, this event ensures that our beloved Infinity Kingdom remains a dynamic and engaging world for all.

Merging players into fewer servers is a strategic move that benefits the entire community. It creates a more lively and competitive atmosphere, fostering collaboration, competition, and camaraderie. By consolidating the player base, the game gains the necessary activity and community spirit to thrive. This shift is not just about moving accounts but about building a stronger, more united community.

The “Call of the New World” event opens the door for a multitude of servers to participate in the migration process. Whether you’re a commander seeking a change of scenery or a leader looking to revitalize your server, this event offers the chance to reshape the future of your Infinity Kingdom.

Special Consideration: Bypassing Migration Caps

One standout feature of this event is its ability to bypass the migration cap restrictions that servers may typically impose. During the “Call of the New World,” servers open for free migration cannot limit or disable migration, allowing for a more seamless and unrestricted experience. This groundbreaking aspect ensures that players have the freedom to move without hindrance, creating an open and fluid environment for all.

Conclusion:

The “Call of the New World” event is more than just a server migration; it’s a chance for commanders to embark on a new adventure, revitalizing less active realms and building a stronger, more connected Infinity Kingdom. title: Should you spend on the Elemental Bond event?
description: In the past, the Elemental Bond event was a decent way to obtain fragments for certain Immortals. It was limited, a bit underwhelming, and only rotated a small number of Immortals—mainly Water and Fire. Because of that, I placed it in the high B-tier in my tier list video.
html:
In the past, the Elemental Bond event was a decent way to obtain fragments for certain Immortals. It was limited, a bit underwhelming, and only rotated a small number of Immortals—mainly Water and Fire. Because of that, I placed it in the high B-tier in my tier list video.

But things have changed. Since the recent update, Elemental Bond has undergone a massive transformation, and it’s time we adjust our rankings. I now firmly place Elemental Bond in a recommended event to participate and spend on. It’s not the absolute top, but it’s one of the highest-value recurring events for any player, especially mid-game and late-game accounts.

What Changed in the Update?

1. Immortal Rotation Every Two Days

The biggest change is the introduction of a rotation schedule for different elemental pairings. Now, every 48 hours the lineup changes, cycling between elemental pairs like:

  • Earth and Thunder
  • Water and Earth
  • Water and Fire (the original default setup)

This opens access to a much wider range of powerful Immortals. Previously, you were locked to a static selection; now, there’s a strategic calendar-based opportunity to target difficult-to-obtain units.

2. Revamped Mechanics and Guaranteed Rewards

Each board contains 12 cards and guarantees fixed rewards:

  • 12 fragments of a selected Immortal (6×2-card pairs)
  • 30 Element Dragon Shards

It’s no longer a gamble. Every 12-card clear guarantees valuable progression materials.

3. Predictable and Affordable Spending

Each board clear requires 12 Soulglass Crests, which cost $3 per set. That means you can reliably target key Immortals without diving into expensive packs or depending on RNG. This is particularly important for progressing mid-spenders and light pay-to-play players.

Why This Event Is Good Now?

A) Access to Gem-Heavy and Rare Immortals

Many Immortals in the rotation are:

  • Gem Heavy (only available via expensive market purchases or packs)
  • Event Locked or rare in typical gameplay

Examples include:

  • Tokugawa Ieyasu (Lightning)
  • El Cid (Lightning)
  • Genghis Khan (Wind)
  • Louis IX (Fire)
  • Saladin, Alexander, Richard, and others

To make these Immortals viable in PvP, most require Level 8 Specialization. Elemental Bond gives you a clear path to work toward that without needing to gamble in the Market or wait for events like Lucky Spin.

B) Fragment Sniping: Min-Maxing Value

One of the best strategies is what we call “fragment sniping.”

  • Flip cards manually—never use the Flip All button.
  • If you match both of the 6-fragment cards early, reset the board immediately.
  • Prioritize fragments over dragon shards—shards are farmable; fragments are not.

This lets you stretch your crests and acquire more fragments with less spending.

C) Consistent Daily Value

  • You can buy 5 Soulglass Crests of each type daily.
  • These do not lose value with more purchases.
  • Compared to many events with diminishing returns, this one stays stable and affordable.

Comparison to Old Version ‘Triumph of Fate’

  • Triumph of Fate had RNG, mixed rewards, and often left you with junk.
  • Elemental Bond is clean, reliable, and much better for actual progression.

You’re paying for exactly what you want—fragments and shards, no fluff. This makes it significantly more efficient in both time and money.

Ideal Player Targets

This event is fantastic for:

  • Light and Mid-Spenders who want to focus on 1–2 Immortals at a time
  • Competitive Players trying to hit Level 8 Spec for powerful Immortals
  • Catch-Up Players needing value fragments without RNG or Market drain

Final Thoughts: S-Tier for a Reason

The Elemental Bond event used to be decent. Now? It’s essential.

  • Predictable $3 per 12 fragments + 30 shard payout
  • Rotating elements ensure regular access to top Immortals
  • Min-maxing with sniping makes it the best-value spend event in the game
  • Fragment rarity offset by strategic board clearing

If you skipped this event before or undervalued it, it’s time to rethink your strategy. With smart fragment sniping and a focus on the right Immortals, Elemental Bond is now a top-tier progression tool for all players—free-to-play or spenders alike.

Highly recommended.

html:
With the release of Patch 2.8.4, Infinity Kingdom has retired the long-standing and generally underwhelming Triumph of Fate event, replacing it with a completely revamped and significantly improved version: Elemental Bond. This new event introduces a modernized structure, rotating Immortal pools, and a cost-effective shard acquisition method for paying players.

In this guide, we’ll break down how the new Elemental Bond event works, its key differences from Triumph of Fate, optimal spending strategy, and overall evaluation from both a pay-to-play and free-to-play perspective.

What Changed From Triumph of Fate?

Triumph of Fate used to offer:

  • 12-card flip board
  • Up to 12 Immortal Shards
  • 1 Sun Crystal, 2 Artifact Fragment Chests
  • Some Dragon Crystals, EXP Scrolls, and Speedups
  • 2 free daily flips
  • Additional flips at 300 Gems each

However, this event was widely criticized for its poor rewards, low Immortal variety, and lack of shard consistency.

With Patch 2.8.4, Triumph of Fate has been retired. In its place stands Elemental Bond, with meaningful upgrades that focus on value, predictability, and expanded Immortal choices.

How the New Elemental Bond Works

Event Duration: Weekly, from Friday to Monday.

Event Mechanics:

  • You flip cards on a 12-tile board, aiming to match pairs.
  • Each flip costs 1 Soulglass Crest, a new event currency available only via in-game bundles.
  • Instead of flipping one by one, you can use a Flip All option, which costs 12 Soulglass Crests and instantly gives all the rewards.

Rewards Per Round:

  • 12 Immortal Fragments of your selected target
  • 30 Element Dragon Shards matching your Immortal’s element

Rotation System:

  • Immortals are split into two-element groups that rotate every two days:
    • Water & Earth
    • Earth & Lightning
    • Lightning & Wind
    • And so on
  • Only elemental Immortals are available (no Shadow, Holy, or Chaos)
  • Immortal pool includes high-value rares such as Charles, Han, and Baldwin

Bundle Pricing:

  • All packs offer the same consistent value: 1 Soulglass Crest = $0.25
  • 12 Crests = $3 (cost to complete 1 full flip session)
  • No value degradation in higher-priced bundles (a rarity for IK)

Is Elemental Bond Worth It?

For Light to Mid Spenders

  • YES.
  • $3 per 12 Fragments of top-tier Immortals like Charles or Khan is excellent.
  • Compare this to $99 Epic Return packs or Lucky Spins with lower predictability.
  • You also receive a small number of Dragon Shards to help develop dragons.

For Free-to-Play (F2P) Players

  • NO.
  • Unlike Triumph of Fate, no free daily flips are available.
  • No way to earn Soulglass Crests through gameplay or gems.
  • The event creates a stronger paywall around Immortal acquisition.

Strategic Tips

  • Always use Flip All: Since the reward is fixed and there’s no RNG advantage to flipping manually, save time and just Flip All for 12 Crests.
  • Choose Wisely: Pick Immortals that are hard to get elsewhere. Go for Charles, Baldwin, Han, or Wu if available.
  • Bundle Efficiency: Buying the cheapest bundles repeatedly yields the same value as large packs — buy according to your budget.
  • Dragon Shards: Don’t expect large shard gains here. This is more about Immortal progress than Dragon growth.

Final Verdict

Pros:

  • Predictable, fixed-price Immortal acquisition
  • High-value Immortals in rotation
  • Excellent for catch-up and focused spending
  • Consistent pack value (rare for IK)

Cons:

  • Fully paywalled; no F2P access
  • Limited Dragon Shard gains
  • No Artifact rewards or added bonuses

Elemental Bond is a strong addition to the game for low- and mid-spenders. While it does remove free options for F2P players, it makes acquiring some of the game’s best Immortals significantly more affordable and predictable. It represents a step forward in value, though not necessarily in accessibility.

We hope to see future iterations include hybrid mechanics, such as a free daily flip or gem conversion to open it up to more players.

Stay tuned for rotation schedules and best picks from each cycle in upcoming guides!

title: Alliance Challenge
html:
Alliance Challenge Recommendation in Infernal Assault

For alliances with ambitious goals and a drive for excellence, it is highly recommended to focus on completing Level 10 and Level 20 of the Infernal Assault event. The reason behind this recommendation lies in the point allocation system, where each level’s destroyed Core Furnace grants the alliance 5 points.

To provide a clearer understanding, let’s delve into some calculations. The following was kindly provided to us by player Tea, thank you for sharing with the community!

Level 10: 5 x (10) = 50 Alliance Points Level 12: 5 x (12) = 60 Alliance Points Level 20: 5 x (20) = 100 Alliance Points

Level 10 consists of 3 nodes to be completed, with each node assumed to be worth 100 Alliance Points. Thus, the AP requirement for Level 10 is 3 x 100 = 300 AP for every 50 points.

Level 12 has 5 nodes to be finished, with the same assumption of 100 AP per node. Consequently, the AP requirement for Level 12 amounts to 5 x 100 = 500 AP for every 60 points.

Similarly, Level 20 also comprises 5 nodes, each valued at 100 AP. Therefore, the AP requirement for Level 20 is 5 x 100 = 500 AP for every 100 points.

Let’s consider a case where a player with limited spending capabilities possesses 21,000 AP and desires to spend it during the event. Employing the equilibrium formula, we can make comparisons among Level 10, Level 12, and Level 20:

Ctotal: Level 10 = Level 12 = Level 20 Ctotal: (Q/Qr) x P = (Q/Qr) x P = (Q/Qr) x P

Calculations: Ctotal: (21,000/3 x 100) x (10 x 5) = (21,000/5 x 100) x (12 x 5) = (21,000/5 x 100) x (20 x 5) Ctotal: 70 x 50 = 42 x 60 = 42 x 100 Ctotal: 3,500 = 2,520 = 4,200

Based on the formula, it is evident that allocating 21,000 AP for Level 10 will yield an Alliance Point contribution of 3,500 (with a minimum death troop requirement of 120,000), Level 12 will result in a contribution of 2,520, and Level 20 will provide 4,200 points (with a minimum death troop requirement of 220,000).

Considering the above calculations, if you hold a leadership position within the alliance (R6 or R5), it is advisable to suggest that alliance members focus on completing Level 10 and Level 20 to optimize their performance in the event and increase the chances of securing the top position.

How to Manage Alliance Challenge

To effectively manage the Alliance Challenge within the Infernal Assault event, it is crucial to employ certain strategies. Here are some tips to ensure smooth coordination and maximize participation:

Set the Alliance Calendar or Send Alliance Mail

It is essential to utilize the features of the alliance calendar or send alliance mails to notify all members of the upcoming siege. These notifications serve as reminders and allow all alliance members to prepare for the event. As a leader (R6 or R5), it is your responsibility to set the alliance calendar or send the necessary mails to keep everyone informed.

Remind Your Alliance Members in Alliance Chat

To ensure that all alliance members actively participate in the Individual Challenge, regularly remind and motivate them through the alliance chat. Encourage open communication and provide assistance and guidance to members who may have questions or need support during the event.

Set the Alliance Mark

a) Find the Location for Infernal Assault

When setting the alliance mark, it is advisable to choose a location near the borderline, as it increases the likelihood of the mark appearing next to your castle. This makes it easier for alliance members to locate the Infernal Assault and rally together for coordinated attacks.

b) Add to the Alliance Bookmark

In addition to setting the alliance mark, add the location of the Infernal Assault to the alliance bookmark. This allows all members to quickly access the event’s location and eliminates any confusion or delays when mobilizing troops.

By implementing these strategies and effectively managing the Alliance Challenge, your alliance can work together seamlessly, optimize participation, and increase the chances of achieving top rankings in the Infernal Assault event. Remember, coordination and teamwork are key to achieving success in this endeavor.

title: Builds: Farming lvl 43’s minimal losses
description: Guide to Infernal Assault in Infinity Kingdom
html:
Guide to Infernal Assault in Infinity Kingdom

Infernal Assault is an incredibly important event for every player in Infinity Kingdom – why? Simple, it is the single best method of obtaining vast piles of gold. Gold is arguably the most precious resource in the game (perhaps only surpassed by pure gems and VIP points). Gold is required in massive amounts to upgrade your Immortals and Dragons and is something that every player struggles to ever get enough of. Therefore, you need to take advantage of every Infernal Assault event and earn as much gold as you can.

There are two important limitations to understand when dealing with Infernal Camps. Firstly, you are limited in the number of troops you can/want to spend on farming these camps. Secondly, you are limited by your Action Points (AP) in terms of how many camps you can kill without draining your AP-bank.

The higher the level of the enemy camps, the harder the fight is but the more gold you are rewarded from clearing. This is why you need to find a sweet-spot, i.e. the highest level camp you can clear without taking massive losses. This way you retain troops and AP and get as much gold as possible during the event.

For me, my sweet-spot has previously been level 28, then 33-34 and now with my new builds that I would like to share with you all I am comfortably clearing level 43 Infernal Camps and Infernal Core with minimal losses.

My Builds

So let’s get on with it and have a look at the builds. There are two builds here, you can either choose to make two different formations and swap between them or make them as your first and second team. If you are having problems clearing cores with this build as a second team (maybe due to lower technology, boost levels or Immortal levels) you should go for two formations and make small modifications to the core-build.

The first build you want is for clearing the camps. These function as normal gnome camps which you need to clear as quickly as possible with low losses. This means area of effect damage (AOE) since we have four gnome enemies.

For the second build, we are building a boss-killing build, because the Core will always be a Gnome Boss. Use your normal boss-killing build in a different formation if you can’t run both of my builds here comfortably, you can also checkout more boss-killing builds on ik-wiki under Boss Killing Builds.

Camp-clearing build

(1) Build for killing camps Himiko + Zeno + Alexander + Charles. Note, that because this is my main march for PvP this is what works best for me. You can use your Immortals from your main setup with small modifications to obtain similar results.

  • Himiko: Berserk for attack speed. This is needed to get high damage quickly from Alexander and to get Charles to quickly reach max energy and use his shields (because he has Adrenaline Rush, increased attack speed helps here). Annihilation and Concentration are also used on Himiko, because they are the highest damage output in AOE for a magic user.
  • Zenobia: Oaken Guard to reduce the damage taken from enemy normal attacks, Purify for the healing effects (although this is low number value, it is fast and works well given the relatively low damage hits of gnomes). Lastly, we have Misleading here, because we want the gnomes to miss as many attacks as possible to protect our troops and minimize losses.
  • Alexander: Berserker (or anger/wind-rage if you do not have Berserker) for the added damage and attack speed. Combined with Cleave and Death Breath, your Alexander will make quick work of the gnome enemies dealing high and fast AOE damage.
  • Charles: Weakness to tab into as many critical hits as we can, increasing the chance to crit makes a big difference when you Immortals deal this much damage to the enemy you basically wipe the camp with one good crit on Himiko. Blessing of Defense is used to reduce the damage taken, it is brilliant for this kind of encounter because you are going to have the buff active for almost the entire fight (if not the entire fight) given how quickly you will each gnome army in the camp. Finally, Adrenaline Rush is used on Charles to get his shield effects active as quickly as possible. Getting his shield up almost prevents all damage taken from that point onwards.

Core killing build

(2) Build for killing core – boss Fire builds are always amazing for killing bosses, both because of the fire dragon and because of Hippo and Empress Wu. They are amazing single-target damage dealers and vital in this setup. I use Empress Wu + Yoshi + Hippolytta + Khubilaikhan for my boss core killing build.

  • Empress Wu: Poison Thorn for high single-target damage. I would like to use concentration too, but we use that in the gnome camp build and I am building a second team here instead of a new formation. So instead, we use Blessing of War to provide us the damage we need to quickly kill a boss. Lastly, Root is an amazing skill for bosses both because it deals good single-target damage and because it roots the boss making it unable to attack your Immortals during the control effect.
  • Yoshitsune: Anger (or onslaught), Snipe and Duel Master for maximum physical damage to a single target. If you do two formations you can use Adrenaline Rush here for very good effect.
  • Hippolytta: Wind Rage with Combo and Energy Burst. This makes her deal surprisingly high normal attack and combo damage while also giving a good chance to proc critical hits and hence regen energy with Energy Burst. If you run her in a second formation you can do hyper regen builds and you can opt to include weakness in your boss killer formation – perhaps on Khubilai.
  • Khubilai: In this build as a second march, we use Life-Link and Absolute defense. This is a nice combination for bosses to minimize the damage you take. While you are not going to see massive damage from this on these bosses akin to what we see on Spider bosses, you will take a lot fewer losses which is very important since Khubilai will be tanking all normal hits – and Hippolytta’s ultimate ability makes the boss unable to do anything but normal attacks! Neat right? Lastly, I run Blessing of Rage here, because all of our Immortals in this build scale incredibly well with increased energy regen and hence we get a big increase to our damage.

With these builds, I am able to kill Infernal Assault camps and cores at level 43 with very low losses with an avg. troop loss of around 300-350 per fight. Very manageable and hugely rewarding! I hope you enjoyed this guide; good luck farming your billions!

The Infernal Assault event not only encompasses team-based gameplay but also includes individual challenges that allow players to test their skills and prowess on their own. While these missions are intended for solo completion, players are not alone in their journey, as they can seek assistance from alliance friends and other players. One crucial aspect to consider when undertaking the Individual Challenge is the strength of the troops players should deploy. To assist in making informed decisions, we have provided troop power recommendations based on specific levels. It is our hope that these recommendations will aid players in completing the Infernal Assault with maximum rewards while minimizing the loss of troops.

The troop power recommendations for farming are as follows:

  • X – 40,000: Recommended for Under Level 4
  • 40,000 – 80,000: Recommended for Level 4
  • 80,000 – 100,000: Recommended for Level 6
  • 100,000 – 130,000: Recommended for Level 8

These power recommendations correspond to the strength of your strongest troops, taking into account the minimum number of death troops. By aligning your troop power with the recommended levels, you can optimize your performance and increase your chances of success.

You might wonder why there are no power recommendations for levels such as Level 7 or Level 18. The reason for this omission is the significant disparity in troop losses between certain levels. Specifically, there is a notable difference in the number of death troops between Level 6 and Level 5, as well as between Level 19 and Level 20. As a result, we advise players to adhere to the power recommendations outlined in the table above, unless they are willing to surpass those limits in pursuit of additional rewards.

For instance, let’s consider an example. Suppose you have already reached Level 20 but desire to obtain the extra reward offered at Level 21. In order to accomplish this, you must successfully clear the next stage and overcome the challenges it presents.

By following these recommendations and carefully strategizing your troops’ deployment, you can enhance your performance in the Individual Challenge of the Infernal Assault event. html:
Background Story of Infernal Assault

The Infernal Assault event in the popular online game Infinity Kingdom is driven by an intriguing background story that captivates players and sets the stage for an exhilarating gaming experience. The narrative unfolds in a fantastical world where the mischievous Gnomes, notorious for their disruptive behavior, once posed a significant threat. However, following the momentous fall of Harold’s Ice Wall, a pivotal event in the game’s lore, a noticeable decline in Gnome activity was observed.

Yet, the resilient Gnomes refused to be easily deterred. Adapting their tactics in response to previous failures, these cunning creatures showcased newfound intelligence and resourcefulness. No longer content with their traditional approach of heading north for supplies, the Gnomes displayed a remarkable shift in behavior. They began venturing to the front lines, constructing weaponry on-site to further their wicked agenda.

This strategic evolution resulted in the creation of Core Furnaces, instrumental in the Gnomes’ nefarious endeavors. It is imperative to thwart the Gnomes’ progress and put an end to their infernal assault. The fate of the realm hangs in the balance, and players must rise to the challenge, uniting their forces to counter the relentless onslaught of these resilient adversaries.

Special thank you to player Tea who has been kind enough to share much of the information used for this article!

Infernal Assault in General

The Infernal Assault event, available in the immersive world of Infinity Kingdom, offers players an opportunity to engage in a thrilling in-game experience. To participate in the Infernal Assault, players must have been on the server for a minimum of three weeks, unlocking access to this challenging event. Spanning three days, the Infernal Assault demands strategy, teamwork, and skill to emerge victorious.

Once unlocked, the event progresses in a specific order, with players required to complete each round sequentially. The Infernal Assault presents players with a distinct set of defenses, specifically designed for this event, presenting a fresh and exciting challenge. Successful completion of the Infernal Assault rewards players with varying quantities of valuable in-game items, enhancing their progress and providing new opportunities for growth.

Upon conclusion of the event, players have the chance to participate in subsequent iterations of the Infernal Assault on a cyclical basis. By completing the final stage of the event each month, players can continue engaging in this action-packed experience, further refining their skills and reaping greater rewards.

The Infernal Assault is a team-based event that encourages players to coordinate and mobilize their troops to launch an assault on the Gnome camps. The size of the player’s team directly affects the bonuses received, making it advantageous to recruit as many teammates as possible. Having a full team significantly reduces troop losses during the assault, increasing the chances of success. It’s worth noting that individual attacks contribute to the overall progress of the team, but to earn credit for a level, players must reach the last node, known as the furnace.

Advancing through higher-level camps unlocks additional squad slots, allowing players to optimize their benefits by increasing their squad size up to five slots. This strategic choice enhances their chances of success and maximizes the rewards obtained.

To ensure effective coordination, it is recommended that teammates remain in close proximity. This proximity facilitates collaborative attacks, allowing players to assist each other and conserve valuable Action Points (AP). Even if all marches are engaged in resource gathering, players can still contribute by “joining” the team, providing buffs and support. The Infernal Assault does not require every player to initiate individual attacks; as long as the level criteria are met, all players can participate in the rally and contribute to the alliance’s progress.

The Infernal Assault event presents an immersive and cooperative gaming experience, where players must strategize, coordinate, and support each other to overcome the relentless Gnome assault. By triumphing in this epic battle, players not only safeguard their world from chaos but also earn rich rewards.

Event Rewards

The Infernal Assault event offers rewards to both individuals and alliances, further incentivizing players to participate and excel in this challenging endeavor. There are three categories of rewards available:

  1. Gold Farming: This event is the single best method and the only event where you are able to consistently farm gold resource. This makes is an extreemly valuable event and one that you want to prioritize until you have all Immortals and Dragons at max level and rank.
  2. Alliance Rewards: These rewards are distributed based on the accumulation of points earned collectively by the alliance. The more points earned, the greater the rewards bestowed upon the alliance as a whole.
  3. Individual Rewards: To be eligible for individual rewards, players must meet specific requirements. These rewards are tailored to each player and can include valuable items such as philosopher stones, a coveted resource within the game.
  4. Destroying Core Rewards: Destroying the core within the Infernal Assault yields additional rewards. The quality and quantity of these rewards are determined by the level of the Infernal Assault. Higher-level events offer superior rewards, incentivizing players to strive for greater challenges and achievements.

By successfully navigating the Infernal Assault, players have the opportunity to reap substantial rewards, both individually and as part of their alliance. The event not only tests their skills and strategic prowess but also provides a pathway to acquire coveted resources and enhance their progress within the game.

  2. Alliance challenges and methods for AP efficient alliance ranking

Tips: Do you have strong alts? Then you have a big advantage in King of the Hill. Read the detailed descriptions on day 3 and day 5-6 and find out how you will get an easy win.

Stage Ranking Rewards

Overall Ranking Rewards

Claim your spot as King of the Hill

Day 1 – Troops Cooking

Tier 5 soldiers yield a measly 64 points each. This is the most point efficient way to spend universal speedups if you are planning to use these during KoH. Bare in mind tho, you will need to be deleting the troops you train and thus not gain value in the long term, whereas researching technology and upgrading dragons are high value.

With tier 5 barracks training 1 soldier is: 64 points = 5 seconds. I.e. 12.8 points per second.
Research (day 4) is: 480 points / 60 seconds = 8 points per second.

Use the calculator to count your speedups available: https://ik-wiki.com/speedup-calculator/

Day 2 – Gnome camping

Day 3 – Resource Farmvile

This is a simple day: 2 ressource gatheres yields 1 point.

  • Always have gatheres out, and remember to use both gathering buffs and production buffs!
  • You should also make sure not to collect resources from your castles farms on day 2. This way, you can reap capped farms at reset to day 3 and get optimal points from your castles farms.

Pro tip: If you hit another players node (on peaceful server an alt) the ressources collected will count as gathered and therefore yield points towards this stage.

Day 4 – Building and Technology

You will gain 480 points per min. spend on building and/or technology research.

This is not the most efficient way to gain points, but unlike troop training, the value gained is long term.

With tier 5 barracks training 1 soldier is: 64 points = 5 seconds. I.e. 12.8 points per second.
Research (day 4) is: 480 points / 60 seconds = 8 points per second.

Use the calculator to count your speedups available: https://ik-wiki.com/speedup-calculator/

Day 5 and 6 – Kill Event

You gain 25 points per 1 honor point gained during the two-day Kill Event.

During Kill Event days, honor farming is all the rage. To be efficient during these days, you must either have many strong alts or group up with other players on your server. This is because the talent “Rank Advancement”. The absolute no. 1 to gain honor in Infinity Kingdom is to stack high ranked marches in a single castle and hitting them with one strong march and the talent. If you are able to do this right, t5 stacks can earn you as much as 250.000 honor in a single attack.

How to max honor gain

  1. Gather 5 marches (can be from a min of 2 Castles/Lords)
  2. Remove dragons and passives from the marches
  3. Garrison the Target Castle
  4. Assist garrison with 4x marches to the Target Castle from the assisting Lord
  5. Attack with strongest march you can muster and use Rank Advancement

title: Event Overview
description: The Malena Ambition event, which occurs monthly in the Infinity Kingdom, has been the subject of much discussion. In this article, we aim to provide an in-depth look into common mistakes made during the event and what preparation steps should be taken to secure a high score.
html:
The Malena Ambition event, which occurs monthly in the Infinity Kingdom, has been the subject of much discussion. In this article, we aim to provide an in-depth look into common mistakes made during the event and what preparation steps should be taken to secure a high score.

Planning

The most crucial step is to develop a plan and share it in the alliance letter. This feature allows for statistical voting to determine attendance levels. If there are many high-power participants, it’s advisable to defend a high-level city. On the other hand, if the attendance is dominated by low-power participants, a city with a lower level should be chosen. Neglecting to plan and prepare is a common mistake made by many alliances.

Reminding Remind your members by using the alliance calendar, so everyone is aware of the event. This feature can send notifications to alliance members, including via their cell phones.

Common mistakes

Make sure to protect your strong troops by placing them in the city’s garrison. Troops outside the green line’s range can defend the castle within the green circle. Avoid panicking during the invasion of the gnomes.

Basically, if you are inside the green area you must garrison yourself. A good way to kill off invading gnomes with a march that needs to replenish/refill troops often. Your strongest marches can be on the city walls while a march that barely beats the gnomes is more than enough on your castle, it would need constant marching on the walls. Hence you maximize the use of your four marches.

If you want to avoid any incoming attack, place yourself outside the area and just send garrisons to the walls. This works if you are a whale who can take on many incoming attacking without loosing eventually. If you only kill a few gnome armies before loosing and having to march all the way back and forth, it is a waste of time.

But this is a great way to get whales to help even without being online! They can simply sit in safe area having sent garrisons to the walls before logging off.

Alliance Rankings

To score the highest points, it’s important to flawlessly maintain gate defense. Although it may be challenging, the rewards for a successful defense will be significant.

Obtaining Rank 1 in Malena Ambition By following the steps outlined above, your alliance has the potential to rank first in the Malena Ambition event. An easier option is to join a server that is dominated by one alliance.

Power Recommendations

For Low Death Troops in Norheim’s City The following is a statistical report for the recommended power levels to achieve low troop deaths in Norheim’s city.

Level 10: 200,000
Level 11: 230,000
Level 12: 250,000
Level 13: 280,000
Level 14: 320,000
Level 15: 350,000

I hope that this article provides valuable information on how to achieve a top ranking in the Malena Ambition event. The event is a great opportunity to test your alliance’s cohesiveness. To rank first, it requires proper preparation or domination of a server by one alliance.
