title: Malena’s Ambition – Beginners Guide (preperation friendly)
description: Here’s a comprehensive guide to Malena’s Ambition, structured in an engaging and informative way for both new and experienced players. It explains event mechanics, strategies, power level recommendations, and rewards, along with critical tips for maximizing success in the event.
html:
Here’s a comprehensive guide to Malena’s Ambition, structured in an engaging and informative way for both new and experienced players. It explains event mechanics, strategies, power level recommendations, and rewards, along with critical tips for maximizing success in the event.

Comprehensive Guide to Malena’s Ambition

Malena’s Ambition is a PvE-based event in Infinity Kingdom where alliances defend cities from waves of Gnome armies. It’s an excellent opportunity to earn personal and alliance rewards while testing your troop strength and coordination.

This guide will cover:
✔️ How the event works
✔️ How to participate effectively
✔️ Key strategies for new and veteran players
✔️ Optimal troop placement and defense tactics
✔️ Reward breakdown and power recommendations

If this is your first time participating, don’t worry! By the end of this guide, you’ll know exactly what to do to maximize rewards and contribute effectively to your alliance’s defense efforts.

How Malena’s Ambition Works

1. The Basics of the Event

  • Your alliance selects a city to defend against waves of attacking Gnomes.
  • The Gnome waves increase in difficulty as the event progresses.
  • If the city walls fall, you can still continue fighting by defending the garrison pillars inside the city.
  • The event rewards personal contributions and alliance-wide performance, so both individual and teamwork efforts matter.

Complete challenges to gain bonus power against the Gnome invaders as well as a bit of extra rewards.

💡 Tip: The Gnome difficulty scales based on the city’s base level (not the upgraded level). You can check a city’s base level by clicking on it on the map.

How to Participate Effectively

1. Entering the Event & Positioning Yourself

  • You must move either close to or into the event area to participate.
  • If your castle is inside the event area, it will be attacked by the Gnome waves.
  • Lower power players should stay outside the siege circle and send their army to garrison the city walls instead.

💡 Tip: If you can defeat the incoming Gnomes with at least two of your marches, you can safely stay inside the event area and repeatedly garrison the city walls. Otherwise, it’s safer to remain outside and just send reinforcements.

2. Garrisoning & Reinforcing Defenses

  • If you are outside the siege zone: Send troops to garrison the city walls to help repel Gnome waves.
  • If you are inside the siege zone: You can repeatedly garrison the city walls to strengthen defenses and earn extra points. ALWAYS garrison yourself when inside.
  • If the walls fall:
    • Your alliance has NOT lost yet!
    • You can continue defending from the garrison pillars inside the city.
    • If needed, stack everything into one pillar for maximum resistance.

💡 Tip: Even if your city’s outer walls collapse, you still have a chance to earn rewards and hold back Gnome forces from completely overwhelming the city.

Strategic Tips for Maximizing Success

1. Role Assignments Based on Power Levels

  • High-Power Players (Strongest Troops & Marches):
    ✔️ Should be inside the siege zone to garrison city walls and defeat Gnome waves directly.
    ✔️ If the walls fall, they should hold the garrison pillars.
  • Mid-Power Players (Moderate Strength & Good Formations):
    ✔️ Can stay outside the siege zone and reinforce the city walls consistently.
    ✔️ If they can beat Gnome waves with atleast two marches, they should consider being inside the area.
  • Low-Power Players (Weaker Armies & Troops):
    ✔️ Do NOT move inside the siege zone—this will get your castle attacked.
    ✔️ Instead, they should send their armies from outside the siege zone to reinforce the city walls.
    ✔️ Focus on supporting stronger players with constant reinforcements.

💡 Tip: If your alliance is struggling, prioritize reinforcing ONE garrison pillar rather than spreading defenses too thin.

2. Prioritizing Targets & Maximizing Damage

✔️ Coordinate with your alliance—keep checking each square of the wall, ping your alliance to reinforce if one section is weak.
✔️ Save your strongest marches for garrisoning walls and use a march that wins despite larger losses on your own garrison (or stay outside the area).
✔️ Note that there will be gnome bosses in a few major waves, make sure to secure the area with strong marches when you see a boss moving towards the wall section

💡 Tip: If your alliance is losing ground, focus on defending garrison pillars to maximize points and prolong survival.

Rewards & Recommended Power Levels

1. Personal & Alliance Rewards

  • Rewards are given based on individual contribution (damage dealt, troops sent, etc.) and alliance-wide performance.
  • Higher-tier cities give better rewards, but are also more difficult to defend.

Main rewards include:
✔️ Alliance Coins (main reward)
✔️ Speed-Ups
✔️ Gems
✔️ Philosopher stones

💡 Tip: Even if your alliance doesn’t fully defend the city, you’ll still earn valuable rewards, so participation is always worth it. Note alliance coins rewards are based on the amount of gnomes you kill, being the last to garrison a section of the wall means the first to fight incoming gnomes.

2. Power Level Recommendations

These differ greatly based on server progression and city level! In preperation for example: a Level 4 Cities (Low Difficulty) – Recommended **39K+ power per march. **Base Level 7 Cities (Moderate Difficulty) – Recommended 72K+ power per march. However, these recommendations are not entirely honest since they assume you do not have a well-created army. If you have strong builds you can go quite far above the recommended power. Note that Capitals are more dangerous but certainly not impossible if you alliances larger players participate.

The event is easier than most players think in preperation servers and season one. So I would recommend you try one of your higher level cities to begin with. If that is easy for your alliance, move on to your capital. If it is hard and you maybe barely defend in the last pilar, move to a lower level city. But dont go too low, the difficulty drops fast and so does the reward points!

💡 Tip: Check the level of the city before selecting a siege target. You can do this by clicking on the city on the map to see its base stats.

Summary

✔️ Malena’s Ambition is a city defense event where alliances must repel waves of Gnome attackers.
✔️ Lower-power players should stay outside the siege zone and send reinforcements, while stronger players should garrison inside.
✔️ If the city walls fall, you can still fight from the garrison pillars inside the city.
✔️ Rewards are based on personal contributions and alliance performance—so always participate!
✔️ The difficulty scales with the base city level, so check the map before choosing a target.

💡 Final Tip: Always communicate with your alliance to assign roles, coordinate reinforcements, and maximize success.

🔥 Now you’re ready to dominate Malena’s Ambition and earn top rewards! Good luck, and may your defenses hold strong! 🏰⚔️

title: Marchantile Path Event overview
description: Merchantile Path, The latest update patch in the Infinity Kingdom 2.2 patch release. This new event has a unique playstyle unlike any other in Norheim history. Let’s dive into what is up and down here.
html:
Merchantile Path, The latest update patch in the Infinity Kingdom 2.2 patch release. This new event has a unique playstyle unlike any other in Norheim history. Let’s dive into what is up and down here.

“Trade in Norheim is starting to pick back up as humanity wins war after war. Trade caravans transport goods to markets where they are exchanged for valuable commodities. But the cunning Gnome Units have been keeping an eye on these caravans, waiting for their chance to strike and steal the goods. Your goal is to work with your allies to safely protect these caravans to their destination while collecting enormous rewards.“

How to Play Merchantile Path?

1. You can start your own caravan or join one that already exists.

2. Caravans come in three different sizes: small, medium, and giant. The more supplies that can be transported, the more difficult the journey will be, and the more generous the rewards will be when it is successfully completed, the larger the caravan.

What what can I solo? The power suggestions is WAY OFF!

I am able to easily solo a maxed giant caravan with a 300k march and my 150k alt can do Giant caravans with 30 goods without a sweat.

3. You can send your own troops or ask other members to join the journey once a caravan has been setup. This is precisely like throwing a rally with your fellow alliance teammates. Just for defending a Caravan as it travels to a Norheim City Market.

4. Gnomes will be sneaking in and stealing the supplies from the caravan. It is your job to make sure they are killed upon approach! Protect the caravan goods at all costs 😉

5. You must eliminate the gnomes that continously attack the caravan. The supplies from the caravan will be lost, and your reward will be reduced, if you lose the battle. The expedition will fail if all of the supplies are stolen.

What is the Rewards?

The content of the rewards available varies depending on the size of the caravan and the amount of resources protected. After successfully exploring a caravan, the caravan organizer will receive an exploring reward based on the amount of supplies left in the caravan, and an assisted explorer reward based on the percentage of damage done to Gnomes by the alliance member(s).

The rewards are:

(1) Materials for crafting Artifacts. These are earned every time you complete a caravan escort event.

(2) Gems and Philosophers Stones. These are by far the most important things to get from this event, since purple stones are our primary ressource for combat strength (until we max all ToK skills). Unfortunately, the ranking is not working in my server so I cannot tell you how the ranking works. If anyone know please do reach out 🙂

html:
🎉 Infinity Kingdom Guide: Summer Party Event 2025 – How to Get the Green Typhoon Frame & More!

🌴 Introduction: Welcome to the Summer Party!

Infinity Kingdom just kicked off a brand-new mini-event called the Summer Party, a charming little event designed as a prelude to the much-anticipated Summer Harvest Festival and the upcoming C60 update. It features a unique reward, the new Green Typhoon Frame, along with easy quests, insightful summaries of your progress, and incentives for returning players.

This quick guide will explain everything you need to know, from getting that sought-after Green Typhoon Frame to understanding each element of this fun-filled mini-event!

💚 How to Obtain the Green Typhoon Frame

The most common question since the event started has been:

“How do I get the new Green Typhoon Frame?“

Here’s the simple answer:

  • Open the event panel and navigate to the “Mid-Year Review.”
  • Click through the interactive summary of your Infinity Kingdom journey this year.
  • At the end of the review, you’ll find a claim button.
  • Click this button to immediately receive your Green Typhoon Frame!

It’s really that simple!

TL;DR:

  • Go to Mid-Year Review → Scroll to the final page → Click claim → Enjoy your Green Typhoon Frame!

📜 Mid-Year Review: Celebrate Your Journey!

The Mid-Year Review provides a personalized overview of your achievements in Infinity Kingdom from the past months, including:

  • Logins
  • Enemies killed
  • Nemisis enemy
  • Best friend
  • Favorite Skin

It’s an enjoyable snapshot of your progress and a nice way to look back on how far you’ve come.

Why it Matters:
While mostly just a fun feature, this is also where you obtain your exclusive Green Typhoon Frame, a fantastic cosmetic reward.

🎖️ Quests and Rewards

The Summer Party event includes a set of easy-to-complete quests providing some great little bonuses for playing as usual.

Free Quest Tier Rewards:

Complete various simple tasks like training troops, logging in daily, defeating gnomes, and gathering resources to earn rewards such as:

  • Philosopher stones
  • Gems
  • Speedups
  • Resource chests

These quests are straightforward and require no extra effort beyond daily gameplay.

Paid Quest Tier (Spender Rewards):

If you choose to spend money on bundles during the event, you can unlock additional valuable rewards, including:

  • Random Epic Immortal Fragments
  • Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments

These paid rewards are excellent for players looking to accelerate their immortal upgrades.

Why it Matters:
Free-to-play players get easy resources for minimal effort, while spenders earn valuable immortal fragments, making it beneficial for all player types.

TL;DR:

  • Free: Complete easy tasks → Philosopher stones, gems, speedups.
  • Paid: Purchase bundles → Earn additional rare immortal fragments.

🎁 Returning Player Invite Codes

Another cool new feature is the Returning Player Gift Code system: My Invitation Code: 3CKG3M

  • Current players can generate unique gift codes to invite friends who stopped playing Infinity Kingdom.
  • Returning players who use these codes receive immediate rewards upon logging back in.
  • This helps players reconnect, and it encourages old friends to come back to the game.

Why it Matters:
It’s a nice incentive to re-engage your alliance members or friends who’ve gone inactive—making your server stronger and more active for upcoming events and battles.

🎯 Event Summary & Why It Matters

The Summer Party event serves as an enjoyable warm-up for the upcoming major events (Harvest Festival, C60 Update). It is:

  • Easy to participate in and offers a variety of immediate rewards.
  • An excellent opportunity for free resources and valuable fragments.
  • A way to earn an exclusive cosmetic item (Green Typhoon Frame).
  • Perfect for reconnecting with inactive friends, strengthening alliances, and boosting server activity.

🚩 TL;DR Quick Overview

  • Green Typhoon Frame: Found at the end of your Mid-Year Review (claim at the final page).
  • Quests & Rewards: Simple gameplay tasks → free rewards (gems, stones). Spending → bonus fragments.
  • Returning Players: Invite old friends using codes for mutual rewards.

🥳 A Fun Prelude to Bigger Events!

The Summer Party event might be small, but it adds excitement and valuable rewards leading into the major events coming soon—especially the big Castle Level 60 (C60) update and the Harvest Festival. Take advantage of this easy opportunity to earn valuable resources, reconnect with old allies, and claim the exclusive Green Typhoon Frame to show off your dedication!

🌞 What We’re Waiting For – The Grand Annual Update

The Summer Party event isn’t just another mini-event; it’s the precursor to Infinity Kingdom’s biggest update of the year! On August 7th, players can dive into the much-anticipated version 2.8.6, featuring game-changing additions that will reshape the landscape of Norheim.

🚀 Level Cap Raised to 60

One of the most exciting announcements is the increase of the maximum castle level from 55 to 60. This is no small upgrade—it means entirely new troop tiers, upgraded buildings, more powerful technologies, and a fresh sense of progression and challenge. Players who’ve been patiently sitting at level 55 will finally have a whole new journey to embark on!

⚔️ New Immortals and Skills

A higher level cap means new immortals and unique skills are coming into play. Players can look forward to creating innovative strategies and team compositions as these new immortals shake up the existing meta. Each new immortal will offer distinct mechanics and playstyles, giving both veterans and newcomers something fresh to explore and master.

👹 Powerful New Bosses

Infinity Kingdom’s new version also brings powerful new bosses to challenge. PvE enthusiasts and damage specialists who enjoy competing for the highest single-hit records are especially excited. New boss encounters offer not only additional in-game rewards but also fresh opportunities to demonstrate your strategic depth, immortal synergies, and mastery of game mechanics.

🎁 Random Equipment Drops & New Systems

With this update, equipment progression is receiving a significant upgrade. Equipment will now be available as random drops, likely from powerful PvE enemies or bosses. This will provide players an alternative pathway to power without solely relying on resource-intensive forging. New optimization features and quality-of-life improvements will also debut, enhancing the overall player experience.

🎉 Summer Party Event – Celebrating the Coming Expansion

The Summer Party event serves as a joyful bridge to these highly anticipated updates. By joining the festivities, players not only get immediate in-game rewards—such as the stylish Green Typhoon Frame—but also a great opportunity to prepare and build momentum ahead of the major expansion release.

🎯 Event Activities

  • Mid-Year Review: Explore your accomplishments and game journey throughout the year. Simply navigate through your personal mid-year review to earn the new exclusive frame.
  • Daily Quests and Rewards: Completing simple daily tasks grants you useful items like Philosopher’s Stones, random immortal fragments, and speedups. While casual in nature, these rewards are beneficial for preparation ahead of the major update.
  • Returning Player Incentives: A dedicated feature allowing active players to create unique invitation codes to welcome back friends. Both parties receive rewards, making it the perfect time to reconnect and rally your alliance for the coming update.

💬 Community Contests and Engagement

Infinity Kingdom’s development team is actively engaging with players through social media and in-game feedback initiatives:

  • Patch Notes Reading Conference: Share detailed insights or feedback on new skills and features to win special prizes.
  • Facebook Community Contest: A community-driven event offering participants a chance at free gems and raffle tickets by simply sharing their excitement and ideas about the upcoming update.

Link to Facebook

Running from August 4–10, this contest encourages players to express their excitement for the update, discuss their favorite upcoming features, and even suggest future additions to the game. Twenty lucky participants will receive gems and raffle tickets as appreciation for their valuable input.

In essence, the Summer Party serves as the perfect bridge between anticipation and arrival. Players can engage in fun, casual gameplay while voicing their opinions and getting hyped for one of Infinity Kingdom’s largest and most exciting updates yet.

Enjoy the Summer Party, and prepare yourselves for what’s next in Infinity Kingdom!

title: The Icon, Day of Gratitude and Starlight Tribute mini event (november 2025)
description: Day of Gratitude & Starlight Tribute Mini Event Guide – (aka the “Icon & Thanksgiving Mini Event”)
html:
Day of Gratitude & Starlight Tribute Mini Event Guide – (aka the “Icon & Thanksgiving Mini Event”)

Introduction

So this mini-event is basically IK’s seasonal Thanksgiving celebration, and it’s split into three parts: missions that give you “Exchange Coins,” the big Icon Vote contest, and a set of returner/inviter rewards tied to GTarcade’s backend system. If you’ve played any of the previous IK holiday mini-events, the structure will feel familiar — but this one’s definitely more community-focused than usual.

You’ll also notice they added a small “Relive Your Saga” feature that gives you a neat little history certificate and some freebies. It’s not as deep as past versions, but hey, free rewards are always awesome!

Event runs: November 24, 2025 → December 1, 2025 (00:00 UTC)
So don’t wait too long to claim or exchange coins — IK does wipe unclaimed stuff at the end.

Accession the event through the in-game button:

Event Breakdown

1. Missions & Exchange Coins

The basic loop is simple: do missions → earn Exchange Coins → redeem them for cosmetics or upgrade materials. Most missions are F2P-friendly, but they definitely sprinkled in spender tasks that line up with Black Friday.

Honestly, the Exchange Shop isn’t the strongest one we’ve seen — the costs feel a bit steep. But the mission path itself is easy enough to clear daily if you’re even semi-active.

2. The Icon Vote (The Heart of the Event)

So this is the fun social part. IK picked 10 community candidates based on server impact and contributions, and each one has a short story you can read on the event page. Seriously — read them. A bunch of players put real heart into those and they are all very good! I know it means quite a lot for me to be in there for the competition of IK-Icon, and I am sure it does for the others too. I encourage you to read them all and vote for whoever you find has the best story!

Change note: I was in there as Charizard (server joke name) when writing this, but if you are reading this on the 28th or after, they have updated me to Myrahk.

How it works:

  • Vote once per day from Nov 24 to Dec 1.
  • Every vote gives you 1 Exchange Coin.
  • No “right” choice — literally vote for whoever resonates with you.

Rewards for the top 3 Icons:
This is actually pretty huge compared to past mini-events:

  • Hall of Fame Quote on the loading screen
  • Territory Patrol NPC across all players’ maps for one month
  • Official Interview and feature via community channels

So yeah, it’s a cool way to support them!

3. Grateful Gift → GTarcade Store

This tab basically routes you to GTarcade to buy bundles. Since Black Friday hits mid-event, the timing is… well, exactly what you’d expect.

If you’re a spender, you’ll probably get natural progression on several of the mission tasks anyway — good synergy.

4. “Relive Your Saga” – Small Bonus Reward Page

This is tucked at the bottom of the Reward Redemption page. It shows your starting date and generates a little certificate. It’s kinda stripped down compared to the older anniversary mini-features, but there’s a free gift. For me that was:

  • 3x Philosopher Stones
  • 200 Gems
  • 81 Market Refreshes

Not mind-blowing, but definitely worth clicking!

Returner & Inviter Event Details

Who counts as a returner?

  • Must have not logged in since Oct 31, 2025 (00:00 UTC)
  • Must be Castle Level 15+

What they get:

After entering your invitation code, returners receive:

  • Miraculous Descent x1
  • Philosopher’s Stone x9
  • Superior Resource Chest x10
  • Speedy Construction x5

Good chunk for someone jumping back in.

What YOU get for inviting:

This is split into three milestones:

Invite 1 returner:

  • 9 Philosopher Stones
  • 10 Stardust
  • 10 Random Immortal Fragments

Invite 5 returners:

  • 1 Uncommon Dragon Crystal Selection Chest
  • 20 Stardust
  • 20 Random Immortal Fragments

Invite 10 returners:

  • 30 Stardust
  • 1 Miraculous Descent
  • 30 Random Immortal Fragments

Everything gets mailed to you in-game. Just don’t forget to claim before the event expires — IK does purge leftover progress.

Reward Redemption – What’s Actually Worth Getting

Alright, so the shop has a mix of cosmetics and progression items. Opinions incoming.

Cosmetics

  • King’s Feast Castle Skin – 30 coins
  • Turkey Frenzy Avatar Frame

If you’re into matching your city with the holiday vibe, go for it. IK doesn’t throw these skins around often.

Progression Items

  • Token of Lights
  • AP / SP bottles
  • Stardust / Crimson Moonlights if you need them bad.
  • Epic Dragon Crystal Selection Chest

Here’s the take from someone who burns AP like crazy:

AP & SP Bottles → top priority if you’re pushing gold farming or trying to climb Boost Levels. AP farming weekends hit hard, and I never feel like I have enough SP when trying to hit late-tier boost levels on immortals (SP if your main isnt max yet).

Stardust → expensive at 15 coins for 15. But if you’re a someone who did not have the opportunity to use the Stardust Wheel event to bank Stardust, then this is a way to get some atleast.

Token of Lights → worth grabbing. These become lottery tickets when the next seasonal rolls in, and I’ve gotten lucky with big pulls in the past (not often… but it happens).

My(rahk’s) perspective

So if it were me playing this event right now:

  • I’d hit the missions if not just for the AP/SP value.
  • I wouldn’t chase cosmetics unless I was feeling festive — they’re nice, but Exchange Coins are tight.
  • AP is king for farming infernal gold, and I have yet to regret hoarding SP—Boost Level pushes soak it up like crazy.
  • Token of Lights are “future me” items, but I always try to grab at least a few just in case the next seasonal jackpot is spicy.
  • For the Icon Vote, I’d genuinely read all 10 stories carefully and go with your heart whatever that may be!

description: Navigating the Primal Pinball Event in Infinity Kingdom
html:
Navigating the Primal Pinball Event in Infinity Kingdom

The Primal Pinball event in Infinity Kingdom is an exclusive opportunity for players, especially big spenders, to accumulate valuable resources for upgrading portrait levels on Chaos Immortals. This guide aims to provide an overview of the event mechanics, the significance of Crimson Moonlights and Stardust, and strategic advice on maximizing your returns from the event.

Event Overview

To participate in the Primal Pinball event, players need Pearls of Finding, which are purchasable in the game shop. The primary rewards from this event are Crimson Moonlights and Stardust, essential for upgrading portrait levels and enhancing the power and appearance of your Chaos Immortals.

Crimson Moonlights and Stardust

  • Crimson Moonlights: These are premium items used specifically for upgrading portrait levels on Chaos Immortals, increasing their stats and overall effectiveness in battles.
  • Stardust: This resource is also used for enhancing portrait levels, although it might serve a more general purpose across different types of immortals or in-game enhancements.

Event Mechanics and Chances

The Primal Pinball event offers a variety of rewards with different probabilities:

  • Yellow Tier 4 Rewards: There’s a 5% chance to land on this tier, rewarding players with 4x Crimson Moonlights. Given this probability, on average, you would need 500 Pearls to obtain 100 Crimson Moonlights.
  • Stardust Fields: These have a slightly higher chance of 6.8% for players to land on, providing another avenue to gather essential resources.

Strategic Spending for Maximum Efficiency

Given the structure of bundle prices and the probabilities for obtaining rewards, strategic investment is crucial:

  • The $5 bundle provides exceptional value, offering 3.6 Pearls per dollar, making it the most cost-efficient option.
  • The value decreases with higher-priced bundles, with the $15 bundle yielding 2 Pearls per dollar, and further diminishing returns for the $30 bundle and beyond.

For those playing the long game and focusing on efficiency, combining the $5 and $15 bundles for a total of $30 provides 48 Pearls, equating to roughly 10 Crimson Moonlights.

Conclusion

The Primal Pinball event is a long and potentially expensive endeavor tailored towards players willing to invest significantly to enhance their Chaos Immortals. The key to maximizing your investment lies in strategic spending, focusing on the more cost-effective bundles to gather Pearls of Finding. While the event offers a path to obtaining valuable Crimson Moonlights and Stardust, players should approach with a plan for resource allocation to ensure the best return on their investment in upgrading portrait levels. Remember, patience and strategic planning are essential in navigating the cost-intensive landscape of the Primal Pinball event.

html:
Rebel Tracks is one of the few very important events for everyone to participate in. Spenders and F2P alike want to take part to reap the excellent rewards that this event has to offer. In this guide we are going to have a look at the overview of the event, what are the rewards, how does the event work, what should I do and how do you best setup Rebel events togeather with your alliance for maximum effiency and rewards for everyone.

Rebel Rewards

To begin with, let us take a look at the rewards of this event. The reward caps are very easy to get as a group in organized alliances but can be a bit of a pain if you are flying solo.. which I mean, don’t fly solo.. anyway!

There are three different reward types we care about from this event:

(1) Exp. Scrolls. These are quite good, as you do need a fair bit of experiance in order to maintain 4 x 3 Immortals at max level.

(2) Soul Crystals (purple crystals). These are very very very important! You need A TON of Purple crystals in order to max three Tower of Knowledge skills / passives on all four Immortals in all three marches. That’s a grand total of 3 x 4 x 3 = 36 ToK skills as a minimum. Seeing as just 1 ToK Epic skill costs you 163K crystals to max, it is fair to say you need every single crystal you can get!

(3) Sun Crystals and Empowered Sun Crystals. Another very solid reward. In fact, this event only have good rewards!

We need quite a lot of Sun Crystals as well as Empowered Sun Crystals in order to upgrade the Artifacts of all our many Immortals. It costs you 40 Sun Crystals to upgrade a single Artifact (unique or norm. same cost) from Bronze Quality to Silver Quality rewarding a massive attribute boost.

Furthermore, you need another 40 Empowered Sun Crystals in order to finish your artifact upgrading it from Silver Quality to Gold Quality – again you gain a massive increase by doing so.

How does it work?

Okay, so it is pretty clear that this even is bloody awesome! You are going to want to max out the rewards from this event every single opportunity you have. Don’t miss this event! But how exactly does it work?

The Rewards are unlocked by completing the Event Rewards Point Bar. As you kill Rebel Camps you are rewarded with Points (stars coins). Once you have collected 300 you unlock rewards chest one, 500 = the second chest, etc. Completing the entire event requires 1500 Points.

You obtain points by killing Rebel Camps or being part of a Rally that kills a Rebel Camp. A Rebel Camp level 7 rewards you 70 points. Camp level 5 rewards 50 points, lvl 6 = 60 points, etc.

Killing Rebel Camps

First things first, you need to collect Rebel Camp quest items in order to spawn these rebel camps. These items are dropped by Gnomes level 8 and above.

The higher the level of the Gnome Camp (either of the three types) = the higher the level of your Rebel Camp item and thus more Rebel points.

Find a comfortable level where you take minimal losses and do A LOT instead. It is far better to run both more gnomes and more rebel camps than fighting against enemies that force large troop losses upon you.

You must be able to kill it easily in one blow, so other players can join your rally with their fourth troop and get the rewards without ever fighting a rebel.

You should always complete this event togeather with atleast a group of 5 players total. Preferably, setup alliance wide events with massive hives. Spread out slightly to make room for Spawning Rebel Camps and go nuts cooperating!

html:
Introduction

Rebel Tracks has been reworked in patch 2.8.9, but the basics remain the same. The Rebel Tracks event is a recurring feature in Infinity Kingdom that offers players the opportunity to earn valuable rewards by engaging in coordinated alliance activities. By defeating Gnomes and rallying against Rebel Camps, players can accumulate points and resources essential for progression.

Instead of rewards through fixed event chests, the event is now tied to a new currency that you can spend in a dedicated shop.

Rebel Tracks Basics

Rebel Tracks is essentially a progression bar linked to fighting Rebel Camps (the gnome camps on the map). As you clear camps and earn event points, you unlock a series of chests along the track.

Key points from the rework:

  • The event now gives five main chests along the Rebel Tracks progression.
  • Instead of directly dropping Sun Crystals or Empowered Sun Crystals, these chests now give Ancient Gold.
  • Ancient Gold is a special event currency used in the new Gold Trade shop.

If you reach the final milestone on the track, and open all five chests, you’ll have enough Ancient Gold to buy out every item in the Gold Trade shop for that cycle of the event.

So, in simple terms:
Do the full track → get all chests → get enough Ancient Gold → clear the entire shop.

Event Mechanics

1. Obtaining Rebel Sigils

  • Defeating Gnomes: Engage in battles against Gnomes to acquire Rebel Sigils. These sigils are necessary to summon Rebel Camps.

2. Summoning Rebel Camps

  • Using Rebel Sigils: Each sigil corresponds to a specific Rebel Camp level, ranging from 4 to 7. Higher-level Gnomes drop higher-level sigils, leading to more challenging camps.

3. Rallying Rebel Camps

  • Alliance Cooperation: Coordinate with your alliance to rally against summoned Rebel Camps. A full rally team can consist of up to five players, and it’s crucial to include as many members as possible to maximize rewards.

Gold Trade Shop

What It Is

The Gold Trade shop is an extension of Rebel Tracks. Instead of relying on getting rewards from chests, the game now gives you a fixed event currency (Ancient Gold) and lets you choose what to buy. This way, you can get some goods you want without completing the entire event if you are struggling to do so. Makes the event more beginner friendly and low-stp friendly. That being said, you should always strive to complete the entire thing and clear out the event.

From the information we have, the Gold Trade shop can include:

  • Sun Crystals
  • Empowered Sun Crystals (available in conquest)
  • Unique Artifact Chest for seasonal selection
  • Unique Artifact Chest for elemental selection

The rewards of this event scale with seasonal progress. Hence, rewards gets better and better as your server progress maintaining the high relevance and quality of the event. It is a must do for all seasons. Read more here.

Is it a good event then?

All in all very good rewards and a good upgrade from the previous version as we collect more good stuff in this new reworked version with the artifacts. Very nice!

The new structure also changes how realistic it is to advance artefacts without heavy spending.

  • Clearing Rebel Tracks events gives you the upgrade materials to empower an artefact from normal → silver → gold just via this event.

So if you stick with it and consistently finish all points and buy everything: This is huge for accounts that previously stalled out at lower artefact tiers because of limited crystal access and likewise for accounts that have struggles to get unique artifacts due to pay-to-play barriers.

Impact on Immortals & Team Variety

Before this rework, exclusive Immortal artefacts were often effectively paywalled. You could get the Immortal itself, but the artefact was where a lot of the power and identity lived, and those were much harder to obtain or upgrade without spending.

With the new Rebel Tracks + Gold Trade setup:

  • More players can realistically aim for artefacts of Immortals that used to be “whale-only.”
  • You’re likely to see more variety in marches, not just the same few meta combos.

Examples, likely to become more popular with better artefact access include:

  • Margaret
  • Darius
  • Cao Cao
  • Ragnar

Basically, now that artefacts are more grindable, a lot of Immortals that were “almost good” become actually viable once you can pick up and build their artefact properly.

From a game health point of view, this is great, because field fights and arena matches no longer look so copy-paste.

Difficulty & Team Play

One thing to keep in mind: higher-level Rebel Camps still hurt.

  • Max level Rebel Camps in particular can be tough.
  • Your Immortals can get timed out or just take heavy damage from the gnomes.
  • Some players simply won’t be able to solo the higher-level camps consistently.

The recommended approach is to:

  • Coordinate with your alliance.
  • Create a hive or shared area where people spawn and hit Rebel Camps together.
  • If you can’t spawn your own or can’t clear your own, join your guildmates on theirs.

Grinding Rebel Tracks with friends is not just more efficient, it’s also safer for your marches and a lot less frustrating than wiping on level 11 alone over and over.

Player Perspective

If we look at it from a player’s point of view, not just raw mechanics:

  • This event went from “nice, but limited” to “almost mandatory” if you care about artefacts.
  • The guaranteed crystals + artefact options make Rebel Tracks one of the better recurring events for free-to-play and light spenders.
  • It also indirectly supports creativity in team-building, because more people can actually finish artefacts for non-standard Immortals.

If it were me, I’d:

  • Treat Rebel Tracks as a must-clear whenever it shows up.
  • Make sure to hit 2,550 points every cycle so I can buy the entire Gold Trade shop.
  • Use the event to slowly push an important artefact all the way to gold over four runs.
  • Team up with alliance members for the higher-level Rebel Camps instead of wasting stamina and time wiping solo.

Conclusion

The Rebel Camps rework into Rebel Tracks + Gold Trade is one of the most free-to-play–friendly changes in recent Infinity Kingdom updates.

To recap:

  • Rebel Tracks now gives Ancient Gold instead of direct crystal drops.
  • Ancient Gold is spent in the Gold Trade shop, where you can buy:
    • At least 10 Sun Crystals
    • At least 10 Empowered Sun Crystals
    • Plus Artefact Chest and Exclusive Artefact options
  • Clearing the full track (2,550 points) lets you buy everything in the shop each event.
  • Doing the event four times can take an artefact from normal → silver → gold just from this source.
  • High-level Rebel Camps can be tough, but doing them with alliance members solves most of the difficulty.

Bottom line:
If you care at all about artefacts or long-term account growth, Rebel Tracks is a grind you really shouldn’t skip.

title: Sparks of Galaxy 101
description: In this guide we are going to have a closer look at a new event called “Sparks of Galaxy”. In this event, you are able to spend both gems and purchase bundles in order to earn Frosty Orbs which you in turn use to unlock strong rewards.
html:
In this guide we are going to have a closer look at a new event called “Sparks of Galaxy”. In this event, you are able to spend both gems and purchase bundles in order to earn Frosty Orbs which you in turn use to unlock strong rewards.

This event is quite special and in my opinion an awesome event because it offers rewards which has previously been very expensive, for mid-spenders! Yes, you heard correct. In this first itteration we are looking at shadow Immortals and Unique Artifacts available for gems and low-cost bundles! This means that more players will be able to afford and access (heck, even slow grind) shadow Immortals and their unique artifacts via this event. You do not have to participate in the expensive Triss Roulette and Theia’s Roulette anymore!

Event rewards

In the first itteration of this event we are able to reap in Siegfried and Himiko Immortal fragments, as well as Unique Artifact fragments for these two Immortals. In addition, we are able to get Shadow Dragon Crystals and a solid pile of Philosopher stones in the process!

How does it work?

title: Sparks of Galaxy Updated (written 2.8.7)
description: The Sparks of Galaxy event is one of the main ways to obtain rare Immortal fragments and Artifact fragments for Shadow and Holy immortals. It’s structured like a gacha draw with pity, meaning you spend draws on a prize pool that includes Immortal fragments, Artifact fragments, Dragon Essences, and D
html:
The Sparks of Galaxy event is one of the main ways to obtain rare Immortal fragments and Artifact fragments for Shadow and Holy immortals. It’s structured like a gacha draw with pity, meaning you spend draws on a prize pool that includes Immortal fragments, Artifact fragments, Dragon Essences, and Dragon Crystals. There is also a pity system, which guarantees Immortal fragment drops if you go too long without one (100 draws).

This guide covers the event mechanics, drop rates, pricing breakdowns, and practical plans for targeting both Immortal and Artifact fragments efficiently.

Event Mechanics

  • Each draw has a chance to give a reward from the pool:
    • Immortal Fragments (10x): 4 slots at 1.30% each → 5.2% total chance
    • Artifact Fragments (5x): 3 slots at 1.20% each → 3.6% total chance
    • Dragon Essence (1x): 2 slots at 17% each → 34% total chance
    • Dragon Crystal Chests (10x): 28% chance
  • Pity rule: If you go 100 pulls without an Immortal fragment, the next pull is guaranteed to give one (10 frags). Pity resets after each Immortal fragment drop.
  • No pity for Artifact fragments.
  • Rewards are selection chests for Shadow/Holy Immortals or Artifacts, so duplicates aren’t a risk.

Drop Math & Expectations

Immortal Fragments

  • We get 10x Immortal frags per hit.
  • Chance per pull = 5.2%.
  • To reach 60 frags (6 hits):
    • Expected pulls: ~115
    • Median: ~109 pulls
    • 95% certainty: ~197 pulls
  • Thanks to pity, bad luck is capped, but given the decent drop rate we are not going to run into pity very often. That being said, it will happen and it does reduce the average expected a bit.

Artifact Fragments

  • Need 5x Artifact frags per hit.
  • Chance per pull = 3.6%.
  • To reach 60 frags (12 hits):
    • Expected pulls: ~333
    • Median: ~324 pulls
    • 95% certainty: ~500 pulls
  • No pity = much wider variance.
  • Artifact frags are harder to obtain than immortal fragments, which is standard in these events. Given you need 4750 immortal fragments to max out an immortal and only 900 artifact fragments (assuming good craft roll within the standard 15 to max) it is not as bad as it looks initially. But you are on average getting the 15 artifacts = 1 max in 4995 pulls on average whereas you need 9104 draws to get the total 4750 immortal fragments needed for a max + talents.

Pricing Breakdown

You can buy pulls through cash packs or with gems.

Pack Options (per event stock)

  • $1 → 5 pulls ×12 = 60 pulls → $12 total → $0.20/pull
  • $2 → 10 pulls ×10 = 100 pulls → $20 total → $0.20/pull
  • $5 → 18 pulls ×8 = 144 pulls → $40 total → $0.2778/pull
  • $10 → 24 pulls ×6 = 144 pulls → $60 total → $0.4167/pull
  • $15 → 32 pulls ×5 = 160 pulls → $75 total → $0.4688/pull
  • $30 → 40 pulls ×2 = 80 pulls → $60 total → $0.75/pull
  • $50 → 50 pulls ×1 = 50 pulls → $50 total → $1.00/pull
  • All bundles combined: 738 pulls for $317 → $0.43/pull average

Strategies depending on your spending level, the more time you have the cheaper you can get it!

Three clean routes to farm ~1020 Immortal fragments from the draw event

Quick baseline:

  • Immortal frags = 10 per hit, hit rate 5.2% per pull, with a 100-pull pity that forces an Immortal frag if you haven’t hit one yet.
  • To reach ~1020 frags you need ~102 hits → expected ~1,962 pulls. Pity mostly just trims bad-luck streaks; the mean stays about the same over this many pulls.
  • For these strategies or plans, we are going to be doing three different versions. In plan A we are using only the cheapest 1 and 2 dollar bundles. This will be most efficient (see below) but also take more time given the stock caps. In Plan B we are including the slighly less efficient but still very good value 5$ bundle and for Plan C we are going fast and getting the 10 and 15 dollar bundles too.
  • Bundle reminder:
    • $1: 12× (5 pulls each) → 60 pulls total → $12 → $0.20/pull
    • $2: 10× (10 pulls each) → 100 pulls total → $20 → $0.20/pull
    • $5: 8× (18 pulls each) → 144 pulls total → $40 → $0.2778/pull
    • $10: 6× (24 pulls each) → 144 pulls total → $60 → $0.4167/pull
    • $15: 5× (32 pulls each) → 160 pulls total → $75 → $0.4688/pull

Plan A — Cheapest money (only $1 + $2 packs)

This is the budget grinder. You buy only the cheapest packs and accept more events.

  • Pulls per event: 60 + 100 = 160 pulls for $32
  • Target pulls: ~1,962
  • 12 full events = 12 × 160 = 1,920 pulls → $384
  • Remainder since we are a bit short on draws (unles you got lucky): 1,962 − 1,920 = 42 pulls needed –> Grab 4× $2 (40 pulls, $8) + 1× $1 (5 pulls, $1) → 45 pulls for $9.
  • Total Plan A: ~1,965 pulls i.e. 1020 immortal fragments for a price of $393 over the course of ~13 events (12 full + a tiny top-up in the 13th)

This is the best $/pull you can get. It just takes the longest.

Plan B — Fewer events (add $5 packs)

Here you still keep things pretty efficient, but you finish way faster.

  • Pulls per event: ($1+$2+$5) = 60 + 100 + 144 = 304 pulls for $72
  • 6 full events = 6 × 304 = 1,824 pulls → $432
  • Remainder: 1,962 − 1,824 = 138 pulls
    • Cheapest way to finish (still only using 1/2/5): 12× $1 (60 pulls, $12) + 8× $2 (80 pulls, $16) → 140 pulls for $28
  • Total Plan B: ~1,964 pulls, i.e. 1020 immortal fragments for a price of $460 over the course of ~7 events (6 full + a small top-up)

This is the sweet spot if you value time without burning money on the worse-value packs.

Plan C — Fastest timeline (also buy $10 + $15)

Now we throw in the $10 and $15 bundles to compress the event count further.

  • Pulls per event: ($1+$2+$5+$10+$15) = 60 + 100 + 144 + 144 + 160 = 608 pulls for $207
  • 3 full events = 3 × 608 = 1,824 pulls → $621
  • Remainder: 1,962 − 1,824 = 138 pulls
    • Cheapest top-up: 12× $1 (60, $12) + 8× $2 (80, $16) → 140 pulls for $28
  • Total Plan C: ~1,964 pulls (1020 immortal frags) for the price of $649 so quite expensive, but done in just ~4 events (3 full + a small top-up)

You’re paying for speed here. It’s noticeably more expensive than Plan B, but you’re done in roughly half the events of Plan A.

Gems-only comparison

Pricing of rewards, as you can expect if you are using only Gems

  • 5 pulls = 1000 gems → 200 gems per pull
  • 115 pulls (60 Imm frags) ≈ 23,000 gems
  • 334 pulls (60 Art frags) ≈ 67,000 gems
  • 1020 immortal fragments for comparison, i.e. ~1,965 pulls → ~393,000 gems

What I’d do (player perspective)

  • If you’re patient and care about value: Plan A. It’s the cheapest by far (~$393) but you’re in for ~13 events.
  • If you want a good balance: Plan B. This is my preferred route: ~$460 and ~7 events.
  • If you just want it done fast: Plan C. You’ll likely wrap in ~4 events for ~$649.

Small tip: because pity triggers every 100 “no-hit” pulls, over a 2k-pull grind the variance is low. You don’t need a huge extra buffer—just don’t cut it to the exact pull on your last event (buy +20–40 extra pulls if you’re paranoid).

Conclusion

  • Always buy the $1 and $2 packs — they’re the best value in the event.
  • If you’re patient, Plan A (just $1 + $2) is the best long-term strategy.
  • If you want speed, add $5 packs for a balanced Plan B. Only go to $10/$15 if you want to finish in very few events.
  • Gemming this event is expensive — only use if you have excess saved.
  • Don’t be afraid of the pity system — failing pulls aren’t wasted since pity forces progress.
  • Over long grinds (like 1k+ frags), variance smooths out and your average pulls will line up close to the math.

Sparks of Galaxy is a high-value but expensive event, offering one of the few reliable paths to Shadow/Holy Immortal and Artifact fragments.

title: Childrens’ Day 2025 (v2.8.4)
description: Infinity Kingdom’s Children’s Day Event has officially gone live, bringing 10 days of activities, rewards, and for the first time ever — an upgradable castle skin: Sky River Palace. This guide will break down everything you need to know: what to do daily, where the value is, how the ranking system w
html:
Infinity Kingdom’s Children’s Day Event has officially gone live, bringing 10 days of activities, rewards, and for the first time ever — an upgradable castle skin: Sky River Palace. This guide will break down everything you need to know: what to do daily, where the value is, how the ranking system works, and strategic tips for free-to-play (F2P), low spenders, and whales.

Event Duration and Structure

  • Length: 10 days (June 11–21)
  • Daily Claim: Same reward each day; don’t forget to log in and claim.
  • Repeat Format: Similar structure to recent seasonal events, with resonance crystals, mini-challenges, and exclusive skins.

Sky River Palace – The First Upgradable Castle Skin

This is the headline reward. Unlike previous skins, Sky River Palace can be upgraded.

Stats:

  • Level 1: +5% Physical & Magical Attack, -3% Death Rate
  • Max Level: +15% Physical & Magical Attack, -6% Death Rate

This is hands-down the strongest skin in the game, outperforming past skins that focused only on HP% or production buffs.

Is it overpowered?

Yes and no. While the numbers are strong, it’s worth remembering that many top players don’t even use elemental boost buffs. So while this skin offers a clear advantage, it won’t turn weak marches into meta threats on its own.

Glorious Challenge – Strategic Tip

  • Do not buy extra tickets until hard mode unlocks.
  • Wait three days to avoid wasting star energy and missing out on final rewards.
  • Many players burn currency too early — patience pays off.

Pinnacle Trial

  • Complete once per day.
  • Rewards resonance crystals used for the shop and progress.
  • Quick, easy daily task.

Upgraded Reward Tiers

This event’s rewards have been significantly improved:

Available Boxes:

  • Immortal Fragment Chests (targets: Alex, YSS, Charles, Wu, Baldwin)
  • Chaos & Holy Shards
  • Resonance Crystals
  • Chaos Immortal Fragments
  • Apollo Fragments

Note: Base rewards no longer include raw resources, which is a huge win. Immortal fragments and shards are now the standard base, making even light participation worthwhile.

Ranking System – The Competitive Core

Daily Rankings:

  • Top Player of the Day wins a Sky River Palace token.
  • The token can unlock or upgrade the castle skin.
  • Total: 10 winners over 10 days = max of 10 upgrades available.

Strategy:

  • First token unlocks the skin.
  • Second token upgrades it.
  • Only a handful of players will max this skin during this event.
  • Expect very high spenders to dominate these ranks.

Past Data:

  • Winners in previous events spent 4,000–5,000 USD per day. Silly whale stuff!
  • Given better rewards, expect even higher competition now.

Conclusion:

If you’re not a top spender, focus on unlocking — not upgrading. Future events will likely offer more Sky River tokens.

Shop Strategy

Ticket Purchasing:

  • Wait for Hard Mode.
  • Shop items are generous, but limited.

What to Buy:

  • Artifact Selection Chests: Needed to upgrade all your unique artifacts, my go to prio.
  • Stardust: Needed for artifact upgrades, my second pick.
  • Crystals: Solid pickup.
  • Philosopher’s Stones: Okay if you need purples.
  • Speed-ups: Very good chests for their cost actually. If you are progressing in seasons these are a good value pick for whatever you have left.
  • Skip Resources: Resources are easily gathered. Skip them.

You won’t be able to buy everything. Prioritize based on your progression needs.

Summary Tips

  • Daily log-ins = free rewards. Don’t miss them.
  • Sky River Palace is strong, but not game-breaking.
  • Do NOT overspend before Hard Mode unlocks.
  • Focus on unlocking, not upgrading the skin.
  • Expect intense competition in rankings.
  • Philosopher’s Stones and dust are top-value shop rewards.

Stay tuned for future updates — more Sky River upgrades will likely return in seasonal events throughout the year!

html:
Skyriver Palace Castle Skin: Early Overview & Analysis

Introduction

Infinity Kingdom has just pushed out a brand new and absolutely game-changing castle skin: Skyriver Palace. Introduced in the latest update (post-maintenance, June 6), this new skin now appears in the Castle Skin menu and has already made waves due to its unprecedented power scaling. As of now, the method to obtain this skin has not been confirmed, but it has been teased as part of the upcoming Children’s Day event, running from June 11 to June 21.

In this guide, we will break down what we know so far about the Skyriver Palace skin, its game-altering buffs, potential acquisition methods, and some forward-looking speculation on how this might impact the meta and future castle skin releases.

Skyriver Palace Stats & Buffs

Level 1 Buffs:

  • +5% Physical Attack (Immortals)
  • +5% Magical Attack (Immortals)
  • -3% Death Rate

Max Level Buffs:

  • +15% Physical Attack (Immortals)
  • +15% Magical Attack (Immortals)
  • -6% Death Rate

This is the most powerful castle skin ever released in Infinity Kingdom. Previous combat skins primarily gave 2% HP or 2% Honor gain at most. In contrast, Skyriver Palace provides a full-on 15% offensive boost AND survivability via reduced death rate. No other skin even comes close.

Check the Sneak Peak Video here to see for yourself!

How Do You Get It? (Speculation)

We currently do not know how to obtain the Skyriver Palace. However, based on the fact that it was teased in conjunction with the Children’s Day event, it’s safe to assume that:

  1. It will be tied to the event launching June 11.
  2. It will likely require heavy spending to unlock.
  3. We may unlock the base skin now and upgrade it in future events.

This follows a trend similar to how other seasonal event bundles are structured. The event may also include multiple milestone rewards or a tiered progression system (similar to recent cosmetic or VIP pack models).

What Makes This Skin So Special?

  • Double Damage Buffs: 15% to both physical and magical damage means this skin benefits every single march regardless of element or role. This is completely unique.
  • Death Rate Reduction: A -6% death rate is incredibly impactful for long PvP engagements, protecting troop count and reducing healing burdens.
  • Flexibility: Unlike HP% skins that favor tanks or support, this is universally valuable across all team roles.

No other castle skin has offered anything close to this level of universal, combat-focused performance enhancement.

Strategic Implications

  • Must-Have for Competitive Players: For players engaged in Throne battles, Squad Tournaments, or competitive server conquest, this skin is likely to become mandatory.
  • Massive Power Spike: This skin will significantly widen the gap between spenders and F2P players.
  • Game Meta Shifts: Expect a ripple effect through the meta. Teams may shift toward maximizing burst potential to take full advantage of the offensive bonus.

Future Castle Skin Predictions (Speculation)

Given how Skyriver Palace is structured, we can reasonably speculate on future seasonal skins:

  • Same +15% physical/magical damage base
  • Third buff variable:
    • Death Rate (current)
    • Honor Gain (possible next?)
    • HP% (final and most powerful?)

These would follow a pattern of rotating seasonal skins that can either be collected or upgraded over time, providing increasing bonuses.

What Should You Do?

For now, keep an eye on the event launch June 11. If you’re a spender:

  • Prepare your budget.
  • Plan for milestone-based or progressive unlock mechanics.
  • Evaluate your other spending (e.g., bundles, chaos fragments, etc.).

Personally, I plan to unlock this skin if at all possible. As soon as we know more about pricing, progression, and event structure, I will release a full guide on obtaining, upgrading, and valuing the Skyriver Palace skin.

Final Thoughts

The Skyriver Palace is unlike anything we’ve seen in Infinity Kingdom. While its release method is still under wraps, its mere presence signals a potential shift in how powerful cosmetics can be. If you’re competitive, stay alert, stay updated, and be ready to make a decision when the event drops. This is likely the most impactful castle cosmetic Infinity Kingdom has ever seen.

Stay tuned for a follow-up guide covering exact costs, progression paths, and upgrade strategies once the Children’s Day event goes live.

Seasonal events in Infinity Kingdom, like the ongoing Children’s Day Celebration, offer unique ways to earn powerful rewards. Among these, the most sought-after is the Jackpot Reward from the Treasure Hunter feature. This system appears regularly in seasonal events, and while it’s often overlooked or misunderstood, with the right strategy you can snipe the jackpot—even as a free or light spender.

On Season 1 servers, the jackpot consists of 60x Shadow/Holy Selection Chests, while Chaos-enabled servers receive 80x Chaos Selection Chests—a truly massive prize that can accelerate your immortal progress drastically.

This guide will explain in detail how the system works, the odds involved, and a proven strategy to snipe these jackpot rewards using patience, timing, and in-game observation.

TL;DR

  • Jackpot = 60x Holy/Shadow chests (S1) or 80x Chaos chests (Conquest servers)
  • Only 3 jackpots per 3,000 items
  • It’s all about timing, not money

Understanding the Treasure Hunter System

Each round of the Treasure Hunter has a fixed pool of 3,000 items shared across your server group. This pool is made up of three item tiers:

Bottom Tier (Common Items)

These items are extremely common and make up the bulk of the pool:

  • Random elemental immortal fragments (540 total)
  • Small Dragon Crystal chests (168 total)

Middle Tier (Uncommon Rewards)

Less common, but still decently likely to pull:

  • Unique Artifact Schematics (30 total)
  • Cao Cao Fragments
  • Large Dragon Crystal Selection Chests
  • Immortal Selection Chests (e.g. Alexander)

Top Tier (Rare Jackpot Items)

These are the true high-value rewards:

  • 60x Shadow/Holy Selection Chests (S1 servers) or 80x Chaos Selection Chests (Conquest servers) — only 3 total
  • 5 Unique Artifact Fragments (Holy/Shadow or Chaos)
  • 4 Random Immortal Fragments (Holy/Shadow or Chaos)

With just 3 jackpot items in a 3,000-item pool, your base odds are 0.1%. However, these odds improve over time as other players pull and drain lower-tier items.

TL;DR

  • Pool: 3,000 total items per round
  • Jackpot odds start at 0.1%, increase as pool is drained
  • Common items dominate early draws

The Strategy: How to Snipe the Jackpot

The key to success is timing your pulls to when the jackpot odds are most favorable.

Step 1: Monitor the Jackpot Count

Check how many jackpot items are left in the current pool. If all 3 are gone, the pool resets. If only 1 remains, stay alert.

Step 2: Track the Pool Count

You can see how many items remain in the pool. As this number gets lower, your chances improve dramatically.

  • At 3,000 items: ~0.1% odds
  • At 1,000 items: ~0.15% odds

Step 3: Wait for Ideal Conditions

If 1 jackpot is left and fewer than 80 items remain, prepare to start pulling and make sure you have a bank of wishes so you can finish the pool if “unlucky”.

Step 4: Draw Quickly

Start drawing when the pool hits 60–50 remaining items. DO NOT draw manually (use multi-draw!) you may be reading other guides telling you to avoid wasting pulls after the jackpot drops, but for this sniping we need speed a lot more than we need to not waste a draw or two. As it pool gets to very low number of items, you speed through draws to snipe the jackpot.

Step 5: Monitor & Repeat

If someone else snipes the jackpot before you, the pool resets and you start tracking again.

TL;DR

  • Start pulling at 50–60 remaining items with 1 jackpot left
  • Always use fast multi-draws during sniping window
  • Jackpot pulls cause instant reset

Real Example: Children’s Festival Jackpot Sniping

During the ongoing Children’s Day event, players received Resonance Crystals from:

  • Battle Pass
  • Free Celebration Shop rewards

One player used only these free and pass-earned crystals to participate. By tracking pool drops and watching for low-count jackpot opportunities, they were able to pull 3 jackpots in only 50 draws total.

This demonstrates that success doesn’t require heavy spending—only dedication and smart timing.

TL;DR

  • 3 jackpots pulled with 50 draws
  • No additional purchases beyond Battle Pass
  • Patience and timing = success

Additional Tips for Jackpot Hunters

  • Have time ready: You may need to monitor the event for long stretches
  • Be patient: RNG is random—some rounds will reset early, others give chances late
  • Avoid overcommitting: Never burn all crystals in one go without watching the pool

TL;DR

  • Time > money
  • Track manually
  • Be ready to adapt quickly

Why Jackpot Sniping Knowledge Is Essential for Every Seasonal Event in Infinity Kingdom

If you’ve just learned how to snipe the jackpot in the Children’s Day Celebration event, congratulations—you’ve unlocked one of the most powerful techniques in all of Infinity Kingdom. But here’s the real kicker: this isn’t just useful for one event.

In fact, once you understand how Treasure Hunter jackpot sniping works, you can apply that same knowledge to every seasonal event moving forward.

Same Mechanics, Different Skin

Whether it’s the Spring Festival, Halloween Spree, Anniversary Carnival, or any other seasonal celebration, Infinity Kingdom reuses the same exact Treasure Hunter system. The interface might change, the event currency may have a new name, and the rewards might be themed differently—but the mechanics remain identical:

  • 3,000 items per round
  • 3 jackpot prizes
  • Fixed item counts for all rewards
  • Shared cross-server pool
  • Jackpot causes an instant reset

This consistency means once you’ve mastered the art of timing your pulls, monitoring the remaining item count, and jumping in when odds are optimal, you can rinse and repeat your way to massive long-term gains.

The Jackpot Is Always Worth It

Depending on your server stage, the top-tier prize will vary:

  • Season 1 servers: 60x Shadow/Holy Selection Chests
  • Conquest servers: 80x Chaos Selection Chests (far more valuable)

These jackpots are game-defining. Getting even one or two over the course of an event can power up a full new immortal, supercharge an element build, or complete an artifact breakthrough. When you learn to snipe successfully, you’re not relying on luck—you’re stacking the odds in your favor and bypassing the spending curve entirely.

Knowledge That Pays Off Repeatedly

Each seasonal event typically lasts 10–14 days and has multiple jackpot rounds. Multiply that across all major events throughout the year, and you get several dozen sniping opportunities annually. Now imagine walking away with 5, 10, or even 15 jackpots over time.

This knowledge literally compounds in value the longer you play.

The True Power: Non-Whales Keeping Up

For low- or mid-spenders, jackpot sniping is one of the few tools that can let you fight above your weight. Whales will always have more resources, but they often spend fast and early, not strategically. If you’re patient and observant, you can end up walking away with the jackpot that they missed by being too hasty.

What to Expect in Future Events

So far, the Treasure Hunter system has remained unchanged across every seasonal event that used it. That means in future events, you should expect:

  • Different event currency (e.g., Lanterns, Candy, Fireworks, etc.)
  • Updated pool visuals and themes
  • New artifact or fragment jackpot rewards (sometimes exclusive)
  • The exact same jackpot logic and pool behavior

Final Words

Learning to snipe jackpots in Treasure Hunter isn’t just a fun trick—it’s a core player skill. Master it once, and you’ll be harvesting jackpot rewards every few months as seasonal events roll through.

Track the pool. Wait for the low counts. Draw fast. Get rewarded.

Next time a seasonal event hits Norheim, you’ll already be ahead of the game.

How do we most efficiently obtain a unique artifact?

There are a couple different ways of obtaining a few free Marbles.

At the time of writing we are in day 1 of the event, needless to say I cannot know for certain what we will find in the rewards tabs for day 2-5 quests. But based on the previous years we should not expect additional free Marbels from this event tab in the other days.

Shop Bundles

Price of unique artifact

In total you will pay 70 bucks for your artifact, this is a good price but please beware that this is assuming you are completing both the Joyful Park and Wonderful Home events and spending the 3.5K gems on the Wonderful home. If you do NOT complete Wonderful Home nor spend gems here, you must purchase as follow:

Price of Genghis Khan / Charles / Baldwin

You also have a shot at getting a full 60x Immortal fragments for either Khan, Charles or Baldwin. This will cost you 150 marbles and should plan your spending as follows:

The changes for not completing Wonderful Home side event, is more easily dealt with here, as you simply add another 10$ bundle if you are unable to complete this event.

Celebrate the Season with Pets Christmas New Year Carnival in Infinity Kingdom!

Season’s greetings, commanders! As we eagerly await the grandeur of the Winter Festival event on the 24th of December, Infinity Kingdom has surprised us with a delightful bonus mini event to keep the festive spirit alive. Introducing the “Pets Christmas New Year Carnival,” this holiday-themed event will run from now until January 7th, bringing joy, rewards, and a touch of merriment to the realm.

Invitational Code Bonanza:

The highlight of this mini event is a heartwarming opportunity to reconnect with friends who may have taken a break from Infinity Kingdom. By generating an invitational code, you can entice returning players to rejoin the battlefield. If you know someone yearning to dive back into the action, share the code and reap the rewards – including gems, essences, and event boxes that promise exciting surprises!

Simple Tasks, Abundant Rewards:

The Pets Christmas New Year Carnival keeps things straightforward with three simple tasks that can yield bountiful rewards. First, login to the event page; second, login to the game; and third, complete your daily quests, accumulating 100 activity points. In return for your festive dedication, you’ll receive three attempts to pull rewards from the whimsical event-machine-grabler-thingy.

A Treasure Trove of Rewards:

What can you expect from the event-machine-grabler-thingy? Oh, only a trove of rewards to enhance your Infinity Kingdom experience! From gold boosts and gems to philosopher stones, experience points, and marching speedups – the possibilities are vast. And if luck favors you, you might even snag Stardust, Portals, or Elite Dragon Crystal chests, elevating your holiday celebration to new heights.

Daily Visits, Daily Delights:

Make it a daily ritual to venture into the Pets Christmas New Year Carnival event from now until January 7th. With each visit, you’re not only ensuring a jolly time for yourself but also increasing your chances of uncovering rare and valuable treasures. The event promises a mix of practical resources and exciting surprises, making it an adventure worth embarking on every day.

A Prelude to Winter Festival:

While the Pets Christmas New Year Carnival is a delightful side-event, remember that the grandeur of the Winter Festival awaits us on the 24th of December. So, commanders, stay tuned for the real Christmas extravaganza, and in the meantime, revel in the joyous atmosphere of the mini event.

‘Tis the season of giving, and Infinity Kingdom is spreading the holiday cheer with the Pets Christmas New Year Carnival. Reconnect with old comrades, complete simple tasks, and revel in the joy of daily rewards. As we count down to the Winter Festival, let this mini event be a delightful prelude to the grand celebration that awaits us. Happy holidays, commanders, and may your Infinity Kingdom be filled with festive magic!

title: Christmas Snow Festival
description: It is finally that time of the year! Snow is falling in Norheim, Merlin’s done brewing the eggnog and Zenobia is almost done with the feast! Christmas is here and the Infinity Kingdom snow festival has begun – Happy holidays everyone!
html:
It is finally that time of the year! Snow is falling in Norheim, Merlin’s done brewing the eggnog and Zenobia is almost done with the feast! Christmas is here and the Infinity Kingdom snow festival has begun – Happy holidays everyone!

In this guide, we are going to have a look at this years Christmas event.. and spoiler alert – it is an extreemly awesome one this time. This might be one of the absolute best and most Free-To-Play friendly seasonal events ever! Merry Christmas and thank you IK.

Rewards

So this year, Santa has brought some very nice rewards for us. In the Winter Surprise we have a few main rewards that we want to focus on.

First of all, you are able to get Attila, Saladin, El Cid or Alexander for FREE. Spending only 60 Snow Hats.

Secondly, you can get a unique artifact for your brand new Immortal for 250 Snow Hats.

Third, if you are in need of dragon crystals, there are a few in there for not much cost, likewise, there are a few purple crystals to be earned.

Fourth and last, you have the usual cosmetic stuff. Getting the Nameplate, Chatbox and Profile Frame costs you a few Snow Hats,

This years Castle Christmas Skin will cost you 250 Hats, but more importantly, it is the same box as the unique which means you are unable to get both unique artifact and event skin this time.

How does it work?

In order to unlock the good rewards for this event, you need some Snow Hats!

These are available in the Shop for Gems. Yes. GEMS! You do not need to spend a single dollar this Christmas, instead you spend some of that hard earned gem stockpile on awesome rewards.

The bundles have 1 stock and resets daily, meaning you can get a lot of value from this event.

Spending your gems will get you more than just Snow Hats too – this is a rare chance for players to get very very cheap Dragon Essences!

The full event shop is as follows (reset daily)

Cost of main rewards

So what does the big juicy rewards cost? They are quite cheap! You can get the unlock on otherwise pay-to-play Immortals for under 8k gems. Moreover, a unique artifact for under 33K gems is very cheap compared to the spender prices from many other events. However, it is similar to that of Pinball events.

Loki under the tree

Infinity Kingdom also has a special treat for us this year – Loki!

Our favorite Chaos Immortal is hiding in the Snow Festival Eve Quest rewards, unlocking all five will get you a total of 40 Loki Fragments, simply by completing the daily quests that release as the event progresses. This is massive and an awesome way to keep us engaged during the holidays. All players should pay careful attention to this and make sure you complete all of the quests this year!

All in all

All in all, this event it a very good one. We are getting a ton of value. Free to play players are able to unlock Atilla or another pay-walled Immortal with only gems and everyone is able to get Dragon Essences at extreemly low cost. Lastly, we are able to get Loki fragments FOR FREE. We don’t even spend gems, we just complete quests and unlock massive 40 Loki Fragments free of charge.

A great event for this years Christmas in Infinity Kingdom – I hope that each and every single one of you and your loved ones have a wonderful Christmas and enjoy the holidays to the fullest!

Infinity Kingdom Winter Festival Player Guide: Unwrapping the Festive Delights

Greetings, fellow Infinity Kingdom commanders! ‘Tis the season for joy and celebration, and the Winter Festival event has graced us with its presence, bringing merriment and valuable rewards. In this comprehensive guide, we’ll navigate the snowy landscape of the Winter Festival, uncovering the intricacies of each event bracket.

1. Snow Festival Eve:

Embark on the Snow Festival Eve by completing daily quests, earning valuable points to progress through the main event bar and unlock chests. These chests contain coveted rewards, including 40 Athena Fragments, 30 Stardust, 3 Dice, and 500 Gems—all for free! Start your festive journey with these generous rewards.

2. Winter Adventure – The Dice Game:

The highlight of this year’s Winter Festival is the captivating Winter Adventure—a dice game akin to the spender-event. Obtain three free Dice and explore additional opportunities to acquire more through event bundles, cosmetic bundles, and the Festival of Colors. A significant twist lies in the abundant rewards for completing this dice game, including 80 Stardust, 60x Holy/Shadow selection chests, and a staggering 80x Chaos Selection Chest, a valuable boon for chaos immortal enthusiasts.

Calculating Dice Needs:

The journey to 1500 points involves strategic dice management. On average, completing a round requires 8.57 dice, leading to an estimated 183.4 Dice for the entire event.

Note that luck plays a role; bad rolls may necessitate more dice, while favorable rolls could reduce the count.

Player Experience:

One commander’s experience involved using 123 dice to reach 1020 points. While close, the remaining 45 dice needed for the Chaos Selection Chest may require additional investment. As a precaution, purchasing the cosmetic packs for $125 might prove essential to ensuring a victorious Winter Adventure.

3. Snow World:

Engage in the Snow World event, where farming resources and defeating gnomes and bosses yield Snow Coins. Redeem these coins in the Winter Surprise shop for various rewards, including 30x Stardust and helpful speed-ups.

4. Festival of Colors:

Collect presents as a currency by completing quests during Snow Festival Eve, and utilize them in the Festival of Colors to adorn your Christmas tree.

Completing quests should provide ample presents, allowing you to progress through the 20 levels. Notable rewards include 10 free dice, with the $20 tier offering 45 dice, Stardust, and other enticing rewards.

In summary, the Infinity Kingdom Winter Festival is a delightful event filled with opportunities for festive merriment and valuable rewards. As you unwrap the presents and roll the dice, may your Winter Festival be filled with joy, prosperity, and victorious battles. Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year to all commanders!

There are three reward tiers waiting to be unlocked, so make sure to participate in the Colorful Party and earn some amazing prizes.

description: The Original Festival has begun! From the 16th to the 21st of April players are able to participate in the Original Festival for a bit of post-easter celebrations! During these six days, players can participate in a variety of activities and earn rewards.
html:
The Original Festival has begun! From the 16th to the 21st of April players are able to participate in the Original Festival for a bit of post-easter celebrations! During these six days, players can participate in a variety of activities and earn rewards.

Main Rewards Summary

Rewards come in two tiers: The first tier is for free-to-play players with farmable Frigg Souvenir Coin as the main currency. The Second tier of rewards costs the Original Crystal currency. This currency is a “spender” currency. You can get 3x via gems in the Colorful Party, but the rest are only available in recharge bundles costing real fiat currency to exchange.

Tier 2 rewards (F2P):

– For 5 Souvenir Coins you can buy the “full of energy” chest containing either valuable AP potions of universal speeds. A very very good chest and you want to purchase all 3 in stock.


– For 120 Souvenir Coins you can buy the “Miracles of Goddess” chests containing an Epic Immortal at random. This is a super good reward available for free and it a good way to obtain a good chunck of Purple Soul Crystals.


– Call of Origin Selection Chest is the third noteworthy reward, simply because some players live for cosmetic effects. Here you are able to get the Original Festival Avatar Frame or an extra philosopher stone.


– Any remaining Souvenir Coins you have should be used to purchase as many speed-ups as possible.

Tier 1 rewards (spender):

– For 30 Original Crystals you can purchase the Epic Immortals Selection Chest offering a full 60 fragments for your favorite missing Immortal. You can choose between: Attila, Saladin, El Cid and Alexander.


– With another whopping 100 Origin Crystals you are able to purchase the Aspect of Origin Selection Chest which holds either: Castle Skin “Wonderful World” or a unique artifact for either Attila, Saladin, El Cid or Alexander.


– For just 10 Original Crystals you can purchase the Common Dragon Crystal Selection Chest and choose between 100x dragon crystals for either Earth, Lightning, Water or Fire.


– Spending only 2 Original Crystals you can purchase 1 Philosopher stone. This carries a max stock of 10, giving a good option for some summons.


– For 10 Original Crystals you can buy the Lively Origin Selection Chest where you can either get 6x philosopher stones (okay stone value) or the Playful Frigg chatbox cosmetic.


– Lastly, for 5 Original Crystals you can get the Colorful Origin Selection Chest with either 3x philosopher stones (okay stone value) or the Colorful April avatar frame cosmetic effect.

Original Crystal Pricing

The price tags are quite steep for this event. A total of 185 dollars will get you the full 170 crystals. However the structure makes is highly inefficient way of obtaining anything.

Rewards I will prioritize

I want to make sure to purchase 3x Full of Energy spending just 15 free-to-play Souvenir Coins. I will also make sure to get the Miracles of Goddess for 120 coins just because purple crystals is always worth banking. All remaining coin I will be dumping into as many speed-ups as I can.

For the spender section of this event I am not going to participate. I do not find the rewards worth the price tags. 10 Original Crystals (5$) for 100 dragon crystals is bad value, the castle skin is not very good (especially since we have the Frozen Dragon Skin with cooler cosmetics and just pure and simple better effect. The Unique Artifact for Alex, Attila, Cid or Saladin costs 100 Crystals translating into 85$. Comparatively, the 5-day UA bundles that occur very often as a default in the shop, gets you the same unique artifact for 50$ + dragon essences and crystals. Much better value. Lastly, there is the 60 Immortal fragments. Is this atleast cheap? No. Getting 30 Crystals will cost you 35$ since the 10$ bundle only hold 16 and not the 20 crystals you need. That makes it hugely inefficient and expensive.

I am not spending a dime this event. I am going to be grinding this event however, since the free to play rewards are okay.

If you would like to know more about this entire event and how to obtain these rewards. Check out the full event details below!
