html:
The Goddesses Festival is a great event for all types of players. If you want to spend there are excellent items available if you have a gem-abundance. This event however, does not require you to spend a single dollar to max out on rewards, making it arguably one of the best events for F2P players.

Basics of this event

During the festival event you earn Goblets by farming nodes on the map, collecting resources from your farms (inside your castle), killing gnomes and killing bosses. Just like so many other events, we get boxes with item currency, this time Goblets.
These Goblets can be used to purchase Star Souvenir Coins, which are the currency for basic rewards. These are bought at a 1:1 ratio.

There are two types of rewards, and not all can be farmed with Goblets.

The higher quality rewards requires Divine Crystals

These are not farmable, but are rewarded from completing the event quests/tasks and can be purchased for 200 gems each.

Free Divine Crystals
For free we get a total of 1×2 1×3 and 1×5 = 10 crystals. We want to spend these on philosopher stones!

If you plan on spending gems during this event, see below how much each item will cost you.

Rewards

I have EXCLUDED the free crystals, so you can just see it as a 2000 gem discount on your first purchase.

1. Star Souvenir Coin

We want to make sure we grind enough Goblets / Star coins to get the Random Epic Immortal, the Philosopher’s Offer chest and the Elite Immortal Fragments Chest. These are the most important rewards, because they yield decent purple crystal. If you have currency to spare, go for speedups.

2. Divine Crystal

There are many important rewards to take not of here:

  1. Free to play players have a rare opportunity to unlock one of the best Immortals in the game – Charles, Genghis Khan or Baldwin. These are usually only availble through a 99$ bundle, making this a VERY good event and a priority for players who are not spending that much on an Immortal unlock.
  2. Dragon soul crystals take a long time to grind out, making it a very nice reward if you are working on a second or a third dragon. If you are building multiple marches, you want to buy this one. If you are a low spender or a free to play, dont bother with your gems on this one.
  3. Philosopher Stones are often the best value item of these events. this is no different. Each stone has a value avg. of 515 purple crystals and getting them at a discount rate is awesome. These are simply insanely good, because you need a ton of purple crystal (read everything abount purple crystals here).
    Each stone costs 200 gems instead of the usual 300 gems, making it a nice discount you want to use up.

Other rewards

In other rewards, we get some nice things on the side as we play through this event. Doing the quests from “Secrets of the Stars” will net you a territorial teleport, assorted buffs, rss chests, speedups and exp scrolls. All very nice loot for very little effort.

We also get a nice amount of ressources, speedups and if we are lucky, Enchant Stones and Exp Scrolls as we hand over our Goblets and purchase Divine Crystals with gems on the “Divine Blessings” tab.

While you do need quite a few gems to get the top rewards, the fact that any F2P player can bank gems and obtain the best of the best rewards is a huge improvement to other seasonal events where top rewards is pay-walled.

Basics of this event

During the festival event you earn Goblets by farming nodes on the map, collecting resources from your farms (inside your castle), killing gnomes and killing bosses. Just like so many other events, we get boxes with item currency, this time Goblets.
These Goblets can be used to purchase Star Souvenir Coins, which are the currency for basic rewards. These are bought at a 1:1 ratio.

There are two types of rewards for this event and not all can be farmed with Goblets. Goblets unlock the basic farmable rewards whereas the juicy and best rewards require another event currency: Divine Crystals.

Divine Crystals

These are not farmable, but are rewarded from completing the event quests/tasks and can be purchased for 200 gems each.

Free Divine Crystals

While you can spend 200 gems to get a Divine Crystal all day, there is also a few Free Divine Crystals available in this event.

For free we get a total of 1×2 1×3 and 1×5 = 10 crystals.

The way you unlock these is by completing the quest’s found in the Secrets of Stars event tab. There are a total of xx Quests (outer circles) which you should make sure to complete during the event. As you complete these quests, you are rewarded both as you complete every quest as well as when you complete all the quests connected to one of the major chest nodes (see below)

All in all these are the tasks you want to complete:

  1. kill 50 gnomes (ANY level)
  2. Purchase 50 times at the Market (buying Soul Crystal Immortal fragments can be melted for 1:1 return
  3. Kill 15 Gnome bosses (ANY level)
  4. Raid Well of Time 150 times (1500 SP required, make sure never to waste SP at cap)
  5. Challenge 20 times in Arena (20 hits not wins!)
  6. Sail 8 times (careful doing 12hour sails if you are behind)
  7. Force teleport 10 lords (any dead castle will do, no lvl restriction)
  8. Login for 4 days
  9. Collect 600K resources (single node will do)
  10. Train 80,000 troops (any type will do)
  11. Summon 25 times using Philosopher Stones
  12. Manufacture 200,000 Fortifications (any level and type)

Rewards

I have EXCLUDED the free crystals, so you can just see it as a 2000 gem discount on your first purchase.

1. Star Souvenir Coin

We want to make sure we grind enough Goblets / Star coins to get the Random Epic Immortal, the Philosopher’s Offer chest and the Elite Immortal Fragments Chest. These are the most important rewards, because they yield decent purple crystal. If you have currency to spare, go for speedups.

2. Divine Crystal

There are many important rewards to take not of here:

  1. Unique Artifact for Alex, Attila, Saladin or Cid is very powerful and 40,000 gems is pretty cheap! You usually should think a value of around 100-150$ for one of these.
  2. Dragon soul crystals take a long time to grind out, making it a very nice reward if you are working on a second or a third dragon. If you are building multiple marches, you want to buy this one. If you are a low spender or a free to play, dont bother with your gems on this one.
  3. Philosopher Stones are often the best value item of these events. this is no different. Each stone has a value avg. of 515 purple crystals and getting them at a discount rate is awesome. These are simply insanely good, because you need a ton of purple crystal (read everything abount purple crystals here).
    Each stone costs 200 gems instead of the usual 300 gems, making it a nice discount you want to use up.
  4. The Full of Energy Chest is very good! You can get a TON of AP this way and you want to make sure you buy all five of those regardless of who you are!

Other rewards

In other rewards, we get some nice things on the side as we play through this event. Doing the quests from “Secrets of the Stars” will net you a territorial teleport, assorted buffs, rss chests, speedups and exp scrolls. All very nice loot for very little effort.

We also get a nice amount of ressources, speedups and if we are lucky, Enchant Stones and Exp Scrolls as we hand over our Goblets and purchase Divine Crystals with gems on the “Divine Blessings” tab.

Goddesses Festival Event Guide: Maximizing Rewards in Infinity Kingdom

The Goddesses Festival returns to Infinity Kingdom, continuing the tradition of celebrating with Goblets, Souvenir Coins, and Divine Crystals. This event offers players, both free-to-play (F2P) and spenders, a variety of rewards through active participation and strategic resource management. Here’s how to navigate this event efficiently, ensuring you maximize the benefits from both tiers of rewards.

Free Tier Rewards: Goblets to Souvenir Coins Conversion

Collecting Goblets

Participants will collect Goblets throughout the event period, which serve as the primary currency for F2P rewards. These Goblets can be converted into Souvenir Coins, the currency used to redeem rewards in the free tier.

Noteworthy Free Tier Rewards

While the free tier rewards may not seem as lucrative compared to previous events, there are still valuable items to be obtained for diligent players:

  • 100 Stardust for 150 Souvenir Coins: Essential for upgrading portrait levels, stardust remains a valuable resource.
  • Epic Immortal Selection Chest for 150 Souvenir Coins: For players looking to complete or enhance their epic immortal rosters, this selection chest offers a direct path to do so.
  • Minor Speedups: While not the highlight of the event, speedups are always useful for progressing faster in various game aspects.

Spender Tier Rewards: Leveraging Divine Crystals

Earning Divine Crystals

Divine Crystals are obtained through event-specific quests and spending gems, with the conversion rate being 1 Divine Crystal for every 200 gems spent. These crystals unlock the path to more premium rewards within the event.

Premium Rewards and Their Costs

The spender tier offers significant rewards that can impact your strategic positioning in the game:

  • Holy or Shadow Immortal for 120 Divine Crystals (24,000 gems): Acquiring a Holy or Shadow immortal at this price is an opportunity worth considering for players focusing on these elements, particularly for those looking to max out immortals like Himiko or Tomyris.
  • Unique Artifacts for 60 Divine Crystals (12,000 gems): Given the essential role of artifacts in boosting immortal performance, securing them at this price offers great value. Players should prioritize acquiring artifacts integral to their main lineup.

Strategic Considerations

Assessing Value and Priorities

  • For F2P Players: Focus on collecting Goblets daily to maximize your Souvenir Coins. Prioritize rewards that directly contribute to your current objectives, such as stardust for portrait levels or specific epic immortals to round out your lineup.
  • For Spenders: Evaluate your spending plans in the context of the event. If you were already planning to invest in gems, timing your purchases to coincide with the Goddesses Festival can yield additional value in the form of Divine Crystals. Prioritize holy or shadow immortals and unique artifacts that align with your strategic needs.

Conclusion

  • Daily Engagement: Ensure you’re completing the event-specific quests daily to gather as many Goblets and Divine Crystals as possible.

The Goddesses Festival in Infinity Kingdom presents a blend of opportunities for both free-to-play participants and spenders. While the free tier offers modest rewards, diligent collection and conversion of Goblets to Souvenir Coins can still yield useful resources. For spenders, the event underscores the strategic use of gems to obtain significant boosts through Holy or Shadow immortals and unique artifacts. By carefully navigating the event’s mechanics and optimizing resource allocation, players can enhance their Kingdom’s prowess and prepare for the challenges ahead in Norheim.

title: Radiant Festival (new version) 2025
description: The Radiant Festival is back in Infinity Kingdom, and it’s packed with PvP skin, powerful rewards, a chance to unlock Apollo (conquest), and plenty of free-to-play progression tools—if you play your cards right.
html:
The Radiant Festival is back in Infinity Kingdom, and it’s packed with PvP skin, powerful rewards, a chance to unlock Apollo (conquest), and plenty of free-to-play progression tools—if you play your cards right.

Whether you’re a light spender or a high roller, this guide will walk you through how to make the most of every part of the event, highlight critical timing strategies, and help you avoid wasting resources early. Let’s dive in!

1. Sign-In Rewards – Easy to Miss, Easier to Collect

✔ Tip: There was a bug in the last version of the event that made players think the Day 1 reward was missing—it’s not.
✔ Just scroll horizontally on the sign-in tab to claim your daily rewards.
💡 Don’t miss a single day, especially if you’re aiming for milestone prizes or are on a free-to-play track.

2. Radiant Path – Permanent Skin for $50

The Radiant Path offers a $50 permanent city skin, and it’s arguably the best combat skin in the game right now.

Why It’s Good:

  • Effect: Increases death rate (reduces troops lost permanently)
  • PvP Impact: Fewer troops lost = lower healing costs = longer combat sustainability
  • Aesthetics + Function: If you like the look and want a meaningful combat edge, this is one of the best-value skins yet released

💰 Verdict: If you ever wanted a skin that actually gives real PvP value and looks great—this one’s worth it.

3. Glorious Challenge – DO NOT Rush

This is the #1 thing players messed up last time:

✔ You get 5 free challenge attempts daily
✔ You can buy extra attempts using gems in the Celebration Shop

BUT WAIT…

⛔️ DO NOT BUY extra attempts immediately.
🕒 Wait for Hard Mode to unlock (usually Day 3 of the event)

Why?

  • Hard mode gives better rewards
  • You’ll be able to spend your extra purchased attempts on harder stages, maximizing value
  • Later stages = more tickets + better celebration shop returns

💡 Save your gems, stockpile your daily attempts, and go big once hard mode is live.

4. Pinnacle Trial – Quick Daily Grab

✔ Free entry every other day
✔ Rewards are solid – speedups, boosts, etc.
⛔ Doesn’t stack if unclaimed, so log in and use your daily entry

No tricks here—just solid value if you remember to claim it.

5. Dazzling Wish – Summon Mechanic

This is where big spenders chase Apollo—the new exclusive Immortal.

In early game servers before Chaos Immortals are released, we are naturally not able to summon Apollo. But Holy is still quite new for e.g. season 1 servers, and we get a decent chance at those in season 1.

Apollo and Drop Rates in Conquest:

  • 0.2% chance to get Apollo directly
  • 2% chance for 5 Apollo fragments
  • 1.2% chance for 5 Apollo artifact fragments
  • 0.2% chance for 60 Apollo artifact fragments

🌀 Most players will receive random immortal fragments, which are still very useful, especially if you’re running:

  • Fire (Hammurabi, William, Zenobia)
  • Earth (Charles, Alex, YSS)

💡 F2P takeaway: Even if you don’t pull Apollo, the fragments still help strengthen your team, especially in meta builds.If you are not in a season where Chaos Immortals are available, the value of Dazzling Wish drops quite significantly, and I wouldn’t recommend spending on it. Just do what comes freely during the event.

6. Stardust & Celebration Shop – F2P Priorities

This is where free-to-play players get great value. Prioritize your celebration currency wisely.

🎯 Best Purchases:

  1. Stardust – Used to draw from Dazzling Wish (and potentially unlock Apollo).
    • Buy 5 per day = 500 Stardust = a solid chunk of pulls
  2. Token of Light – Used to redeem immortal fragments and key rewards
    • Fragments are random, but include many top-tier Immortals
  3. Artifact Fragments (Optional) – If you’re short on specific schematics, this is a decent pickup. For young servers, this is a huge reward!

Other Options (Situational):

  • Speedups: If you’re prepping for fights or building/tech rushes
  • Gold/Supplies: For developing accounts
  • Philosopher Stones: Highly valuable for immortal stars—a long-term must-have

7. Deluxe Rose Box & Popularity Event

This one’s for the leaderboard chasers.

  • You can gift Rose Boxes to players for popularity points
  • Top players get exclusive skins, frames, and chat texts
  • You can gift up to 1,000 times for 1,000 gems (but… why?)

Verdict:

⛔ For most players, not worth the gem cost
✔ For whales chasing cosmetic clout—go nuts, just don’t expect it to be cheap

Final Tips & Takeaways

✅ Sign in daily, scroll sideways if needed
✅ Wait until Hard Mode unlocks before buying challenge attempts
✅ Stardust + Token of Light are the best F2P rewards
✅ Pick up the $50 skin if you want long-term PvP benefit
✅ Dazzling Wish is RNG-heavy, but fragments still bring value
✅ Deluxe Rose Box is a pure whale vanity item – skip if you’re on a budget

TL;DR – What to Do Each Day

Summary

The Radiant Festival is a great mix of fun, cosmetics, and progression—and with the right strategy, you can come out with top-tier value even without spending.

🎯 Remember: Hard mode = best rewards, Stardust is king, and that PvP skin is worth the $50 if you want it.

Let me know if you’d like a matching visual thumbnail, summary chart, or PDF export for this guide—happy to help!

html:
Unveiling the Secrets of Infinity Kingdom’s Halloween Event 2023

Infinity Kingdom has once again adorned itself in spooky splendor as Halloween approaches. The 2023 Halloween event has surfaced with its familiar yet exciting elements.

In this comprehensive guide, we’ll walk you through the event’s intricacies, helping you secure every enticing reward. Let’s dive into the festivities:

1. Shadowy Spectres Event
Begin your Halloween journey with the classic 5-day daily quests offered by the Shadowy Spectres. These quests not only grant you valuable sub-rewards but also unlock access to a treasure trove of Loki fragments and stardust.

By completing these quests, you’ll accumulate 40 Loki fragments, 20 stardust, 10 Milk Candy, and 500 gems, setting the stage for a fruitful event.

2. Scary Pumpkins
Engage in the age-old tradition of pumpkin hunting by defeating gnomes and harvesting resources. These actions allow you to acquire event-specific chests using the free-to-play currency, setting you on the path to creating delectable sweets. After all, it wouldn’t be Halloween without some treats!

3. Trick or Treat Mini Event
The Trick or Treat mini event is where the magic of candy production unfolds. Here, you’ll craft candies that play a pivotal role in the Halloween festivities.

4. Gift Party
The Gift Party is the heart of the Halloween event, where your hard-earned Candy and Milk Candy find purpose. For free-to-play players, prioritize obtaining 30x Stardust for 5 Candy each, along with 200 gems. Additionally, secure the precious speed-ups. While the other offerings are present, they may not be as worthwhile due to the relatively high gem cost for older legacy artifact technology.

For the spender Candy, known as “Milk Candy,” you can unlock even more Stardust. By redeeming a total of 10 sets of 9 Stardust, you’ll receive a substantial boost of 90 Stardust. Each set of 9 costs 10 Milk Candy, totaling 100 Milk Candy to acquire them all. This is a valuable investment, especially if you wish to maintain Portrait Levels.

Furthermore, for a bargain price of 120 Milk Candy, you can obtain 60x fragments for your preferred Shadow or Holy immortal. This deal is hard to pass up.

Lastly, consider acquiring as many Crimson Moonlights as possible, especially if you are a dedicated Chaos Spender. These Moonlights are relatively costly in the pinball event, making them a wise purchase. Aim to obtain the full 30 Moonlights for 300 Milk Candy.

5. Night Phantoms
Night Phantoms provide an opportunity to acquire Halloween-themed cosmetics, including frames, nameframes, and castle skins.

However, it’s advisable to focus on these items only if you urgently require additional Candy or are particularly fond of the cosmetics. They are less cost-effective compared to the regular bundles.

6. Candy Feast
In the Candy Feast section, you have the chance to purchase Candy. The $5, $10, $20, and $50 bundles are available once during the event, and the $100 bundle can be purchased up to five times. This entails a total cost of $585 for 620 Milk Candy.

The bundle you opt for depends on your event goals. For mid-spenders aiming for Stardust and a Holy or Shadow immortal requiring 220 Milk Candy, you can choose to skip the $5 bundle and purchase the other ones, including one $100 bundle. This results in a budget-friendly cost of just $80 for a Holy or Shadow immortal.

In conclusion, the 2023 Halloween event in Infinity Kingdom promises a bountiful harvest of rewards, including affordable Holy and Shadow immortals and ample Stardust. So, dive into the festivities, gather your Candy, and enjoy the spooktacular delights that await you!

description: In this article we shall go through the unique seasonal event for Halloween 2022! For this one, we are going to focus on spender-content. Since we are doing the Halloween event where spenders can reap big rewards.
html:
In this article we shall go through the unique seasonal event for Halloween 2022! For this one, we are going to focus on spender-content. Since we are doing the Halloween event where spenders can reap big rewards.

Halloween have some F2P rewards too in the form of gifts, but I honestly don’t think anyone here wants to here me tell you to go send gifts to your friends – we all know that!

Free Gift Codes for Halloween!

Here are the three new codes! They expire in 6 days from today, so get on it and make sure you have used all three. There are major rewards including a total of 9 philosopher stones to get this year!

3x CODES: halloweenfb + halloweendc + halloweenvk

Spender rewards

We have quite a few high value items available for this event, including castle skin, unique artifacts and a chance to unlock one of the great Epic Immortals of Infinity Kingdom.

We will take a look at the rewards first, then the bundles on offer as well as the pricings of his years event rewards.

Buddy up!

This years event is much like the previous. We have a lot of rewards, but we can’t redeem them ourselves but instead have to gift them to one another. We gotta go trick or treating! So you should find a buddy on your server that needs some of the same items that you do and trade gifts.

Castle Skin

This years gifts are the unique Halloween castle skin giving a 3% boost to technology research timers.

Let’s just jump into the castle skin. Night Phantoms is an awesome skin and one of the skins I personally have gained the most value from since I got it last year. Having 3% boost to technology is a gift that keeps on giving. I know only one player that has actually completed technology at this stage, meaning pretty much everyone even in castle level 50 are struggling to keep up with the vast tech-tree of Infinity Kingdom.

I cannot recommend this castle skin enough! Dragon gold, tech boost and troop HP are in my opinion the three skins that are worthwhile to get!

Unlock Charles or Genghis Khan or Baldwin

You can also get a full 60 fragment chest for either Genghis Khan, Charles or Baldwin. These are absolute top tier Immortals and especially Charles and Khan are invaluable in many end-game meta setups.

Get Skin, Charles og Khan as a FREE TO PLAY?!?

There are not many events where players are able to obtain a Genghis Khan or a Charles. If you are a 100% free to play player, you cannot trade with someone else. That would require money investments. Instead, what you can do is trade your services in return for a rewards chest!

For instance, some players in your server may value honor or resources highly. If you have an army of free to play alts ready. You can trade a couple million honor for a spender reward. Or you can make a deal for x-amount of million resources for a reward. This is an opportunity for all you free to plays to offer your services for sale!

Unique Artifact – high value item

Third on the list of amazing rewards, is a full unique artifact piece for Alex, Attila, Cid or Saladin. These cost around 200-300 USD to get through Triss events and as such you can get a very nice discount if you are running one of these Immortals and need more artifacts.

Pricing on rewards

Let’s have a look at the pricings and how we can get the rewards we want for as cheap as possible.

These are all the candy-currency bundles of this years event. As usual the cheaper the bundle the more value.

Because this event both has rewards you can buy directly and rewards you can gift to each other. There are some of the rewards you can get in multiple ways.

The castle skin, should be traded. You can get is as cheap as 70$ if you gift-trade with another player.

Whereas if you get it from the bundles you purchase you have to spend the total 115$ and you will not be able to get a unique artifact! That would be terrible!

The Immortal unlock of Khan or Charles will set you back 85$ if done as cheap as possible.

The Unique Artifact can ONLY be gained through the big event 99$ bundles, and as such you need all of them totalling a cost of 115$ for the artifact. A bit less than half of what they usually cost to get through Triss!

The cosmetics can be bought for 15$ but are included in the 115$ if u buy unique artifact.

What does it cost to get EVERYTHING?

Well if you want everything you have to combine purchasing exclusive bundles and currency-bundles.

To get the unique artifact you have to buy all three exclusive bundles, getting you back 115$. As I said, a very very good price.

This also takes care of getting the cosmetic stuff, and leaves you with 30 spare candy currency.

To get the Castle skin you need to trade with a buddy and spend 80 candy. Moreover, we want Charles or Khan, so we need an additional 120 candy. With the 30 we have spare we are looking to buy 170 candy at a cost of 155$.

Some of you will now think. Boy, that’s a lot of money. And yes, it is. But I have to say, at a grand total of 270$ for ALL the high profile rewards, it is very very cheap compared to buying the same value outside of this event.

You get the castle skin, a unique artifact, a khan or Charles, the cosmetics and a bunch of VIP points and other minor stuff. Comparatively, you should be expecting to pay this for a single artifact on a bad day of Triss!

All in all very good value for spenders this Halloween.

Free-to-play gift rewards

As a free-to-play we have very very nice rewards. We are always on the hunt for more Purple Soul Crystals, and this event has quite a few! In addition we can get much needed AP potions and a bunch of speedups and the cosmetic name plate.

You get the free to play currency by farming resources and killing gnomes. Basically play the game and they will come.

You craft it in the event tab and can spend it on sending gifts to your friends. Try find a buddy who needs the same stuff you do, and trade!

The best rewards you should focus on getting are soul crystals, AP potions and if you have anything to spare get speedups. Cosmetics have no impact. But I mean.. if you think it’s worth it go get that too!

title: Harvest Festival 2025 – Full Event Guide & First Impressions
description: The Harvest Festival has arrived in Infinity Kingdom, bringing with it the usual mix of sign-in rewards, special challenges, seasonal shops, and cosmetic skins — but also a few big changes to the event formula.
html:
The Harvest Festival has arrived in Infinity Kingdom, bringing with it the usual mix of sign-in rewards, special challenges, seasonal shops, and cosmetic skins — but also a few big changes to the event formula.

Some of these changes are small but noticeable, others are major — and one in particular (the reworked Treasure Hunter) is already dividing the community.

Let’s break down everything you need to know.

1. Sign-In Rewards – Goodbye Resonant Crystals (for now)

One of the first differences you’ll notice this time is the absence of Resonant Crystals in the sign-in rewards. Instead, they’ve been replaced with Tokens of Light.

If you’ve been hoarding Resonant Crystals, there’s no need to panic — they’ve been cycled out before (such as during Apollo’s release) and returned later in other seasonal events. Chances are we’ll see them again. For now, Tokens of Light are a fine substitute, though they’re not as universally desired.

2. Battle Pass – New Castle Skin “Goddess of Victory”

The seasonal Battle Pass features the Goddess of Victory Castle Skin, which is also upgradable for extra troop HP. While the skin looks great, the upgrade bonus is… underwhelming.

At level 3 (requiring both pass progression and paid tiers), you’ll end up with +3% Troop HP, which feels very very low given the investment. Event at fully upgraded this is a worse combat skin than the base-versions from e.g. Midsummer.

Free-to-play note: It’s possible to get the skin as F2P if you grind hard, but paying the $50 tier will net you 60 fragments from the pass itself and another 30 via Pinnacle Trials (see below), letting you hit level 3 immediately.

3. Glorious Challenge – Play Smart, Farm More Coins

The Glorious Challenge format remains familiar: clear stages, earn Harvest Coins, and spend them in the event shop.

Pro tip: Don’t rush to the hardest stages right away. Work through the easy stages over the first couple of days, then move into Hard Mode later in the event. The coin payout in the later stages (around 240 coins per clear) is much higher, so waiting maximizes your currency per ticket.

4. Pinnacle Trials – Competitive New Mode with Castle Skin Pieces

One of the most exciting additions is the updated Pinnacle Trials. Now, after clearing all stages, you unlock a Trial Ranking mode.

This may end up functioning similarly to Tournament of Survival or Arena rankings, where you can compete for top spots.

Why is this exciting? Because the rewards now include Castle Skin Puzzle Pieces. Even if you don’t rank first, you can slowly stockpile these over multiple events and eventually complete a skin. Hopefully in the future we’ll see a choice chest for these pieces so you can target a specific skin.

5. Celebration Shop – Mostly the Same, Slight Downgrades

The Celebration Shop hasn’t changed much

  • First priority reward is artifacts x3
  • Then Stardust
  • Then Token of Lights
  • Speed ups with whatever is left

Note that with the re-introduction of a Dazzling Wish instead of a Treasure Hunter (albeit slightly new format) the Token of Lights are not worth nearly as much as we saw in previous versions. I would only gem for currency to buy Tokens if you are a big spender. And I would never spend money on these in this version of the event.

Still, it’s the standard seasonal shop formula — nothing game-changing here.

6. The Big Change – Dazzling Wish Replaces Treasure Hunter

The most controversial change in Harvest Festival is the removal of Treasure Hunter and the introduction of a reworked Dazzling Wish system.

This new Dazzling Wish keeps the core “spin for rewards” structure but changes both the prize pool and the odds:

  • Main rewards have just 0.1% drop rate.
  • 60x Chaos Chest at 1%.
  • New artifact fragments now included (a welcome addition).
  • Rotating immortal fragments (likely changing daily between elements).

At first glance, the rewards look better than Treasure Hunter in terms of variety, but the cost is high and the rates for premium prizes are extremely low. This seems targeted toward heavy spenders aiming for the top of the Points Ranking, where whales may choose to skip days to manage their spending.

The event is no longer cross servers and involving many players. Therefore, you are unable to play the event smart and snipe items. This means that the value of this event has dropped through the floor. It is quite terrible efficiency and NOT recommended to participate at all given the bad castle skin rewards and the terrible chances for useful drops.

For F2P and low spenders, it’s questionable whether this system is worth engaging with heavily — the payouts are less predictable than the old Treasure Hunter.

7. Final Thoughts – Worth Your Time?

Positives:

  • Fresh seasonal content with familiar farming loops.
  • Pinnacle Trials revamp looks fun, its something new which is always good. Hopefully next version will have worthwhile rewards.
  • New Artifact fragments in Dazzling Wish are a meaningful addition.

Negatives:

  • Resonant Crystals removed (temporarily).
  • Battle Pass HP bonus is way too small.
  • Dazzling Wish rates and costs feel punishing even for whales.

Overall, Harvest Festival is still worth participating in for the free and steady rewards. I would not on the Dazzling Wish at all, very bad value.

Best bet is to focus on:

  • Maxing Pinnacle Trials for puzzle pieces and pass fragments.
  • Farming Harvest Coins efficiently via Glorious Challenge.
  • Picking your Dazzling Wish spins carefully, only if the daily rewards align with your needs.

title: Cost of Maxing 2024
description: Infinity Kingdom: Deep Dive into the Costs of Maxing the Legendary Hunter Event
html:
Infinity Kingdom: Deep Dive into the Costs of Maxing the Legendary Hunter Event

The Hunting Festival 2024 brings us the Legendary Hunter event, where players can hunt beasts using two types of arrows: free arrows and gem-arrows. Gem-arrows cost 100 gems each and deal 50 points of damage, with a 25% chance to critically hit for an additional 50 damage.

In this guide, we will explore the costs associated with maxing out the Legendary Hunter event using only gem-arrows. This will give you a clear understanding of the maximum price tag for obtaining the amazing artifact rewards offered in the event.

Damage Calculation for Gem-Arrows

Each gem-arrow deals an average of 62.5 damage:

  • Base damage: 50 points
  • Critical hit chance: 25%
  • Critical hit damage: 50 additional points

Average damage calculation: Average Damage=50+(0.25×50)=62.5

Total Damage Required

The total damage required to kill all beasts in the Legendary Hunter event is 30,780 points.

Assuming the beasts had a shared health pool, you need to achieve this damage output to max out the event. Bare in mind, that you WILL overcap on damage on multiple levels even when being careful and using Free to Play arrows to finish off the beasts.

Number of Gem-Arrows Needed

To calculate the number of gem-arrows required: Number of Gem-Arrows = 30,780 points / 62.5 points per arrow ≈ 493 Number of Gem-Arrows.

This is up quite significantly from last year. Last year, we had the HP of levels 17-40 being capped out at 550 HP. This year, that cap has been removed which means that where we had a total of 17,000 HP to shoot through in 2023 we need to get through a massive 30,800 HP in 2024! A huge increase in HP which is why the total arrow count needed this year is a whopping 493 gem-arrows up from just 272 last year.

Read more about the 2023 event here if you want to compare yourself.

Total Gem Cost

Each gem-arrow costs 100 gems. Therefore, the total cost to max out the event using gem-arrows is:
Total Cost = 493 gem-arrows ×100 gems per arrow = 49,300 gems.

Additionally, you need to spend 3,500 gems to unlock the gem reward tier.

Total gem cost to max out the event: 49,300 gems + 3,500 gems = 52,800 gems.

Consideration of Free-to-Play Arrows

While the above calculation is based on using only gem-arrows, it’s important to note that free-to-play arrows are also available. These can be obtained by killing gnomes and participating in other event activities. However, it is unlikely that you will be able to max out the event using only free arrows.

For comparison, last year’s Hunting Festival had a total of 17,000 HP, nearly half of this year’s event, and players still couldn’t complete it for free. Therefore, you should expect to spend at least 30,000-40,000 gems to complete this year’s event, even with the use of free-to-play arrows.

Conclusion

Maxing out the Legendary Hunter event in the Hunting Festival 2024 using only gem-arrows will cost you a substantial amount of 52,800 gems. Given the high cost, it is essential to consider whether the rewards are worth the expenditure. While the artifact rewards are attractive, they may not provide enough value compared to what you could obtain from other in-game activities and events.

For most players, it may be more strategic to save gems for other opportunities and make use of free arrows to progress as far as possible in the event. Balancing your resources and spending wisely will ensure you get the most out of the game without overspending on a single event.

Happy hunting, and may your arrows fly true!

title: Cost of maxing Legendary Hunter (with gems)
description: You can kill beasts as the Legendary Hunter using two kinds of arrows, the free arrows and the gem-arrows. Gem arrows costs 100 gems each and deal 50 points of damage (100 dmg crits with a 25% chance).
html:
You can kill beasts as the Legendary Hunter using two kinds of arrows, the free arrows and the gem-arrows. Gem arrows costs 100 gems each and deal 50 points of damage (100 dmg crits with a 25% chance).

Price tag (gems)

Assuming you want to max this event ONLY with gems, how much would that cost? What is the maximum price tag for the amazing Artifact rewards?

Thanks to player KennyYKX being kind enough to share information on all 40 levels of the Legendary Hunter event tab, we know that the hit points of each level is as follows:

As such, we know that it takes a combined 16,980 points of damage to kill every single beast in the Legendary Hunter if they had a shared health pool. We also know that our Gem Arrows deal 50 damage with a 25% chance to critically hit for 50 additional damage.

The avg. damage of a Gem arrow is thus = 50 + (0,25*50) = 62.5

As as such you need a total of 272 Gem Arrows * 62.5 = 17,000 damage. At a 100 gems a piece that gives you a price tag of 27.2K gems to max out the event + 3500 to unlock the artifact rewards tier. All in all, that gives you a total cost of 30.700 gems to max out this event ONLY using gem arrows.

It should also be noted, that the above is not accounting for free-to-play arrows. You will not be using only gem arrows as you have a very easy way to farm large amounts of normal arrows – kill some gnomes!

However, efficiency will also be bit lower since your realistically will get some ‘lost’ damage from overkils.

Hitting a beast with 10 HP will always make for overkil damage. This calculation does NOT account for that but assumes perfect efficiency which is impossible.

All in all, I expect 25K to be more than enough to ensure you max out and get your artifact reward. Which is a very good price for a unique artifact! These usually cost between 50-150$ to get each!

title: Hunting Festival 2024
description: Infinity Kingdom: Hunting Festival 2024 Player Guide
html:
Infinity Kingdom: Hunting Festival 2024 Player Guide

The Hunting Festival 2024 is in full swing, bringing the usual seasonal event tabs with a mix of old and new rewards. In this guide, we’ll take a deep dive into each of the event tabs, compare the rewards to last year’s event, and provide insights on how to navigate the event efficiently.

Event Overview

Tab 1: Tribal Warrior

The Tribal Warrior tab features the familiar daily quests. Each day, three new quest chains unlock, rewarding you with event currency, gems, and other side rewards. Completing these daily quests earns you Event Points that count towards the five main event chests. Each chest contains Gem-Arrows and Stardust.

Unfortunately, unlike last year, there are no chaos fragments available this year. In 2023, players received Loki fragments for completing these quests. This year, the focus is solely on Stardust and arrows.

Tab 2: Hunting Festival Adventure

The Hunting Festival Adventure tab encourages players to engage in regular gameplay activities such as farming resources and raiding gnomes. Completing these tasks earns you the materials needed to craft free-to-play arrows, which are essential for progressing in the Legendary Hunter tab.

Tab 3: Legendary Hunter

In the Legendary Hunter tab, you use your arrows to hunt and progress through 40 levels on the event bar. The rewards in the free tier are minimal unless you reach level 40, where you can obtain a Unique Artifact. For spenders, there are valuable rewards including Epic Immortal Fragments, Stardust, and a few Crimson Moonlight items. The final reward at level 40 for spenders is 60 fragments for a holy or shadow immortal of your choice, which is quite appealing.

However, this year’s event has a significant change compared to last year. The development team removed the HP cap on levels. Last year, the animals’ HP capped at 550 from level 17 to level 40, making the event challenging but doable with gem-arrows. This year, the HP increases continuously without capping. For instance, at level 27, the HP is 1050, and it increases by 50 HP with each subsequent level. This results in a need for an exorbitant amount of gems to complete the event, making it less rewarding and less feasible to progress without heavy spending.

Overall, I cannot recommend spending the gems to progress through this event for anyone. You can get far more value out of your gems in almost every other activity and event in the game.

Strategy and Recommendations

Tribal Warrior Quests

  • Complete Daily Quests: Make sure to complete the daily quests to earn Event Points and progress towards the main event chests.
  • Focus on Gem-Arrows and Stardust: These are the primary rewards this year, so aim to maximize your gains from these chests.

Hunting Festival Adventure

  • Engage in Regular Activities: Continue farming resources and raiding gnomes to collect the materials needed for crafting arrows.
  • Efficient Farming: If you are going to be raiding gnomes for equipment and gems anyway, it is a good time to do so now, as you gain the arrow materials you will need for the hunting festival’s Legendary Hunter event tab. Get whatever you can from the free arrows and disregard the rest of the Legendary Hunter. It is not worth the gems this year.

Legendary Hunter

  • Maximize Free-to-Play Rewards: Given the high gem cost for progressing, focus on achieving as much as possible with the free-to-play resources.
  • Avoid Heavy Spending: Due to the removal of the HP cap, progressing through the event is significantly more costly. It is advisable to avoid spending large amounts of gems unless you are prepared for the high expenditure.
  • Assess Value: If you are considering spending, weigh the value of the rewards against the cost. The final spender rewards are attractive but ensure they align with your goals and resources.

Read more about completing the Legendary Hunter event here.

Conclusion

The Hunting Festival 2024 offers a mix of rewards, but changes in the event mechanics, particularly the removal of the HP cap, have made it more challenging for players to progress without heavy spending. Focus on maximizing the free-to-play rewards and carefully consider any expenditure in the Legendary Hunter tab. While the event may not be as rewarding as last year’s, strategic play can still yield valuable rewards.

We hope this guide helps you navigate the Hunting Festival 2024 efficiently. Happy hunting, and may your arrows fly true!

html:
Early sneak peak at the coming event!

The upcoming Hunting Festival 2025 is set to introduce a brand-new seasonal event format to Infinity Kingdom, reworking the way players engage with limited-time content. While the event isn’t live yet, early access and test server footage have given us a detailed preview of what to expect. Here’s a comprehensive guide to help you prepare.

Check out the video and see for yourself! In the below you will find my comments and take on this new event format. Note that this is not a released event and as such everything is subject to possible changes before it launches.

🌿 Event Dates

May 14 to May 23, 2025

🌟 Overview: What is the Hunting Festival?

The Hunting Festival revamps the seasonal event format by introducing:

  • A Battle Pass-style progression system
  • A new hunting mechanic tied to Resonance Crystals
  • Chaos and Holy/Shadow rewards depending on your server season
  • Point-based milestone rewards
  • Ranking-based competitive rewards

This event structure is similar in overall flow to previous seasonal formats like the Original Festival and Radiant Festival, but introduces higher-stakes rewards and more engagement opportunities.

🔹 Battle Pass System

The Battle Pass contains 30 levels of rewards split into:

  • Free tier: 1 Resonance Crystal per level
  • Paid tier: 5 Resonance Crystals per level

Unlocking the paid tier also grants more valuable rewards, including additional draw opportunities and milestone rewards.

Key Paid Tier Rewards:

  • Resonance Crystals (5 per level)
  • Ability Stone Selection Chests
  • Chaos Artifact Selection Chests (for Chaos servers)
  • Holy/Shadow Artifact Selection Chests (for early servers)
  • Cao Cao Fragments & Unique Artifact

🛡️ The Hunt Mechanic

Using Resonance Crystals, players can “hunt” to obtain rewards:

  • Chaos Servers:
    • Chaos Unique Artifact Selection Chest
    • Random Chaos Immortal Fragments
    • Jackpot: 80 Chaos Immortal Selection Fragments
  • Non-Chaos Servers (Season 1):
    • Holy/Shadow Artifact Selection Chests
    • Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments

Crystals can be bought in the in-game shop and also via the event shop – also reward from Pinnacle Trials, daily login and battle pass system.

Each hunt also earns Hunting Points, which contribute to milestone rewards and leaderboard ranking.

🔹 Pinnacle Trials as usual

The Pinnacle Trials continues with this new version of seasonal events.

🎉 Milestone Rewards

As you accumulate Hunting Points, you unlock reward thresholds that contain:

  • Chaos (or Holy/Shadow) Immortal Fragments
  • Selection Chests
  • Random Fragments
  • Stardust

You don’t need to reach the final level to earn good rewards—even moderate participation yields excellent value. However, the best rewards (including Chaos Selection Fragments) will likely require completing the Battle Pass and purchasing extra Resonance Crystals.

🥇 Server Rankings & Competitive Rewards

This Hunting Festival introduces a server-wide ranking system based on player performance.

Ranking Rewards Include:

  • Stardust
  • Random Immortal Fragments
  • Ability Stone Selection Chests (contains top-tier skills like Corrosive Power, No Escape, Ambush, and possibly more)

High-ranking players will walk away with significant reward bonuses, making this event very appealing to mid- to high-level spenders.

📊 Strategy Tips

  • Prioritize unlocking the paid Battle Pass for 5x hunting power per level
  • Hoard Gems now if you plan to purchase extra Resonance Crystals
  • If on a Chaos server, focus on drawing Chaos Selection Fragments and Unique Artifacts
  • If on a Season 1 server, take advantage of Holy/Shadow gear and fragments to prepare for Conquest
  • Top up hunting milestones to reach valuable rewards like Ability Stone Selection Chests
  • Watch the rankings and time your spending to secure a leaderboard spot

🔎 Final Thoughts

The Hunting Festival 2025 is shaping up to be one of the most rewarding events to date, with high-value items like Chaos Artifacts, Ability Stones, and massive quantities of Stardust and Immortal Fragments up for grabs. Whether you’re a spender looking for top-tier PvP power or a strategic free-to-play player aiming to optimize progression, this event has something for everyone.

Stay tuned for the live launch on May 14, and make sure to plan your spending and daily logins to maximize your rewards!

title: Hunting Festival 2025 (live) Complete overview and strategy for reward maximization
description: Hunting Festival 2025: Full Event Guide
html:
Hunting Festival 2025: Full Event Guide

The long-anticipated Hunting Festival 2025 has officially launched in Infinity Kingdom, introducing a brand-new event structure. Following our earlier sneak peek guide, we now have full access to all features of the event, and there is plenty to unpack. With an innovative hunting mechanic, new currency systems, ranking competitions, and a unique cosmetic reward system, the event is an ambitious upgrade from previous formats—but not without its controversies.

Sign-In Rewards

This time, the daily login rewards consist exclusively of the new event currency: Resonance Crystals. Players receive 2 crystals per day, amounting to a total of 20 free crystals over 10 days. These are used in the core hunting mechanic described below.

Hunting Season Battle Pass

The battle pass features 30 levels and is split into a free and a paid track:

  • Free Track: Awards only Resonance Crystals, with a total of 60 free crystals.
  • Premium Track: Priced at $50, it includes:
    • One random full Holy/Shadow Immortal
    • 145 Resonance Crystals
    • A large amount of Gems
    • The all-new territory skin: Corridor of Ghost Flame

The skin provides a 2% Troop HP buff and a cosmetic sprite transformation, comparable to the Fourth Anniversary skin. Players need 160 EXP per level to reach the top, with a daily cap of 700 EXP, totaling 7000 EXP over the event. This means a degree of flexibility: you can skip a few days and still finish the pass.

Glorious Challenge

This PvE component has players fight gnome formations in two difficulty tiers:

  • Normal Mode is available from day one.
  • Hard Mode unlocks on day three.

You get five challenge tickets per day, and clearing each stage for the first time gives Souvenir Coins and Gems. Once cleared, you can raid levels for extra coins.

Tip: Always push your highest possible stage! Failing a stage does not consume tickets.

⚠️ Glorious Challenge Tickets – Spend Smart!

During the Hunting Festival event, players can purchase Glorious Challenge tickets in the Celebration Shop using gems. However, it’s crucial to be strategic with these purchases!

These tickets are not permanent—they expire the same day you buy them. If you purchase and use them before Hard Mode is unlocked (on May 17), you’ll be forced to spend them on Normal Mode, which yields significantly fewer rewards.

To maximize your returns:

  • Wait until May 17 when Hard Mode becomes available.
  • Then purchase and use all your gem-bought tickets on Hard Mode stages for the best value in Souvenir Coins and event progression.

Patience here pays off—don’t waste your gems early!

Pinnacle Trial

This is a more advanced version of Glorious Challenge, featuring PvE battles against Immortals with challenging passive skill combinations. You receive one ticket per day and can earn up to 30 Resonance Crystals through first clears. Rewards also include random Immortal Fragments and more Souvenir Coins.

Celebration Shop

This event-exclusive shop lets you trade Souvenir Coins for a wide range of items:

  • New avatar and chat frames
  • Glorious Challenge tickets (limited; wait for Hard Mode)
  • Up to 90 Resonance Crystals (for 18,000 coins)

While it’s tempting to spend early, we advise waiting until Hard Mode opens for better coin efficiency.

🎯 Best Items to Prioritize in the Celebration Shop

For players looking to make the most of their Souvenir Coins, I highly recommend securing both of the full Unique Artifact Selection Chests as well as the 500 Stardust. These offer the best long-term value and progression impact.

Once you’ve claimed those key rewards, your best bet is to spend any leftover currency on:

  • Resonance Crystals (for more chances in the Hunt)
  • The 4x 1-Hour Speedup Chests, which provide solid efficiency for daily development

Stick to these priorities to get the most value from the event!

The Hunt Mechanic

The central feature of the Hunting Festival is the Treasure Hunt. Using Resonance Crystals, you can perform hunts for a chance at top-tier rewards:

  • On Conquest Servers, these include:
    • Chaos Immortal selection chests
    • Random Chaos Immortal Fragments
    • Grand Prize: 80 Chaos Selection Fragments
  • On Non-Chaos Servers, rewards are instead:
    • Holy/Shadow Immortal selections

The prize pool is shared across all servers, meaning competition for Grand Prizes is intense and refreshes every two hours or when all Grand Prizes are claimed.

Rankings and Milestone Rewards

Each Crystal spent = 1 point. There are two ranking systems:

  • Daily Rankings:
    • Top prize: Ability Stone Selection Chest (skills like Corrosive Power, Ambush, No Escape and Guard, Purification and more in season servers where later skills are yet to be unlocked *)
    • Runners-up: Unique Artifact Selection Chests
  • Total Event Rankings:
    • Top rewards: Exclusive Event Frame, Gold Dust, Random Fragments

Additionally, there are Milestone Rewards based on accumulated points, granting Random Chaos (or Holy/Shadow) Fragments.

Note for F2P: You can aim to enter the top 1000 daily or bank your Crystals for a late-event push at the daily leaderboard.

Strategic Hunting: Do not hunt whenever you obtain Crystals. Instead make sure you bank enough to obtain a ranking in the daily rankings that you are satisfied with and try to snipe a ranking by noticing days where rankings are lesser than others. E.g. I expect daily rankings on the 17th where hard mode is unlocked and thus event shop coins explode to be much higher than others.

In-Game Shop Bundles

Bundles range from $3 to $100, offering different value:

  • $3 and $5 bundles: Best return with ~3 Crystals per $1.
  • $50 Bundle: Includes Crystals, Philosopher Stones, and an exclusive Avatar Frame.

Total spenders can collect hundreds of Crystals and dominate the event’s Hunt and Rankings. 

Summary & Final Thoughts

The Hunting Festival 2025 is a reimagined event format with a fresh approach to PvE challenges, cosmetic rewards, and battle pass progression. However, the shared prize pool system and emphasis on spending make it difficult for free-to-play or light spenders to compete for top-tier prizes.

Still, everyone can earn decent rewards through milestone progression, PvE stages, and by planning Crystal spending wisely. The new Corridor of Ghost Flame skin and Battle Pass structure represent a meaningful evolution of seasonal content in Infinity Kingdom.

Our recommendation:

  • F2P/Low Spenders: Focus on completing PvE stages and accumulating Crystals to make a focused push on the daily leaderboard.
  • Moderate Spenders: The $50 Battle Pass provides solid return with Crystals, cosmetic skins, and value rewards.
  • Whales: Compete in rankings for Ability Stones and the Grand Prize jackpot in the Hunt.

Happy hunting, Lords! May your Crystals bring you glory—and Chaos.

☀️ A Sunny Season with Familiar Shadows

Running from July 11 to July 20, the Midsummer Festival 2025 marks the return of Infinity Kingdom’s full-format seasonal celebration. Following in the footsteps of recent events like Spring Fiesta and Children’s Day, this festival keeps the same structure while offering new cosmetics, rewards, and chaos progression opportunities.

This event looks bright and breezy on the surface—open fields, summery themes—but underneath, it’s a strategic event with meaningful long-term implications. With PvE trials, premium reward tiers, chaos immortal fragments, and an upgradeable castle skin, this is a high-stakes, high-value event worth digging into.

📝 Sign-In Rewards – Simple, Solid, Worth the Tap

Each day you log in, you get 2 Resonance Crystals. Over the event’s duration, that’s a guaranteed 20 free Crystals. No strings attached, no tasks to complete. Just log in, tap, and bank progress.

🏰 Celebration Pass – New Skin, Familiar Strategy

The Celebration Pass follows the same 30-level structure as before. You complete up to 7 daily missions to earn EXP. You’ll need 7,000 EXP in total to finish the pass, which is easily achievable in 6–7 days.

Free Track:

  • 60 Resonance Crystals

Premium Track ($49.99):

  • 145 Resonance Crystals
  • 6,000 Gems
  • 60 Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments
  • New Skin: Abyssal Temple (Upgradeable Castle Skin)

Abyssal Temple Skin:

  • Base effect: +5% Troop ATK, -3% Death Rate
  • Max upgrade (Level 10): +15% ATK, -6% Death Rate

This skin is a Poseidon-themed upgradeable castle skin—expected to replace or surpass the previous Children’s Day skin with better combat stats and an oceanic visual overhaul.

🧠 If you’re missing an upgradable castle skin or a +Troop ATK bonus, this one is a must. Compared to the Skyriver Palace (which increases Physical and Magical ATK), the universal Troop ATK on Abyssal Temple is more versatile and impactful across all compositions.

⚔️ Glorious Challenge – Smart Timing, Solid Coins

This PvE challenge gives you 5 tickets daily. The rewards are Radiance Marks, the primary event currency.

  • Normal Mode is available from Day 1
  • Hard Mode unlocks on Day 3 i.e. the 14th of july 2025.

🧠 Don’t spend gems on tickets until Hard Mode unlocks. Maximize your returns.

🧱 Pinnacle Trial – One Daily Try, Always Worth It

Each day, you get one free challenge attempt. Win and you unlock:

  • 18 Resonance Crystals
  • Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments
  • Random Immortal Fragments
  • A PvE node to farm for 24h

No entry cost. No risk.

🧠 Free value with scaling rewards. Try every day. The top PvE setups benefit most, but everyone wins.

💎 Treasure Hunter – Ares, Skins, and the Spending Dilemma

This gacha-style Crystal draw event lets you:

  • Spend Crystals to open chests
  • Compete in daily leaderboards
  • Snipe rewards like Immortal fragments and skin shards

Major Rewards:

  • Ares Chaos Immortal Fragments
  • Abyssal Temple Skin Fragments
  • Epic Immortal Selection Chests

Pools refresh every 2 hours unless a top-tier reward is drawn.

Leaderboard Rewards:

  • 1st: 60 Abyssal Temple Fragments
  • 2nd: 36 Fragments
  • 3rd: 24 Fragments
  • 4th–10th: 12 Fragments each

This system mirrors past events but adds wider access to skin shards. Still, the cost of maxing the skin remains extremely high—requiring top-3 placements multiple days in a row.

🧠 Casual players should avoid this unless sniping a low day late in the event. This feature remains whale territory.

🛒 Celebration Store – Pick Power Over Shine

Your Radiance Marks are best spent on power. Prioritize:

  • 500 Stardust
  • Artifact Selection Chests (x3)
  • 90 Resonance Crystals

Optional:

  • Cosmetic items
  • Crystal bundles (unless focused on Chaos)

🧠 Same strategy as always—Stardust and Artifacts have long-term value. Avoid cosmetics unless you’re already maxed out elsewhere.

💰 Bundles & Spending – Small Buys, Big Wins

  • $2.99 / $4.99: Excellent value
  • $9.99–$19.99: Diminishing returns
  • $49.99: Worth it only for skin collectors or high-end players

🧠 if you’re spending, go for the Pass and 1–2 cheap bundles. Skip mid-tier packs unless you’re all-in.

🧠 Final Take – Seasonal Event, Strategic Impact

The Midsummer Festival 2025 sticks to the proven formula but continues layering premium power behind upgradable cosmetics and Chaos progression. It’s effective, rewarding, and increasingly demanding.

🟢 Free-to-Play:

  • Log in daily
  • Clear PvE modes
  • Max the pass
  • Spend Marks on Stardust and Artifacts

🟡 Light Spenders:

  • Buy the Celebration Pass
  • Add a $3–$5 bundle
  • Save Crystals, try Treasure Hunter on a quiet day

🔴 Whales:

  • Everything’s here: Chaos, Cosmetics, Castle Skins
  • Compete for Ares, max the Abyssal Temple, dominate the rankings

This event is generous, strategic, and polished—but also reminds us how steep the curve is getting for full progression. For most players, the best gains come from planning, not spending.

html:
The 2025 Original Festival has arrived in Infinity Kingdom, bringing with it a vibrant and rewarding event that coincides with Easter and the beauty of spring. This guide walks you through the full event, which runs from Friday, April 18 to Sunday, April 27. There’s a lot to earn, and depending on your server progression, some rewards are more valuable than others. Let’s take a detailed look at what this event has to offer!

💠 Overview

The event is split into several parts: daily sign-in rewards, a battle-pass-style system, PvE challenges, and a lucky draw system. This format is identical to recent seasonal events such as the Fourth Anniversary Festival and Goddess Festival. Players of all spending levels can find value here, but some parts of the event hold more weight depending on whether you’re on a Chaos or non-Chaos server.

💠 Sign-in Rewards

The easiest part of the event—just sign in each day to claim free gifts. In total, players can receive up to 800 Gems and 5 Tokens of Light over 10 days. These Tokens are used in the Dazzling Wish feature.

💠 Thriving Spirit Battle Pass

This battle pass offers 30 levels of rewards and two tiers: free and premium.

Free Tier:

  • 6 Tokens of Light
  • Speedups and other useful materials

Premium Tier ($49.99):

  • 10 Tokens of Light
  • 6,000 Gems
  • 60 Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments
  • Permanent Castle Skin: Mt. Paradise (2% Troop HP, 5% Marching Speed)

While the castle skin is attractive, its effect is inferior to previous skins like City of Glory or Goddess of Victory. If you’re choosing between purchases and already have a good skin, you may want to skip this pass unless you want the Tokens or visuals.

Leveling Tips:

You earn 50 EXP per task (8 daily), and each level needs 150 EXP. You need 4,500 EXP to complete the pass, so 90 tasks are required out of 120 total. Prioritize tasks wisely, especially those that require Tokens of Light (like Dazzling Wish draws).

💠 Glorious Challenge

These are short PvE missions similar to the Well of Time. Each completed level gives Gems and Wondrous Coins.

  • Normal Mode (unlocks day 1): Levels 1–16, easy to complete for most players
  • Hard Mode (unlocks day 3): More difficult, similar to Elite Well of Time

Each level also allows raid mode after completing it. You get 5 free attempts daily, and only successful attempts are consumed. Save purchased attempts (up to 35 for 3,000 Gems) for Hard Mode.

💠 Pinnacle Trial

Pinnacle Trials are tougher challenges—1 attempt per day, with no extra purchases allowed. The rewards are very high:

  • 50 Random Immortal Fragments
  • 48 Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments
  • 5 Tokens of Light

The later stages are quite difficult for non-spenders, but you can raid earlier stages for some guaranteed value. Focus on Holy/Shadow Fragments unless you’re aiming for Tokens of Light to target Dazzling Wish.

💠 Dazzling Wish

This is a lucky draw mechanic where you spend Tokens of Light for powerful rewards. Each draw has a chance of earning Chaos-related items, fragments, or other high-value prizes.

Free and Paid Tokens:

  • You can get around 31 free Tokens from events.
  • The Battle Pass adds 10 more.
  • Additional Tokens cost $2 each across several bundle options.

IMPORTANT: Server Differences

  • Non-Chaos Servers (Season 1–3): The main reward here is the 60x Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragment Box.
  • Chaos Servers: This is the only current way to unlock Apollo, a top-tier Chaos Immortal. For spenders, chasing Apollo through Dazzling Wish is the long-term goal.

New to this event are Ability Stone Selection Chests (Chaos Storm, Blood Frenzy, Psionic Tide) which slightly increase the value of draws.

Still, with Chaos chest rates under 4%, this is not recommended for non-spenders. Even spenders may want to consider if chasing Apollo is worth the cost.

💠 Celebration Shop

You can trade in Wondrous Coins (earned through Glorious Challenge) for valuable items.

Priority Purchases:

  • 15 Tokens of Light
  • Wizard of Oz Avatar Frame
  • Mushroom Chatbox
  • 2x Artifact Selection Chests
  • 500 Stardust

These rewards total 16,700 Coins. By completing all Normal Mode stages and raiding them daily, you can earn about 9,540 coins—more if you tackle Hard Mode.

Skip the Tokens if needed to afford Artifact Chests and Stardust first. Any extras can go toward speedups or resource chests.

💠 Summary

This year’s Original Festival 2025 has maintained and even improved on previous formats.

  • Non-spenders should focus on Stardust, free Tokens, and Artifact Chests.
  • Spenders have better value than ever from the Battle Pass.
  • Chaos servers benefit most from Dazzling Wish thanks to Apollo.
  • Cosmetic rewards like frames and skins are plentiful for collectors.

With tasks spread out over 10 days and minimal pressure to spend, this event continues to be one of the most rewarding seasonal activities in the game. Make the most of it!

Stay tuned to IK-Wiki and official channels for updates—and good luck in your wishes!

html:
Player Guide: Navigating the “Original Festival” Event in Infinity Kingdom

The “Original Festival” is the latest seasonal event in Infinity Kingdom, featuring a familiar format with exciting opportunities to earn unique rewards through daily quests and event-specific activities. This guide will walk you through the event tabs, strategies for maximizing your rewards, and recommendations to get the most out of this event.

Event Structure and Key Activities

1. Wonderous Celebration: Daily Quests

This tab is your go-to throughout the seven-day event. Completing the daily quests not only yields valuable rewards like 40 stardust and 30 Original Crystals but also provides Paint Brushes needed for the Colorful Party tab.

Strategies:

  • Ensure completion of daily quests to accumulate Paint Brushes.
  • Focus on maximizing your daily rewards to build towards larger event goals.

2. Surprise Original Festival: Farmable Currency

While not a separate event tab, this aspect encourages players to engage in regular activities such as defeating gnomes and gathering resources to earn Floral Coins, whimsically referred to as Bunny Coins due to their appearance.

Tips:

  • Regular participation in standard game activities is crucial to maximize your earnings of Floral Coins.

3. Colorful Party: Progress Through Painting

Use the Paint Brushes from daily quests to unlock rewards across 20 levels in three tiers: Free, 3.5K Gem Tier, and $20 Tier. Rewards include speedups, philosopher stones, resources, and notably, Original Crystals.

Rewards Breakdown:

  • Free Tier: 3 Original Crystals
  • Gem Tier: 12 Original Crystals
  • $20 Tier: 45 Original Crystals

Recommendation:

  • Invest in the $20 tier if feasible, as it significantly increases your total haul of Original Crystals, vital for purchasing top-tier rewards.

4. Redeem Event Tab: Exchanging Event Currency

This tab is where you spend Original Crystals for high-value items like Unique Artifacts and Chaos Immortal fragments.

In total completing the Wonderous Celebration daily quests and the free, gem and 20$ tier of the Colorful Party will net you a total of 90 Original Crystals. This is important to know for the fourth event tab, because this is the Redeem Event tab where we spend currency in exchange for the main event rewards.

First of all you want to make sure you farm enough free currency to get the 100 stardust and the 10x Philosopher’s chests. If you need epic immortals, you should go ahead and get the 60 fragments too. The rest of your free currency should be used to get as many speed ups as possible.

For the Original Crystal rewards, you can buy 80 chaos immortal fragments for 130 crystals and you can get four unique artifacts (they are in selection chests as normal) for 38 crystals per unique artifact.

If you are after one of the unique artifacts, you can get your 38 crystals by simply competing the daily quests and spending 3.5K gems on the coloring event. That’s a full Unique Artifact for just 3500 gems, very cheap and very good value!

If you are after the Chaos Immortal Fragments you are in need of additional crystals. You got a total of 90 crystals by completing the event and buying the 20$ reward tier in the coloring tab. You need 40 more which you have to obtain through the event bundles in the shop.

The bundles are DAILY bundles which is very good because it means you can get higher value out of them by buying the more efficient bundles every day. For 10$ you get 5 crystals, for 20$ you get 10 crystals, for 50$ you get 15 crystals. As you can see, the first two bundles are better value at 2$ per crystal whereas the 50$ bundle is only for those who need to buy everything (no one… don’t do it!) as it costs you 3.33$ per crystal here.

Getting your last 40 crystals needed for the chaos immortal fragments you want to spend the required 80$ on these bundles in addition to the 20$ on the coloring event for a total of 100$ for 80 chaos immortal fragments. You can do this in three days by buying the 10$ and the 20$ on first two days and the last 20$ needed on the third day of the event. This is a very good price, in line with previous seasonal events and a huge recommendation for anyone with any chaos ambition. This is much better value than the normal chaos event roulette, so you wanna do this if you are building up a chaos immortal.

Recommendations: If you are thinking of going two artifacts unlocked you need 76 Crystals which is less than the 90 you get from the event so just buy the coloring 20$ tier and you get two full unique artifacts for just 20$! Very nice. If you need a third, you should think again. You are going to need 24 more crystals which you gotta spend 50$ on, I would not do that to be honest, the value here is not very good. So if you are after artifacts stick to the cheap 2 artifacts.

Optimal Usage:

  • Stardust and Philosopher’s Chests: Prioritize these if you need to enhance your immortals’ capabilities.
  • Chaos Immortal Fragments: Requires 130 Original Crystals for 80 fragments. Consider purchasing the $20 coloring event tier and additional bundles to meet the crystal requirement.
  • Unique Artifacts: Obtainable for 38 Original Crystals each. If targeting two artifacts, simply completing the event and buying the $20 tier suffices.

In summation

The event introduces daily bundles that offer Original Crystals, providing an efficient way to reach your desired crystal count for top rewards:

  • $10 Bundle: 5 crystals
  • $20 Bundle: 10 crystals
  • $50 Bundle: 15 crystals

Budgeting for Chaos Immortal Fragments:

  • To acquire the necessary 40 additional crystals for the Chaos Immortal fragments, spending $80 on bundles over three days is recommended, supplemented by the $20 spent on the Colorful Party.

Artifact Acquisition:

  • For two artifacts, the expenditure of $20 for the Colorful Party suffices.
  • Pursuing a third artifact requires an additional 24 crystals, which may not offer the best value at $50.

Conclusion

The “Original Festival” provides a structured pathway to significant rewards through engaging daily activities and strategic spending. By focusing on the efficient completion of daily quests and smart allocation of resources towards the Colorful Party and bundles, players can optimize their gains and significantly enhance their gameplay experience in Infinity Kingdom.

html:
🐼 Kung Fu Festival Event (2025)

Seasonal Event • Theme: Panda / Martial Arts • Duration: 10 Days

Infinity Kingdom’s latest seasonal event brings a fresh spin to the usual lineup — a full Kung Fu Panda-inspired theme featuring bamboo-decorated menus, martial arts motifs, and even a castle skin with a literal panda!

Gameplay-wise, it follows the same familiar structure as other seasonal events like the Harvest Festival or Midsummer Celebration: you’ve got your Glory Challenge, Pinnacle Trial, Dashing Wish, and the Seasonal Shop. The big difference this time is the addition of the Lucky Koi Lottery — a $5 entry system with a jackpot prize of 4,000 Insignias.

Event Structure & Main Rewards

1. Glory Challenge

Classic event structure. Normal mode runs first, then Hard Mode unlocks around Day 4.
Waiting to spend credentials until Hard Mode is available is the smart move — each raid there gives roughly 250+ points, letting you nearly clear the shop by the end of the event.

2. Pinnacle Trial

Completing all Pinnicle Trials missions grants 30 Skyriver Palace fragments, and another 30 fragments come from the Battle Pass. That’s 60 total fragments, enough to unlock or upgrade one of the best all-purpose castle skins in the game.

Skyriver Palace is still one of the top PvP skins, mainly because of its strong offensive combat buffs, making this a great time to upgrade it. In my opinion, Abyssal Palace currently holds the crown — its Troop Attack buff is the most powerful overall. Right behind it, I’d put Sun Chariot, not just for its defensive stats but for the marching speed boost that lets you outmaneuver opponents so easily. That extra mobility can completely change how fights play out. Because of that, I’d rank Skyriver’s in third place overall for me personally and how I play, but in terms of pure combat buffs it sits comfortably in second place. Also, don’t forget Skyriver’s utility bonus: -3% death rate, which helps conserve troops over long battles — a small but valuable perk.

3. Battle Pass (Kung Fu Master Edition)

This one’s visually stunning — dojo rooftops, lantern glow, swirling mist, and a meditating panda on the balcony.

The Kung Fu Master castle skin does technically have combat buffs, but it’s nowhere near competitive compared to the top-tier options. Its +3% Troop HP at max level gives only a small survivability boost, and while the +15% March Speed is nice for repositioning or farming, it doesn’t really help in serious PvP fights.

In practice, this skin just doesn’t move the needle like Abyssal Palace’s attack buff, Sun Chariot’s defensive + mobility combo, or even Skyriver Palace’s offensive setup. It’s mainly a collector’s or style skin — great visuals, fun theme, but not something you’d equip when power matters. Think of it as more of a “flex” piece than a performance skin.

But when it comes to stats, it’s more for collectors than for combat:

That +3% HP at max level is among the weakest buffs for any combat skin. The +15% march speed is handy for farming or repositioning, but not impactful in PvP.

If you’re going for efficiency, buy the pass for the Skyriver Palace fragments, not for the Kung Fu Master stats.

🎟️ New Feature — Lucky Koi Lottery

As with previous seasonal events, we have a daily login and get a reward. The Daily Sign-in is bundles in with the new Lucky Koi feature. Here we get 10x Token of Light to be spent in the Dazzling Wish.

This is the big new feature of the event.

  • Entry costs $5 USD per ticket.
  • Each ticket gives some gems as a baseline reward and a chance to win 4,000 Insignias.
  • Every player gets one free ticket daily via login rewards.

At the time of writing, there were roughly 3,317 participants per bracket and only one jackpot winner per bracket, so the odds are around 1 in 3,000. Not amazing, but not real-world lottery bad either.

If you hit the jackpot, 4,000 Insignias equals:

  • ~400 Chaos Immortal fragments, or
  • 3 full Chaos Artifacts (with currency left over).

Realistically, the gem value already makes the $5 ticket not a total waste, but it’s definitely more of a fun gamble than a smart investment.

Speculation

While not confirmed, it looks like Lucky Koi might become a recurring feature. It’s integrated directly into the daily login tab, which to me signals a new-permanent addition rather than a one-off. Usually I find they make a standalone mini-event for none-recurrent elements. But no way to know! Here’s hoping it sticks around — it adds a fun little surprise each day if you are inclined to participate in the lottery!

Event Shop Highlights

  • Panda Chat Box: Bamboo-styled frame with an ink-brush aesthetic. Very clean look.
  • Panda Frame: Simple, thematic, and looks great with most avatars.
  • Make sure to get: Artifact Fragment Chests / Stardust / Speedups: In that priority order.
  • Cosmetics + Resources: Grab these last if you’ve got spare currency.

Tip: Save your credentials until Hard Mode opens — this gives better efficiency and makes it possible to nearly clear the entire shop by event end.

💫 Dazzling Wish

The Dazzling Wish tab is the event’s gacha-style feature, where you spend Tokens of Light to draw for a wide range of rewards. It’s flashy, fun, and filled with tempting jackpots — but like all luck-based draws in IK, the odds are rough.

🎁 Reward Pool & Drop Rates

Here’s the official breakdown of rewards and their drop chances:

  • 🎯 0.05% – 60x Kung Fu Master Castle Skin Fragments (headline jackpot, but not that valuable since the Battle Pass already gives a full unlock)
  • ⚡ 0.45% – 80x Chaos Immortal Selection Chests ← the real jackpot
  • 🗡️ 0.6% – 60x Unique Artifact Chaos Selection Chests ← also top-tier reward
  • 💥 2.5% – 5x Chaos Immortal Selection Chests
  • ⚙️ 3% – 5x Unique Artifact Chaos Selection Chests
  • 🔮 6% – 1x Random Chaos Immortal Fragment
  • 🌑 7.4% – 1x Random Holy or Shadow Immortal Fragment
  • 💧 10% – Water Artifact Selection Chest
  • 🌍 10% – Random Earth Immortal Fragment
  • 🐉 10% – Eternal Dragon Soul Chest (10x Holy or Shadow Crystals)
  • 🌪️ 10% – Random Wind Immortal Fragment
  • 💎 10% – Precious Dragon Crystal Selection Chest (30x regular elements or 20x wind)
  • 📜 10% – Artifact Schematic Fragment Selection Chest
  • 🔥 10% – Random Fire Immortal Fragment
  • ⚡ 10% – Random Lightning Immortal Fragment

💎 Real Jackpot Value

While the castle skin fragments headline the list, the real jackpots here are definitely the Chaos Immortal and Unique Artifact Chaos fragment bundles. Pulling either of those gives serious account value — but they’re both extremely rare. With only 0.45% and 0.6% odds, you’ll need a whole lot of luck to hit one.

At a $1–$2 cost per Token of Light, here’s the math:

  • Expected cost per 80 Chaos Immortal fragments = ~$222 total spins on average.
  • That’s roughly $2.78 per fragment if you’re buying the cheaper token packs, or $5.56 per fragment with the expensive ones.

So yeah — not efficient at all unless RNG smiles on you.

💰 Token of Light Purchase Options

Tokens of Light can be bought from multiple bundles during the event:

  • Profile Picture Bundle: 25 tokens for $50 (once per event)
  • Daily Bundles:
    • 4 stock × 3 tokens for $3 each
    • 6 stock × 5 tokens for $5 each
    • 8 stock × 8 tokens for $10 each
    • 10 stock × 12 tokens for $20 each
    • 12 stock × 30 tokens for $50 each
    • 20 stock × 60 tokens for $100 each

Bundles on the GTarcade App are identical — so no discount this time. However, buying on both platforms effectively doubles your daily purchase cap, which is great if you’re trying to whale hard for leaderboard rewards.

🏆 Ranking System

Just like other seasonal wish events, Dazzling Wish includes a ranking board that resets daily. The top spenders each day earn extra Skyriver Castle Fragments, which can be huge if you’re already investing heavily. It’s a nice bonus for whales but requires you to outspend your bracket to secure the rewards.

Player Perspective

Visually, this might be the coolest seasonal event IK’s done in a while. The Kung Fu Master castle skin is incredible and visually I must have it.

What I will do:

  • I will get the Battle Pass for Skyriver Palace fragments and the cool Panda skin for my collection.
  • I will buy one or two Lucky Koi ticket just for the thrill (the gem value softens the loss).
  • I will make sure to empty the shop for artifacts and stardust.
  • I will not be buying Token of Lights, the pricing to rank is far out of my budget.
