title: Beginners Guide: Everything about server migration
description: Migration in Infinity Kingdom is a significant decision that can shape your experience in the game. Whether you’re looking for a more competitive environment, better allies, or just a fresh start, moving to a new server requires planning and preparation.
html:
Migration in Infinity Kingdom is a significant decision that can shape your experience in the game. Whether you’re looking for a more competitive environment, better allies, or just a fresh start, moving to a new server requires planning and preparation.

This guide will walk you through the essential aspects of migration, from obtaining portals to understanding server restrictions, and help you decide whether relocating is the right move for you.

Understanding Migration

What is Migration?

Migration allows players (Lords) to transfer their accounts from one server to another. This can be beneficial for finding a stronger alliance, joining friends, or escaping an inactive server. However, migration comes with costs, requirements, and risks.

Why Migrate?

  • Stronger Competition: Some players prefer to migrate to more competitive servers to improve their skills and face greater challenges.
  • Better Alliances: Your current alliance may be weak or inactive, prompting you to seek a more organized and active group.
  • Server Wars and Strategy: Winning Legion of Frostborn wars can be easier on certain servers, depending on power balance and alliances.
  • Reuniting with Friends: Many players migrate to join friends or follow their alliance.

Basics – the right portal
There are two versions of the Portal item, the purple version only works for players of low level. What you need it the Epic version and you need quite a few depending on your Power. More on that later. For now, just know that you are looking for this!

How to Migrate

1. Understanding Portal Requirements

Portals are required to migrate, and the number you need depends on your maximum achieved Lord power. Your current power doesn’t matter—what matters is the highest power you have ever reached.

Portal Cost Based on Power Level

Reducing Power for Migration

If your power is close to the next portal threshold, consider:

  • Removing Dragons from Marches: Dragons increase power but aren’t necessary for farming.
  • Using Low-Level Immortals for Farming: Keep different elements to avoid extra power boosts.
  • Avoiding Upgrades Before Migration: Holding off on major upgrades can keep your power lower before moving.

OBS: Migration Power Limits AND the number of Portals you need to migrate is ONLY based on your Maximum Historical Power. As such, you cannot remove dragons to drop below a threshold once you surpassed it. You can however, reduce your power in order to keep growing while you collect portals without reaching the next threshold.

Important: If you increase your power beyond a threshold, your portal cost will also increase. Plan ahead!

2. Acquiring Portals

There are several ways to obtain portals:

Free-to-Play Methods

Alliance Coin Shop:

  • Portals cost 20,000 alliance coins each.
  • Coins can be earned by:
    • Constructing alliance cities.
    • Donating to alliance technology.
    • Donating to alliance-occupied cities in Legion of Frostborn.

    Mini-Events:

    • Occasionally, the game provides portals through events and login rewards.

      Paid Methods

      • Special Bundles: Available in the shop for real money.
      • Weekly Portal Bundles: Post-Legion of Frostborne seasons often feature double-value Portal bundles, providing an opportune moment for spenders to stock up on Portals at a more economical rate. Prices range from $5 to $100, with the number of Portals increasing with the bundle’s value:
      • $5 pack – 1 portal
      • $10 pack- 2 portals
      • $20 pack – 3 portals
      • $50 pack – 4 portals
      • $100 pack – 5 portals

      Golden Path – huge value for your money

      For just 50 Merit Coins you collect a portal with a seasonal cap of 10. I would recommend anyone to collect all 10 until you have a bank – just in case you want to migrate later. There are not many things worse than playing in a server you do not want to be in.

      3. Checking Server Restrictions

      You have decided to migrate, you are on your way to collect portals or maybe you already finished collecting and are ready to find a new home – but you can’t get in? There are limitations to migration that you must understand.

      Each server has different migration conditions depending on the season and leadership:

      • Season 1: Lower power cap for migration.
      • Season 2: Increased power cap and improved rewards.
      • Season 3+: Free migration between non-war servers.
      • Conquest Season: No return to previous seasons, only migration within conquest servers.
      • Power Limits: Some servers restrict migration based on Lord power; you may need approval from leadership.

      Server Migration Conditions which restrict migration coming into a server is set by the King of the server, i.e. the player who has been crowned King by the winning Alliance during the most recent Contention of Relics.

      5. Planning and Coordination

      • Start Saving Early: Gathering portals can take months, so plan ahead.
      • Scout Your Target Server: Create a small account to check activity and leadership.
      • Communicate with the Server Leadership: Ensure they will accept you and your alliance.
      • Ensure Your Team is Ready: Migration is easier with a strong, coordinated group.

      Pros and Cons of Migration

      Pros:

      ✔️ Find a stronger alliance and community.
      ✔️ Experience better competition.
      ✔️ Improve rewards and growth opportunities.
      ✔️ Escape dead or toxic servers.
      ✔️ Join friends or reunite with old allies.

      Cons:

      ❌ Gathering portals is time-consuming.
      ❌ Leaving friends behind can be difficult.
      ❌ New server dynamics can be unpredictable.
      ❌ Risk of not being accepted into alliances.
      ❌ Higher power might mean a more expensive migration.

      Final Thoughts

      Migration is a big decision in Infinity Kingdom, and it requires preparation and strategy. Whether you’re a free-to-play player or a spender, planning ahead will ensure a smoother transition. Consider the costs, research the server you’re moving to, and work with your alliance to make the best choice for your growth and enjoyment in the game.

      Happy gaming, and may your migration lead you to victory!

Follow the tuturial. It is pretty well done, and will get you a short intro to everything. The tutorial in Infinity Kingdom is pretty self-explanatory and well done. You will have a decent idea of what this game is about once you complete it.

As you progress through the tutorial you are introduced to building your castle, fighting gnomes, summoning Immortals. These are the key elements to Infinity Kingdom, as well as the PvP that will be introduced later on.

Below you find a comprehensive list of all things you need to know from level 0-5 in Infinity Kingdom. I have made the list and sub-pages in chronological order based on when you can/should learn something. As such, it follows the tutorial as closely as possible.

Main take-away’s from level 0-5

  1. Right off the bat you are being exposed to the in-game shop which promotes “recommended Immortals” to purchase amongst many other things which will be extreemly confusing to a brand new player – what to buy and should I even buy? Moreover, there are a few key free-to-play rewards from the shop function that you want to take advantage of right as you being playing.
    Read the article: Beginner Bundles & Free swag
  2. The Tuturial gets right down to brass tax – what this game is all about: City building. You want to build and keep building at alle times. Read the article: Beginner Building with builders
  3. You are quickly faced with gnomes inside your castle territory, these must be booted out, and to do so the tutorial helps you summon a powerful Immortal (or two).
    Read the article: Beginner Summoning and Philosopher Stones
  4. One of the last things you learn going into level 5 is attacking gnomes on the map.
    Read the article: Beginner Gnome Raider
    and the article: Beginner Power up Immortals
  5. At castle level 5 where we end this guide, you unlock the Dragon Lair. Here you hatch and develop your dragons, which are a key part of your armies. Read the article: Beginner Dragon Trainer
  6. Finally, at level 5 you unlock your very first Lord Talent Point. Talents are very important for your growth and later provides strong boosts for combat encounters (PvE and PvP).
    Read the article: Beginning Talented Talenting

A bit more you should know …

While this is not a comprehensive list of what you are doing during the tutorial, it is what I feel are the most important things to take-away and make sure you have understood. If you are aware and understand these four things, you are off to a decent beginning.

In addition to the more in-depth explanations offered in the sub-articles referenced above, I have some general tips and tricks for you to consider while you do the tuturial.

Tips and tricks

  • Always keep your builders busy and always buy the temporary builder with gems or alliance coins.
  • Always produce troops. You want to always keep your barracks training new troops. If you reach the cap (you shouldn’t) delete troops and keep cooking. This is because there are key quests later in the game based on how many troops you have trained, these quests yield EXP which you need to set talents (level 5+). In the beginning you want to spend all of your training speed ups on training fast for these quests.
  • Always keep your AP nice and low.
  • Scout ruins without scout downtime. Nice rewards for no effort once you read my coords guide.
    Find all coords for every ruin in the game here.
  • Spend your speedups. Untill level 10-15+ you do not want a single speedup resting in your inventory. Spend them as fast as you can, just remember to get alliance help before completing buildings. Speed builds, troops and tech (later) as hard as you can.
  • Spend your EXP scrolls and upgrade Immortal equipment. You should always spend EXP scrolls and improve equipment when you have materials. No reason to hold on to any of it, since you can reborn an Immortal and get back 100% EXP in new scrolls + all materials and gold spent upgrading and boosting. This is available later in the Alchemy Lab, don’t worry about it for now and just upgrade everything you can.

Conclusion

Basically, you should try to have as low downtime on everything as possible to progress fast through the lower levels. Spend every ressource, speedup, EXP scroll, boost-material, buff, enchant stone, etc. DO NOT STOCKPILE untill you reach atleast Castle level 30.

There are much to learn about Infinity Kingdom, but if I were to sum up how to grow fast and grow right I would say: It is actually pretty simple, just remove downtime as much as you can. Send builders on long builds while you are not playing, build small quick buildings while you are online. Always zero your AP, SP, etc. Keep armies farming ressource nodes once you are offline (you will learn later).

title: How to get MUCH cheaper higher tier soldiers
description: In Infinity Kingdom, unlocking higher-tier troops is a critical milestone for boosting your army’s power. html:
In Infinity Kingdom, unlocking higher-tier troops is a critical milestone for boosting your army’s power. However, it comes at a steep cost, as training higher-tier troops requires significantly more resources and time. This guide will show you how to efficiently upgrade to new troop tiers while minimizing resource expenditure.

Understanding Troop Tiers

Why Troop Tiers Matter

Each new tier of troops comes with higher base stats, making them much stronger than their lower-tier counterparts. Unlocking new tiers can significantly enhance your performance in PvE and PvP battles. However, higher-tier troops are also much more expensive to train, both in terms of resources and time.

The Upgrade Trick

Here’s a key mechanic to save resources when transitioning to higher troop tiers:

Automatic Troop Upgrade

When your barracks upgrades to unlock a new troop tier, all existing troops of the lower tier automatically upgrade to the new tier. This process is instantaneous and does not consume additional resources. For example:

  • If you have 10,000 Tier 1 troops and upgrade your barracks to unlock Tier 2, those 10,000 troops are immediately converted to Tier 2.

This mechanic allows you to bypass the high resource cost of directly training higher-tier troops.

Step-by-Step Strategy

1. Train Troops Before Upgrading

  • Use all available troop training speedups and focus on producing as many lower-tier troops as possible before upgrading your barracks.
  • Aim to completely fill your training grounds with lower-tier troops.

2. Upgrade Your Barracks

  • Once your training grounds are filled and your barracks is ready to upgrade, proceed with the upgrade to unlock the next troop tier.
  • All lower-tier troops will instantly convert to the higher tier upon completion.

3. Redirect Resources

  • The resources saved can now be used for other essential upgrades, such as your castle, technology research, or dragon enhancements.

Example Calculation

Let’s have a look at how much we are saving every time we hit that training button using this method of training Tier 1 troops before upgrading to Tier 2:

  • Resource Cost for Tier 1 Troops: 2700 + 1080 + 540 + 900 = 5220 resources
  • Resource Cost for Training Tier 2 Troops Directly: 15000 + 8000 + 4000 + 6000

  1. Tier 1 Troops:
    • Cost: Training 1,800 Tier 1 troops costs 5,220 resources (2.9 resources per soldier).
    • Time: 1 hour and 25 minutes to train 1,800 troops.
  2. Tier 2 Troops (Requires Barracks Level 10):
    • Cost: Training 2,000 Tier 2 troops costs 33,000 resources (16.5 resources per soldier).
    • Time: 2 hours and 7 minutes to train 2,000 troops.

These figures highlight the steep increase in both resource and time requirements as you move to higher troop tiers.

By pre-training Tier 1 troops, you savehuge amounts of resources while still benefiting from the strength of Tier 2 troops after the upgrade.

Additional Tips for Resource Efficiency

  1. Use Training Speedups Wisely: Focus on maximizing troop numbers before unlocking the next tier.
  2. Plan Your Upgrades: Coordinate troop training and barracks upgrades to ensure no downtime.
  3. Monitor Resource Levels: Ensure you have enough resources to complete the barracks upgrade itself, which can be costly.
  4. Save Boosts for Key Milestones: Use resource and training boosts strategically for significant upgrades like troop tiers.

Conclusion

Efficiently upgrading troop tiers is a game-changer in Infinity Kingdom. By leveraging the automatic troop upgrade mechanic, you can save vast amounts of resources and focus on other critical aspects of your development. Follow this guide to maximize your efficiency and dominate in Norheim!

description: Starting on a new server in Infinity Kingdom can be exciting and challenging. html:
Starting on a new server in Infinity Kingdom can be exciting and challenging. To ensure smooth growth and progression, this guide focuses on how to allocate your talent points efficiently as a beginner. Talents are unlocked at level 5, and as a new player, prioritizing the Development talent tree is key to rapid growth.

Talent System Overview

Talent Trees

Infinity Kingdom offers two talent trees:

  1. Development: Focused on growth and economic boosts, ideal for new players.
  2. Military: Geared towards troop and battle enhancements, essential for mid-to-late game PvE and PvP content.

Talent Pages

You have access to three “Talent Pages,” allowing you to preset different talent configurations. These are particularly useful as you unlock more talent points and need to switch between setups for specific tasks such as dragon upgrades or PvP encounters.

  • Page 1: Development (Primary for beginners)
  • Page 2: Dragon Upgrade (Unlocked at level 21)
  • Page 3: Military (For later stages of the game)

For advanced talent builds beyond level 40, refer to specific guides.

Beginner Talenting Strategy

Why Development First?

As a beginner, focus exclusively on the Development tree. Military bonuses are negligible at early levels due to low stats, and rapid economic growth is crucial. The Development tree provides significant boosts to your resource generation, building speed, and technology upgrades.

Step-by-Step Talent Allocation

Levels 5-20: Early Growth

  1. Building Speed (1 point): Your first talent point should go here to accelerate construction.
  2. Massive Construction (5 points): Increases building speed further, essential for faster castle upgrades.
  3. Experienced (1 point): Grants bonus experience to your immortals, helping them level up quickly.
  4. Plentiful Gold (5 points): Gold is a critical resource, and this talent boosts its production.
  5. Divine Walker (1 point): Provides free marches every 8 hours, saving precious Action Points (AP).
  6. Leaps and Bounds (5 points): Boosts technology upgrade speed by 10%.

By the time you reach level 20, you should have a balanced setup optimized for construction and technology upgrades.

Level 21+: Advanced Development Setup

At level 21, you must split your Development focus into two distinct talent trees:

  1. Technology Speed Tree:
    • Use this setup most of the time, as research is a key aspect of growth.
  2. Dragon Upgrade Tree:
    • Switch to this setup right before initiating a dragon upgrade, then revert to the Technology Speed Tree.

Talent Allocation for Level 21+

Technology Speed Focus:

  • Massive Construction (5 points): Maintains building speed boost.
  • Experienced (1 point): Retains immortal XP bonus.
  • Plentiful Gold (5 points): Continues to enhance gold production.
  • Divine Walker (1 point): Keeps free marches active.
  • Leaps and Bounds (5 points): Maximizes technology upgrade speed.

Dragon Upgrade Focus: Follow specific guides for dragon-focused talent setups to maximize dragon growth efficiency.

Tips for Efficient Talent Use

  1. Preserve AP: Avoid unnecessary marches and save AP for critical activities.
  2. Resource Management: Use talents like Plentiful Gold to address early resource shortages.
  3. Switch Wisely: Use your free resets strategically, especially as you transition to dragon upgrades and Military talents later in the game. It costs gems to swap, so make sure you plan your progress and swaps between technology and dragon talents.
  4. Plan Ahead: Monitor your castle and research upgrade timelines to optimize talent usage.

By following this guide, you’ll establish a solid foundation for growth, ensuring you’re well-prepared for the challenges ahead. Good luck in Norheim!

title: Beginners guide to resources and resource management in Infinity Kingdom
description: Welcome to the world of Infinity Kingdom! As you start your journey, one of the most critical aspects to master is resource management. Whether you’re a new player just figuring things out or an intermediate player looking to refine your approach, understanding how to gather and use resources effici
html:
Welcome to the world of Infinity Kingdom! As you start your journey, one of the most critical aspects to master is resource management. Whether you’re a new player just figuring things out or an intermediate player looking to refine your approach, understanding how to gather and use resources efficiently is the foundation for your success. Let me guide you through the essentials and share some tips to ensure you’re always ahead of the curve.

Why Resources Are Key to Your Growth

In Infinity Kingdom, resources are the lifeblood of progress. They fuel everything from upgrading your castle to training troops and researching technologies. Early on, you’ll notice that resources seem plentiful. Completing quests, defeating gnomes, and playing regularly will give you enough to cover the costs of building upgrades and troop training. However, as you advance beyond Castle Level 20, the resource requirements increase dramatically.

  • Castle Level 10: Costs a manageable 105,000 resources combined.
  • Castle Level 20: Jumps to a hefty 1.45 million resources.
  • Castle Level 40: A staggering 140 million resources.

You can read much more about the costs of upgrading your castle and all other buildings in Infinity Kingdom here. On this page you find details on all costs for all levels across all buildings. Furthermore, you can use this link here to see a list of the prerequisites for upgrading your castle. Use this to plan your progress.

These escalating costs mean you need a solid plan to keep up with the demand. Without one, you risk stagnating and falling behind other players.

Basic Resource Collection: The Starting Point

The first and most straightforward way to gather resources is through your resource production buildings within your castle. These include farms, sawmills, quarries, and mines.

Upgrading these buildings increases their production rate and capacity. While this may seem like the logical first step, I’d advise caution:

  • Why not prioritize production buildings? Upgrading these buildings early can slow down your castle level progression. Higher-level castles unlock more powerful features and troops, which are crucial for growth. Instead, focus your efforts on other methods to supplement your resources.

Key Tip: Upgrade production buildings sparingly and focus on castle progression for long-term benefits.

Efficient Resource Collection Outside Your Castle

1. Resource Nodes on the Map

Resource nodes scattered across the map are a reliable source of resources. When your troops aren’t busy raiding gnomes or garrisoning, always send them out to gather from these nodes. The higher the level of the node, the more resources you can collect. Be vigilant and strategic about node placement to maximize your gathering efficiency.

Key Tip: Use immortals with gathering boosts or skills to improve collection speed and capacity.

2. Alt-Account Farming

Creating alternate accounts (alt accounts) dedicated to resource farming is one of the most efficient ways to supplement your main account. There are two main strategies for alt farming:

  • Focused Alt Farms: Fewer alt accounts that you actively play and use for resource node collection and upkeep.
  • Passive Alt Farms: Multiple alt accounts that you develop just enough to produce resources passively. These require less daily attention and serve as consistent suppliers.

Setting up a network of farms will significantly enhance your resource income without slowing down your main account’s progress. See multiple guides to running alt-farms efficiently here.

Key Tip: Join an alliance with your alts to gain benefits while avoiding unnecessary attacks.

3. Dead Castles

In any server, players inevitably quit or become inactive. These “dead castles” can be goldmines for resources. Scout and mark them for daily collection. Over time, this can become one of your most lucrative resource-gathering strategies.

Key Tip: Watch for server merges and growth stages, as new dead castles often appear after these events.

Conserving and Timing Your Resource Usage

Inventory Resource Items

Throughout the game, you’ll collect resource items stored in your inventory. While it’s tempting to use these as soon as you’re short, conserving them for critical moments is essential. I’ve found that the sweet spot for using your inventory resources is between Castle Level 30 and 40. At this stage:

  • Costs are skyrocketing.
  • The server is still relatively active with fewer dead castles.
  • You’ll need a resource boost to maintain momentum.

Key Tip: Use inventory resources strategically to push through significant upgrades or during timed events for extra rewards.

Wrapping It Up: Your Path to Resource Mastery

Efficient resource management isn’t just about collecting as much as you can—it’s about planning and prioritizing. Here’s a quick recap of what you should do:

  • Focus on castle progression over upgrading resource production buildings.
  • Always gather from resource nodes when your troops aren’t occupied.
  • Create alt accounts for dedicated farming, either actively or passively.
  • Scout for dead castles and collect from them daily.
  • Conserve your inventory resources for crucial stages like Castle Level 30-40.

By following these tips, you’ll set yourself up for success and ensure you’re never caught short when those massive upgrades come knocking. Resource management may seem tedious at first, but once you get into the rhythm, it’s incredibly rewarding. Now, go forth and conquer—your castle awaits!

title: Best spender event in season 1
description: In Infinity Kingdom, every dollar you spend should push your account toward long-term growth and power. For Season 1 players, however, that’s easier said than done. The event options available are few, and most offer relatively poor returns compared to what becomes available later in the game. But t
html:
Why Season 1 Players Should Prioritize the Stardust Wheel Over All Other Spender Events

In Infinity Kingdom, every dollar you spend should push your account toward long-term growth and power. For Season 1 players, however, that’s easier said than done. The event options available are few, and most offer relatively poor returns compared to what becomes available later in the game. But there is one exception: the Stardust Wheel (Primal Pinball event). If you’re considering spending during Season 1, this is where you get the best value—and here’s why.

The Key Problem: Season 1 Has Poor Spending Options

Let’s face it:

  • We don’t have access to chaos immortals in seasonal events.
  • We don’t have Sparks of Galaxy, which provides high-value holy/shadow immortal fragments.
  • Even the most common seasonal spending events yield less value per dollar than what later seasons enjoy.

What we are left with are spender events like Theias Roulette costing thousands of dollars for a holy or shadow immortal which will cost hundres instead a couple months later!

But there’s one crucial upgrade system that is available in Season 1: Immortal Portrait Levels. And to max just one Immortal’s portrait, you’ll need a staggering 6,341 Stardust.

Stardust upgrade costs, read more.

Multiply that by 4 immortals across your main marches—and you quickly realize that Stardust is your biggest bottleneck to power in the early game.

This is why the Stardust Wheel is so important.

Why the Stardust Wheel Is Better in Season 1

In Season 1, the Stardust Wheel offers pure Stardust rewards—and nothing else. That’s not a downside. In fact, it’s the reason this event is so valuable for us.

Starting from Season 2 and in Conquest, the wheel gets diluted with Crimson Crystals, a new resource required for chaos immortals. These are incredibly rare, incredibly expensive, and almost completely useless unless you’re spending $5,000+ to unlock and max Chaos immortals. That means that later versions of this wheel are far less efficient unless you’re a high spender chasing chaos.

In Season 1, though?

  • Every Pearl you spend goes toward Stardust.
  • You can stockpile it efficiently while avoiding future event dilution.

Efficiency Confirmed: Real Drop Rates and Value

According to extensive data testing from the IK-Wiki Stardust Wheel guide and the Stardust Wheel drop rate breakdown, the drop rates for Stardust are solid:

  • Jackpot: 400 Stardust (0.3% chance)
  • 250–200 Stardust prizes (combined ~1.3% chance)
  • Remaining prizes: 5 Stardust with decent probability

On top of that, bonus milestone rewards from the event add another layer of return for committed spenders.

Compared to Other Season 1 Events

Other spender events in Season 1 generally provide:

  • Poor value per dollar
  • Randomized or diluted rewards
  • No Crimson Crystals (which are irrelevant anyway pre-Chaos)
  • Few ways to directly improve portrait levels, which are your most powerful long-term boosts

The Stardust Wheel, on the other hand, gives you:

  • A straightforward path to portrait power
  • Value that remains useful even into Conquest seasons
  • One of the only events that gets worse over time (due to Crimson dilution)

So instead of saving your budget for Sparks of Galaxy or Chaos unlocks you can’t even access yet, invest in the only system that scales with your power and will never go to waste: Stardust.

Final Recommendation: Go All-In While It’s Clean

If you’re a spender in Season 1—even a modest one—the Stardust Wheel should be your top priority.

Why?

  • It’s the only event where later versions are less efficient.
  • It solves your biggest early-game bottleneck.
  • It boosts a system (portrait levels) that provides power long-term.

Build smart. Spend smart. If you’re in Season 1, this is your moment to build power before Crimson clutter hits the event wheel. Once it’s gone, it’s not coming back until next season cycle.

So get spinning.

html:
A Free-to-Play Player’s Guide to Earning Gems in Infinity Kingdom

Gems are one of the most valuable resources in Infinity Kingdom, but if you’re a free-to-play (F2P) player, they can feel frustratingly scarce. Unlike whales who might have gems to spare, you’ll need to be strategic about both collecting and spending them. Don’t worry, though—there are plenty of ways to rack up gems without spending a dime! This guide will walk you through all the best methods.

Daily Gem Collection: Consistent Effort Pays Off

Let’s start with the daily grind. There are several small but consistent ways to earn gems every day, and these can quickly add up over time.

1. Arena Battles

  • Complete at least your five free Arena challenges every day. Winning at least one guarantees performance rewards via in-game mail, averaging around 30 gems even for a smaller castle.
  • At the end of each Arena season, you’ll also earn additional gems based on your rank.
  • Completing your daily Arena challenges also counts toward your Daily Task chest rewards, which include 25 gems (second chest) and 75 gems (final chest).

2. Alliance Missions and Gifts

  • Help your alliance complete Alliance Missions daily. Each chest rewards individual prizes and Alliance Funds.
  • The daily Alliance Gift chest, unlocked through these missions, sometimes contains gems.

3. Nobility Rewards

  • Access these rewards via your Lord Info screen. Starting at Knight level, you’ll earn 10 gems daily, scaling up as your nobility increases. For instance, Viscount Level 1 grants 90 gems daily, while Marquis Level 3 gives 150 gems.

4. Throne of the Supreme (ToS)

  • During the “Points Race” phase, earn 30 gems for each battle you win. Winning all 10 of your daily attempts can net 300 gems per day for two weeks.
  • Focus on winnable battles rather than ranking to maximize gem gains.
  • For young servers, you have to wait until the Game Mode is activated.

5. Gtarcade App

  • Make sure to install the Gtarcade App found here or via your favorite App Store. Here you will have two daily free point shop bundles each yielding 30 gems, i.e. 60 gems per day.
  • In the App go to “Point Store” and redeem the two free bundles. Note that this can only be done once per day per Gtarcade account, so choose your castle wisely.

Daily Gems Summary:

  • Arena rewards: ~30-60 gems/day + end-of-season rewards.
  • Daily Task chests: 100 gems/day.
  • Nobility rewards: 10-150 gems/day based on rank.
  • Throne of the Supreme: 300 gems/day during the Points Race phase.
  • Gtarcade App: 60 gems/day

Weekly Gem Collection: Maximize Your Returns

Beyond daily efforts, there are additional weekly activities that can boost your gem reserves.

1. Wisdom Palace Quizzes

  • Complete daily quizzes to earn tickets for the Saturday Retrial quiz. Each correct answer on Saturday earns gems, typically 400-600 for full participation.

2. Sign-In Rewards

  • Mid-week Sign-In Rewards include 200 gems.

3. Gift Codes

  • Keep an eye out for the weekly gift codes, which often provide 100-200 gems in total.

4. Ruins Exploration

  • Ruins exploration rewards are random and something you can keep doing even after completing all areas. You can expect to find around 50 gems weekly on average.

Weekly Gems Summary:

  • Weekend Retrial quiz: 400-600 gems.
  • Gift codes: 100-200 gems.
  • Mid-week Sign-In Reward: 200 gems.
  • Ruins exploration: ~50 gems.
  • Daily gem total (from previous section): ~1400 weekly.

Combined, these activities can easily net you 2,150+ gems per week, even with minimal effort.

Gems from Periodic Events: Participation Matters

Periodic events are another excellent source of gems. While it’s tough for F2P players to place in the top tiers, even casual participation often yields smaller gem rewards.

  • City Expansion, Immortal Glory, and other events: Just participating can earn you 100-200 gems, plus other rewards.
  • Save speedups and resources: Use them strategically during key events to boost your performance and increase gem rewards.

Periodic Events Summary:

  • Minimal effort yields 100-200 gems per event.
  • Strategic participation and saved resources can boost these rewards significantly.

Tips for Smart Gem Management

Earning gems is only half the battle; spending them wisely is just as important:

  • Avoid impulse spending: Save gems for high-impact uses like speeding up important upgrades or buying rare items.
  • Invest in long-term value: Focus on items or upgrades that will provide sustained benefits, such as immortals or troop enhancements.
  • Plan for future events: Keep a reserve of gems for critical moments, especially during big events where gem spending can yield better rewards.

Generally speaking, I would advice you to only spend gems on two things: (1) upgrading VIP level once you get within range of achieving level 10 and (2) summon Immortals via 10x advanced summons to both unlock the immortals you need as well as farming purple crystals for your Tower of Knowledge skills.

Final Thoughts

Gems may be hard to come by for free-to-play players, but with consistent effort and smart strategies, you can build up a healthy stockpile over time. By focusing on daily tasks, weekly activities, and periodic events, you’ll set yourself up for success. Remember: every gem counts, and persistence is key.

Key Takeaways:

  • Daily gems: Prioritize Arena, Alliance Missions, Nobility Rewards, Throne of the Supreme and remember Gtarcade App bundles.
  • Weekly gems: Maximize Wisdom Palace quizzes, gift codes, and Sign-In Rewards.
  • Event gems: Participate strategically and save resources for key events.
  • Spend wisely: Focus on long-term value and save for major opportunities.

Happy gem hunting, and good luck conquering the Infinity Kingdom!

Part 2 Guide: One-Time Gem Rewards in Infinity Kingdom

Welcome to Part 2 of our guide on free gems in Infinity Kingdom! In this installment, we’ll focus on the one-time gem rewards available to players. These rewards can make a huge difference, especially for new players, by providing a large influx of gems to fuel your early progress. Knowing where to find these rewards and planning how to spend them is crucial to maximizing their value.

Why Focus on One-Time Rewards?

As a new player, you might feel like gems are flowing in constantly—but don’t let that deceive you! Many gem rewards in Infinity Kingdom are one-time only. Understanding this helps you:

  1. Plan ahead for major gem expenditures, like VIP upgrades or immortal summoning.
  2. Avoid the misconception of having a perpetual stream of gems.

Let’s explore the key sources of one-time gem rewards and how to make the most of them.

The Best One-Time Gem Sources

1. Unlocking Immortals

Unlocking immortals is one of the easiest ways to earn gems early on:

  • Rare Immortal: 50 gems
  • Epic Immortal: 100 gems
  • Legendary Immortal: 300 gems (equivalent to one philosopher’s stone)

To maximize this, focus on summoning and upgrading immortals to unlock their gem rewards quickly.

2. Ruins Exploration

Exploring ruins rewards you with both random and guaranteed gem payouts:

  • Random gems: Found while exploring ruins.
  • Area completion: 30 gems for completing all nodes in a region.
  • Puzzle completion: 50 gems for solving the area’s puzzle.

Ruins are not just great for gems—they also help you unlock valuable resources and boost your kingdom’s growth.

3. Well of Time (Campaign Mode)

Clearing the Well of Time provides steady gem rewards:

  • First clear of strongholds: 50 gems each.
  • Chapter completion: 3x 50 gems per chapter.

This adds up quickly as you progress through the chapters. Make sure to complete all available strongholds and chapters as efficiently as possible.

4. Chronicle Rewards

The Chronicle is the single largest source of one-time gem rewards:

  • Early Chronicles: 200–300 gems each.
  • Later Chronicles: 1,200+ gems each.
  • Total rewards: Upwards of 12,000 gems without bonuses and close to 15,000 gems with bonuses.

This makes the Chronicle an essential focus for new players. Prioritize completing Chronicles as you progress through the game to collect these significant rewards.

5. Legion of Frostborne (Advanced Chronicle)

Once your server completes the Royal Ambition Chronicle and the first Contention of Relics, the Legion of Frostborne unlocks.

  • Seasonal Chronicle: Resets every season and offers substantial gem rewards. This is a vital resource for mid-to-late-game players, so plan your gem spending with this in mind.

6. Contention of Relics

While not as lucrative as other sources, the Contention of Relics offers additional gems during and after battles. Focus on participating in these events to supplement your gem earnings.

Tips for Spending Gems as a New Player

With all these one-time gem rewards, it’s important to spend them wisely. Here are the two best ways for new players to use gems:

  1. VIP Level 10: Reaching VIP 10 unlocks a daily philosopher’s stone reward, providing long-term value.
  2. Immortal Summoning: Invest in summoning powerful immortals to strengthen your team early.

Avoid spending gems on speed-ups or other consumables unless absolutely necessary. Focus on investments that will provide lasting benefits to your account.

Key Takeaways for New Players

  • Hunt down all one-time gem sources early to maximize your gem reserves.
  • Plan your spending carefully, focusing on VIP upgrades and immortal summoning.
  • Don’t expect a continuous flow of gems after claiming one-time rewards—adjust your strategy accordingly.

By following this guide, you’ll have a strong foundation to make the most of your gems in Infinity Kingdom. Good luck, and may your treasury always overflow!

I have tried to get this confirmed as something that still works, however I have not been able to get final confirmation. But what you should do is give it a whirl and send a kind hello to the IK VIP discord account.

title: Tips and Tricks for Boosting Your Resources
description: Hey there! Today, I’m going to share with you a super handy trick that many players overlook. If you want to boost your resources and make your progression smoother, you’ll want to master the Troop and Fortification Resource Boost Trick. This little strategy will help you stretch your resources furt
html:
Hey there! Today, I’m going to share with you a super handy trick that many players overlook. If you want to boost your resources and make your progression smoother, you’ll want to master the Troop and Fortification Resource Boost Trick. This little strategy will help you stretch your resources further, essentially “lending” resources from future upgrades. It’s a simple concept, but when done right, it can make a huge difference in your growth. Let’s dive in!

The Core Idea: Upgrade Tiers to Unlock Resource Gains

In Infinity Kingdom, troops and fortifications are upgraded in tiers—Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, and so on. Each new tier makes your army stronger, but here’s the interesting part:

  • When you upgrade to a new tier, all your current troops or fortifications are instantly transformed into the higher tier.
  • When you refund troops, you get 80% of their resource value back.

Now, here’s the trick:

  1. Lower-tier troops cost far fewer resources to train compared to higher-tier troops.
  2. Refunded troops give back resources based on their current tier, not the tier they were originally trained at.

This means you can train cheap, low-tier troops before upgrading, then refund them after the upgrade for a huge resource boost!

How to Use This Trick Effectively

Let’s break it down step by step so you can make the most out of this trick:

1. Fill Your Training Grounds Before Upgrading

  • Train as many troops as you can of a tier you’re about to leave behind (e.g., Tier 1 before upgrading to Tier 2).
  • Focus on troops you don’t need for your main march. For example, if you use a fire team with shieldmen and bowmen, train cavalry and spearmen instead.

2. Upgrade to the Next Tier

  • When you upgrade your barracks or fortifications to the next level, all your troops will be automatically converted to the new tier.
  • Your low-cost Tier 1 troops are now shiny new Tier 2 troops!

3. Refund Troops You Don’t Need

  • After the upgrade, destroy (refund) the troops you don’t need in your main march. For example, as a fire player using shieldmen and bowmen, you’d refund all your cavalry and spearmen.
  • The refund will give you 80% of the resources based on the higher tier’s value, which is significantly more than you spent on training them in the lower tier.

Why Does This Work?

The key here is the difference in resource value between troop tiers:

  • Higher-tier troops cost more resources, and refunds are calculated based on the troop’s current tier, not what you paid to train them.
  • This creates a net resource gain, especially in early to mid-game when resources are harder to come by.

Example

  • Training 1,000 Tier 1 troops might cost 100K resources.
  • After upgrading to Tier 2, their refund value is based on Tier 2, giving you back 80% of 200K (Tier 2 value). That’s 160K resources, a 60K net gain!

Repeat this process for every upgrade, and you’ll see massive resource returns over time.

Addressing Concerns

“Won’t I lose resources if I retrain these troops later?”

Yes, you’ll lose 20% of the resources (the refund penalty), but think of this as “borrowing” resources from your future self. At higher levels, resources are easier to gather through farms, nodes, and events, so this trick essentially gives you a head start when resources are more precious.

“Why train troops I don’t need?”

You’re leveraging the refund system to create a resource advantage. By refunding troops you don’t need, you’re funneling those resources into other upgrades or marches that matter more for your strategy.

Pro Tips for Maximizing the Trick

  1. Plan Around Your Main March:
    • Only keep the troops you actively use. For example, if your main march is fire with Trajan and Hippolyta, focus on shieldmen and bowmen. Refund spearmen and cavalry.
  2. Max Out Your Training Grounds:
    • Before upgrading to a new tier, make sure your training grounds are completely full. The more troops you train at the lower tier, the bigger your refund gains will be after the upgrade.
  3. Use This Trick for Fortifications Too:
    • This method also works for fortifications. Fill your wall with low-tier defenses before upgrading, then refund them after the upgrade for extra resources.
  4. Keep Your Economy Balanced:
    • Don’t overdo it and drain all your resources into this strategy. Make sure you’re leaving enough for regular upgrades and training needs.

Real-Life Example

Here’s how I use this trick on my fire team:

  • Before Tier 4 Upgrade: I filled my training grounds with spearmen and cavalry (troops I don’t need).
  • After the Upgrade: All those troops became Tier 4. I refunded all the spearmen and cavalry, giving me back a ton of resources.
  • Result: I funneled those resources into training more shieldmen and bowmen for my main march.

This approach gave me a massive boost in resources without needing to rely heavily on farming or external sources.

Final Thoughts

This resource-boosting trick is a game-changer, especially in the early to mid-game when resources are tight. By leveraging troop refunds during tier upgrades, you’ll give yourself a massive advantage in building up your kingdom and progressing faster than other players.

Remember, this strategy isn’t about breaking the game but about playing smart and making the most of the systems available to you. So, plan your upgrades, fill your training grounds, and watch your resources grow!

Good luck, and may your kingdom thrive! 😊

title: Top 10 mistakes you want to avoid!
description: Infinity Kingdom is a popular city builder war game where players build and manage their own kingdoms, train armies, and compete against other players in epic battles. In this game, planning and avoiding mistakes is essential to stay ahead of the competition and keep growing at a strong pace. In thi
html:
Infinity Kingdom is a popular city builder war game where players build and manage their own kingdoms, train armies, and compete against other players in epic battles. In this game, planning and avoiding mistakes is essential to stay ahead of the competition and keep growing at a strong pace. In this article, we will discuss the top 10 mistakes that players should avoid to ensure their success in the game.

Top 10 mistakes

Mistake #1: Not buying into Production Tech to start.

One of the biggest mistakes that new players make is not investing in Production Tech at the beginning of the game. Production Tech is essential to increasing the rate of resource production in the game. Without it, players will find it hard to keep up with the demands of their kingdom and will fall behind in terms of growth and development.

Mistake #2: Use up speed ups on any and all things.

Another common mistake that players make is using up their speed ups on any and all things. While speed ups can be helpful, they should be used wisely. It is important to save universal speeds for technology development, as this is one of the most important aspects of the game.

Mistake #3: Not waiting for all the available helps before speeding things up.

Many players make the mistake of not waiting for all the available helps before speeding things up. When you speed up a task, you lose out on the opportunity to receive help from other players. Waiting for all the available helps before speeding up a task can save a lot of time and resources in the long run.

Mistake #4: Use gems too liberally without planning.

Gems are a valuable resource in the game and should be used wisely. Many players make the mistake of using gems too liberally without planning, which can lead to a shortage of gems when they are needed most. It is important to plan ahead and save gems for important tasks, such as purchasing universal speed ups or unlocking new features.

Mistake #5: Use and upgrade the wrong skills without considering immortal synergy (such as Combo).

In Infinity Kingdom, it is important to plan ahead and consider immortal synergy when using and upgrading skills. Using and upgrading the wrong skills can lead to a weaker army and slower progress in the game. Players should have a clear goal for their main marches and stick to it to ensure their success.

Mistake #6: Melting down maxed skills.

While melting down maxed skills may seem like a good idea, it is actually a mistake that many players make. When you melt down a skill, you lose crystals, which are a valuable resource in the game. It is important to only melt down skills that you are certain you will never use.

Mistake #7: Keeping high level and star Immortals you don’t use for main marches.

Another mistake that players make is keeping high level and star immortals that they don’t use for main marches. This can lead to a shortage of fragments, which are needed to upgrade immortals. It is important to focus on one march at a time and keep fragments only for immortals that you know you will use.

Mistake #8: Not focusing on leveling your dwellings.

Gold is one of the hardest resources to get in the game, and many players make the mistake of not focusing on leveling their dwellings. Upgrading dwellings is essential to increasing the rate of resource production in the game. It is important to prioritize upgrading dwellings to ensure a steady flow of gold.

Mistake #9: Missing out on free event rewards.

Events are a great way to earn free rewards in the game, and many players make the mistake of missing out on them. Events often offer valuable resources and items that can help players progress in the game. It is important to keep an eye out for events and participate in them to maximize rewards.

Mistake #10: Forgetting to do Mysterium every 2 days.

Mysterium is a key feature in Infinity Kingdom that provides players with a steady flow of speeds and gold. Many players make the mistake of forgetting to participate in Mysterium every 2 days. It is important to prioritize Mysterium and participate in it regularly to ensure a steady supply of resources.

Conclusion

Avoiding the top 10 mistakes discussed in this article is essential to staying competitive and successful in Infinity Kingdom. By investing in Production Tech, saving speed ups for technology development, waiting for all the available helps before speeding up tasks, using gems wisely, considering immortal synergy when using and upgrading skills, not melting down maxed skills, focusing on leveling dwellings, participating in events, and prioritizing Mysterium, players can ensure a strong start and steady growth in the game.

In conclusion, Infinity Kingdom is a complex game that requires careful planning and strategy to succeed. By avoiding these common mistakes and learning from them, players can stay ahead of the competition and achieve their goals in the game. So, follow the tips provided in this article and have fun building and managing your own kingdom in Infinity Kingdom.

title: What are Random Immortal Fragments?
description: Understanding Random Immortal Fragments in Infinity Kingdom
html:
Understanding Random Immortal Fragments in Infinity Kingdom

Random Immortal Fragments are basically IK’s off-brand Philosopher Stones — but honestly, they’re way better for most players because the pools aren’t limited to a specific list of select few immortals like the Halls is. Instead, you gather 60 fragments of a type, and boom: you summon one random Immortal from the associated pool.

The best part is that these pools cover almost all Immortals, including expensive heavies like Baldwin, Genghis Khan, and paywalled immortals like Zenobia, Himiko, etc. So even a low spender or free player can pull immortals that used to be locked behind pretty rough paywalls.

There are ten kinds of Random Immortal Fragments, each tied to a specific pool of immortals.

The 10 Types of Random Immortal Fragments

The Data Project: Helping the Community Map Drop Chances

The community needs you! Right now, the actual summon odds for these fragment types are unknown. IK never releases the internal gacha weights. So the only way to figure out the real probability distribution is for the playerbase to log every single random fragment summon we can get our hands on.

A group of us has already started a big shared sheet to record summons across:

  • Random Epic
  • Element-specific
  • Holy
  • Shadow
  • Holy/Shadow
  • Chaos (when someone actually gets enough…)

This is the only realistic path to uncover how weighted the pools are, and which Immortals show up more often.

👉 If you want to help the community reveal the true drop rates, please join the shared Google Sheet and log your summons.

The more data points we collect, the more accurate the drop-rate estimates becomes.

Quick overview on how to Collect Random Immortal Fragments

Golden Pass

Still the most consistent source for newer players:

  • Random Epic
  • Elemental random fragments

Honestly, this is the backbone for most people’s early and mid-game fragment collection.

Seasonal Events

You’ll see many types of random fragments there – even chaos!

Harbour (long-term grind)

The Harbour drip-feed is slow but steady:

  • Early levels → Random Epic
  • Mid → Holy & Shadow
  • High → Chaos

Read more about the harbour here.

Why These Fragments Actually Matter (Player Perspective)

So here’s the real talk — and this is the stuff players feel immediately in their account growth:

1. They give free-to-play and light spenders access to premium immortals

Back when the game launched, guys like Baldwin, Genghis Khan, Zenobia, etc. were entirely paywalled and spend-to-collect.

Now? A random Epic or element fragment can legitimately pop one of these. And the same is true for holy, shadow and even chaos! Insane compared to how expensive it was to get these back in the day.

This changes the entire power curve for F2P players — you can actually build full meta marches just from fragments and events.

2. They massively improve your Soul Crystal income

And this part is huge but many players overlook it. Every time you pull a duplicate you don’t need, you melt it in the Alchemy Lab → purple crystals (Soul Crystals). And those Soul Crystals go into your Tower of Knowledge skill upgrades (which are insanely expensive long-term).

Your ToK growth rate can be a very big bottleneck in the game, and these fragments help you push through it.

Conclusion Summary

Random Immortal Fragments aren’t just a fun gacha mechanic — they’re legitimately one of the most important progression systems in the entire game now. They let every player, from F2P to whale, access strong immortals, build Soul Crystals faster, and grow their roster without being tied to Philosopher Stone banners or paywalls.

Bottom line: Collect every random fragment you can. Always melt your dupes. And please log your summons in the shared sheet — the more data we have, the faster we crack the real drop rates.

title: Why you need Alt Castles in Infinity Kingdom – Resources, Honor
description: One of the most common questions I get from new players is: “Why are you making so many alt castles?” To many, it seems like a waste of time, but trust me—if you’re serious about growing fast in Infinity Kingdom, alts are a game-changer. Whether you want to stack up resources, farm honor, or maintai
html:
One of the most common questions I get from new players is: “Why are you making so many alt castles?” To many, it seems like a waste of time, but trust me—if you’re serious about growing fast in Infinity Kingdom, alts are a game-changer. Whether you want to stack up resources, farm honor, or maintain a steady supply of gold, alt castles are your best tool for getting ahead. Let’s break it down!

Resources – How Alts Fuel Your Growth

Relying on your alts to farm resources is the fastest way to grow your main castle.

Each alt generates a steady flow of resources that you can use in two ways: either by directly harvesting them through attacks or by farming with their AP (Action Points). The key is to balance both methods.

Your alts will naturally collect more resources than they need, especially if you’re consistently farming dead castles and gathering from nodes. When these resources start to overflow, you can “harvest” them with your main castle by attacking your own alts. Every attack will bring back a full load of resources, making sure that no excess goes to waste.

Another big advantage is perhaps not very intuitive: Gold production. Your main castle will not have enough resource production to sustain continuous gold transmutations while playing competitively. Alt resources are great for this! Particularly since as you develop your castle you will need wood and stone and iron for buildings but not as much food (later in high PvP battles food is your most precious resource, but not yet). Keep an eye on your minting talents and make sure you’re regularly converting your excess food into gold in the Forge. This is the easiest way to stockpile enough gold for your dragons and upgrades.

Summary:

  • Use alt AP to farm resources from dead castles and farm nodes.
  • Harvest excess resources by attacking your alts with your main.
  • Convert surplus food into gold to maintain a steady supply.

Honor – Farming Honor Efficiently with Alts

If you want to climb the honor rankings fast, alts are your best friend. Here’s how you can turn your alt castles into a never-ending honor farm:

First, you need to set up your alt marches correctly. The trick is to remove their dragons, artifacts, equipment, and passives—everything that makes them stronger. You want them as weak as possible while keeping their troop count high. This way, your main castle can attack them efficiently and maximize honor gain per battle.

Next, make sure you always activate the Rank Advancement talent on your main castle before attacking. This talent doubles the honor gain from one battle, so you want to make sure you hit the largest possible stack of troops every time you use it. To do this, you should stack up garrisons inside one alt castle.

During SvS (Server vs. Server), you can even push the garrison cap with tech, allowing you to get even bigger honor payouts. If you maintain a daily routine of attacking a full stack of marches with Rank Advancement active, you’ll consistently gain massive amounts of honor without needing to rely on combat events.

Summary:

  • Make alt marches as weak as possible while keeping troop count high.
  • Activate Rank Advancement talent before attacking.
  • Stack garrisons inside one alt for maximum honor payout.
  • Attack daily to maintain a steady honor income.

How to Maintain Alts – Keeping Everything Running Smoothly

The more time you invest in keeping your alt AP low, the more resources and honor you’ll generate. However, I know that not everyone has time to manage a dozen alts actively—so here are two main ways to approach it:

  1. Active Alt Management (High Yield) – If you have time, log in daily, spend all AP farming, and keep your resource flow moving.
  2. Passive Alt Management (Low Effort) – If you’re short on time, you can set up a “farmville” of alts that only do the bare minimum. Just log in occasionally to keep them active, gather resources, and let them stack up passively over time. Simply keep buildings and technology moving, and keep increasing troop counts by raid low level gnomes for EXP and raid Well of Time. This takes maybe 20 min. per day total running my 14 alt accounts.

Either way, having alts—even if they’re only semi-active—is a huge advantage over players who rely only on their main castle for growth. This is how the fastest-growing players get ahead, and if you want to maximize your potential, you should be doing the same.

Summary:

  • The more AP you spend on alts, the more value you get.
  • Fully active alts will accelerate your main’s progress.
  • Even passive alts will provide solid resources over time.

This is why I have so many alts and why they’re absolutely essential if you want to be competitive. If you’re serious about growing fast, start setting up your own alt castles today and enjoy the endless resources and honor they provide. See you on the battlefield!

description: Loki: A Free to Play (F2P) Game Changer in Infinity Kingdom
html:
Loki: A Free to Play (F2P) Game Changer in Infinity Kingdom

Ah, Loki, the name that stirs up a whirlpool of emotions in the hearts of Infinity Kingdom players. Dubbed as a “whale Immortal” by many due to his seemingly insurmountable acquisition and upgrade costs, Loki has been a subject of much debate. But, let’s flip the script today and discuss why Loki might just be the unsung hero for F2P players in the realm of Norheim.

Loki’s Arrival: A Blessing in Disguise

Since his grand debut in November 2022, Loki has indeed been tagged with the “expensive” label, but let’s look beyond that. The introduction of Loki brought along a flurry of seasonal events that generously doled out Loki fragments and Chaos Selection Chests – yes, free of charge!

From Spring Festival and Winter’s Christmas Celebrations to Halloween and Summer Party, most of the seasonal events in Infinity Kingdom have had free Loki fragments in quite high numbers.

It also seems that they will continue to offer Loki and Selection Chests in the seasonal events, with a massive amount available in the Anniversary event currently live.

The Power of a 5-Star Loki

For F2P players or those who prefer not to splurge, acquiring a 5-star Loki has become a feasible goal. Some might question the effectiveness of not fully upgrading him. However, this is where the true beauty of Loki’s design shines through.

Loki’s essence isn’t just in dealing damage; it’s his control abilities that truly make him stand out. His skill effects and percentages are so potent that even at 5 stars, he can significantly disrupt enemy formations and strategies. This aspect is vastly underestimated by many.

Leveraging Loki’s Unique Skillset

Loki’s unique skillset allows him to fit seamlessly into any elemental setup, be it fire, water, or earth. His control abilities can turn the tide of battles, making him a versatile addition to any team.

I, too, have embraced the Loki revolution. Swapping out a maxed Gilgamesh (with his top-tier Unique artifact) for a 6-star Loki (which, for skill slot purposes, is quite comparable to a 5-star) has yielded incredible results. This shift has not only enhanced my overall strategy but has also proven to be a game-changer in my battle outcomes.

Why Loki Deserves a Second Look from F2P Players

  • Accessibility: The consistent distribution of Loki fragments through events has made him more accessible to F2P players than initially anticipated.
  • Impactfulness at 5 Stars: Unlike other Immortals who might need to be fully maxed to unveil their full potential, Loki’s control capabilities ensure he remains a formidable force even at 5 stars.
  • Strategic Advantage: Incorporating Loki into your lineup opens up new strategic avenues, allowing for more flexibility in tackling various challenges and opponents.

Conclusion: Embracing Loki’s Potential

It’s time to shed the old perceptions and embrace Loki for the strategic asset he is, especially for F2P and light spender communities. Loki’s introduction to Infinity Kingdom is not just a tale of exclusivity for those who can afford to whale out. It’s a narrative of opportunity, strategic depth, and the democratization of power through smart play and event participation.

So, before you join the chorus of those lamenting over Loki’s “whale” status, consider the potential lying dormant in your 5-star Loki. With the right strategy, he might just be the key to unlocking new heights for your kingdom, proving once and for all that in the world of Infinity Kingdom, strategy can indeed triumph over spending.

title: New mini-game Battle Chess
description: Patch 2.5 Notes – Update info!
html:
Patch 2.5 Notes – Update info!

Battle Chess

A brand new mini-game is coming to Infinity Kingdom with update 2.5. We are going to be diving into a new game mode called Battle Chess in which players can compete using our favorite Immortals on the chess board where powerful spells in the form of arcane cards are used by the players to create a magical chess styled battleground. Kill the enemy King and claim victory!

What do we know about Battle Chess?

We know a bit so far. In addition to the imaged I have included in this post (found in the official patch notes) we also have a bit of information as to how this game is going to work.

The setting is the commonly known chess board. However, instead of the traditional chess pieces we are going to be playing with Immortals as pieces on the board. In addition, players are choosing a deck of spell-cards to be used in combat for various different effects, by the looks of the skills they are going to be in line with well known Immortal Ultimate Abilities from the original game.

Chess Pieces

The pieces we have to use have different mechanics and concepts. It seems we are using a piece-unique resource called Stamina for movement as well as Energy Marks to cast spells. By the sounds of the notes the player continuously earns Energy Marks throughout the fight.

This seems the core resource and you can choose to spend these marks on casting the spells cards chosen (you choose a deck of skill cards). Moreover, you as the player spend Energy to summon Immortals to the board (maybe you also have to spend energy marks to use their ability skills, this not very clear to me) but regardless it is going to be a strategy and resource-management game by the looks of it.

Official details on Pieces

1) King: has HP. Each side will generate a King at the beginning of a game, the King will continuously generate Stamina Points. The King can use Stamina Points to move within its side.

2) Immortal: has HP. Requires Energy Marks to use. Immortal pieces will automatically attack enemy pieces and cast skills. Immortal pieces have their own conduct (normal, fixed point, follow, patrol, charge, etc.), passive skills, and energy skills.

3) Arcane Card: has no HP. Requires Energy Marks to use. Move it to any position to use it to cast a King’s skill, producing various effects.

Game mechanics

Victory Conditions: The enemy king reaches 0 Health Point (HP).

Pre-game Preparations: “before a game starts, the players must select 9 pieces from the Immortal and Arcane decks”. Think of games like Magic Card, Pokemon Cards or Hearthstone. In essence, you are creating your deck the same way you set up a march and tower of knowledge skills in real Infinity Kingdom, here we are just choosing Immortals and magical spell cards instead.

Game play: at the beginning of a game, chess pieces will randomly be sorted into the battle zone (6 pieces) or the waiting zone (3 pieces). You can use Energy Marks to put chess pieces into the battle zone. After a chess piece is defeated, it will be sent to the waiting zone.

Immortal pieces will automatically attack enemy pieces and cast skills. Immortal pieces have their own conduct (normal, fixed point, follow, patrol, charge, etc.), passive skills, and energy skills.

Speed-up Mode is a forced game timer. To make sure that a chess game cannot take extreme amounts of time, there is a speed-up Mode mechanic where the players King’s begin to loose HP continuously (eventually killing them). In addition, during this stage of the fight players earn Energy Marks at an increased rate.

How to play?

Event pre-requisite requirements:

1) Players in servers that have completed “Royal Ambition” in the Chronicle will be eligible to participate in this event.

2) Along with the requirement listed above, lords must be level 11 or higher to participate.

How to access Battle Chess?

Tap the Well of Time icon at the lower right of the main page, and you’ll be able to find Battle Chess listed. Battle Chess is available 24 hours a day and as such NOT dependent on specific event dates or times.

Game Modes

To begin with we are going to have only a single game mode available: Entertainment Mode. However, Battle Chess will contain a variety of modes currently under development.

In Entertainment Mode, you can be auto-matched to opponents or invite friends from your alliance to play with.

Patch notes gift event

You can leave any suggestions, opinions, or questions in the comments section of this post https://forum.gtarcade.com/topic/145887

Participation format: Comment in the topic post and leave your Lord ID in your comment post to participate! 20 lords will be selected and rewarded with a gift.

Event deadline (UTC): March 16th, midnight

Read the official Patch 2.5 Notes at: https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7016809.html

html:
Infinity Kingdom 2.6.3 Update: Unleashing the Free Arena and Mysterious Merchant Ship

Norheim is ablaze with excitement as factions rise and the landscape of Infinity Kingdom undergoes a transformative shift. The highly-anticipated 2.6.3 update responds to player feedback, introducing game-changing features that promise to redefine the thrill of battles and offer fresh challenges. Let’s delve into the dynamic additions of the Free Arena and explore the mysterious opportunities presented by the Merchant Ship in this comprehensive overview.

What is Free Arena?

The Free Arena emerges as a battlefield unbound, a realm where lords can unleash their strategic prowess without the shackles of restrictions. It represents a new era of competitive combat, providing an open arena for both newcomers and seasoned veterans returning to Norheim.

How Does Free Arena Work?

1. Season Cycles & Matchmaking Rules:

  • Each Free Arena season spans a duration of 30 days, allowing lords ample time to showcase their skills.
  • Matchmaking rules ensure that lords face opponents participating in the same round of the KVK season, fostering intense, strategic battles.

2. Challenge Rules:

  • Lords initiate challenges using Free Arena tickets, with five free tickets granted daily.
  • Accumulate Rank Points and Victory Points through victories, unlocking daily rewards, tier rewards, and coveted ranking rewards.

3. Reward Rules:

  • Elevate your rank and ranking to unlock daily rewards and special rewards when the season concludes.
  • Accumulate Victory Points to unlock the daily arena treasure chest, filled with Stardust, Dragon Essence, Gold, and various enticing rewards.

4. Battle Rules:

  • Select attributes, immortals, dragons, and troops wisely, with a reset required at the beginning of each Free Arena season.
  • Immortals, dragons, and troops available are specific to the Free Arena, ensuring a leveled playing field for all participants.

The Unique Brilliance of Free Arena:

One of the standout features of the Free Arena is the ability to engage in battles against other servers participating in the same KvK season. This brings an unprecedented level of excitement as players face off on a truly leveled playing field. Whale servers no longer hold an overwhelming inherent advantage in one-on-one combat. The Free Arena creates an environment where strategic prowess, skill, and teamwork take center stage, making every battle a thrilling and fair competition.

Mysterious Merchant Ship: A Sea of Opportunities

In addition to the Free Arena, the patchnotes also brings a new awesome feature to Infinity Kingdom – The Mysterious Merchant Ship! I am looking forward to this for one simple reason: Stardust. We need so much stardust to upgrade our Immortals that even spending all you can you are still running low on Stardust always. This is an additional method of obtaining Stardust, simple and great!

Unlock Requirements:

  • Servers must have progressed to at least season 2 to unlock the Mysterious Merchant Ship.

Feature Rules:

  • Available every Saturday for a 2-day window, lords can spend Gems to acquire Crimson Moonlight, Stardust, Gold, Loren’s Heart, and other coveted items.
  • Initial purchases enjoy discounts, with subsequent items escalating in price, adding an element of strategy to your acquisitions.

Conclusion:

The 2.6.3 update in Infinity Kingdom heralds an era of unbridled excitement and fresh challenges. The Free Arena and Mysterious Merchant Ship offer lords new avenues for competition and rewards, transforming Norheim into an even more vibrant and competitive realm. Brace yourselves for the Legion of Frostborne, and may your adventures be filled with triumphs in this exciting new chapter!

Patch 2.6.0.6 Update for Infinity Kingdom: A New Era of Gameplay and Aesthetic Delights

Streamlined User Interface: Navigating the Kingdom with Finesse

Here you can see the status, movement timers, and much more giving greater insights more rapidly for players.

This strategic addition allows players to focus on grander schemes while ensuring their territories remain impervious to external threats.

The Mysterium continues!

New Mysterium levels to progres through. The Mysterium rewards are huge now, with artifact fragments for unique artifacts for Atilla, Alex, Cid, Saladin and Ramssess as well as a ton more gold and speed ups.

Conclusion

In conclusion, Patch 2.6.6 is an epochal chapter in the saga of Infinity Kingdom, propelling the game into new dimensions of immersion and strategy. With its enriched UI, automated features, exclusive VIP Store, artifact enhancements, and captivating new immortals, this update encapsulates the developers’ unwavering dedication to crafting an unforgettable gaming experience. Brace yourselves for an adventure like no other, as Infinity Kingdom continues to evolve and captivate the hearts of adventurers worldwide.

html:
Infinity Kingdom, a beloved strategy game, is gearing up to introduce thrilling new features and gameplay enhancements in its upcoming Version 2.6.2 update. The developers are all set to elevate the gaming experience for lords venturing across the vast realms of the Infinity Kingdom. Here’s a comprehensive analysis of the exciting changes awaiting players:

Time Rift Breaker – A Game-Changing Event

The Time Rift Breaker event is unquestionably one of the most anticipated additions in Version 2.6.2. It promises to be a game-changer, reminiscent of the beloved Spider event, but on a grander scale. This cross-server event invites lords from the same season to unite and confront a formidable adversary. It introduces a dynamic twist to the gameplay, where lords must strategize based on elemental weaknesses, adding an extra layer of depth to battles. With different elemental weaknesses and a prolonged cross-server format, it’s an event that holds immense promise and anticipation.

Time Rift Breaker 101 – A Cross-Server Challenge

One of the standout additions to Infinity Kingdom in Version 2.6.2 is the Time Rift Breaker event. This is a cross-server event that allows lords from the same season to come together and challenge a formidable adversary. To access the event, simply tap on the “Well of Time” located in the bottom-right corner of your screen.

Event Requirements:

  • Your server must have entered Season 2.
  • Your Castle Level must be equal to or higher than Level 15.

Event Period:

  • The event starts every Monday at 00:00 (UTC) and concludes every Sunday at 24:00 (UTC).
  • During the first two days (Monday to Wednesday), the enemy is in the recharge and incubation stage and cannot be attacked.
  • The challenge stage begins every Thursday at 00:00 (UTC) and runs until Sunday at 24:00 (UTC). During this period, you can attack the enemy. If defeated, the enemy will resurrect after a certain time or escape if not defeated.

Event Rules:

  • Each lord has three challenge attempts daily.
  • All battles in this event are automatic.
  • Immortals deployed in a challenge cannot be used again on the same day.
  • Utilize Immortals of the corresponding elements to deal additional damage based on the Time Rift Breaker’s elemental weakness.

Event Rewards:

  • The event offers a variety of rewards, including Total Damage Ranking Rewards, Highest Damage Ranking Rewards, Kill Rewards, and Honor Rewards.
  • These rewards will grant you Space-Time Glory Badges, which can be exchanged for valuable items in the shop.

Darius – Lightning’s Mighty Champion

The arrival of Darius I, a formidable new Immortal, is cause for celebration. Belonging to the Lightning element, Darius I brings a unique set of skills to the battlefield. His specialty lies in spear attacks, making him a valuable asset against the physical meta. His skill, which inflicts Physical Damage to all enemies and has a chance to decrease their Physical Damage dealt, positions him as a potent counter to physical damage dealers. This is particularly significant in a meta dominated by physical threats, and Darius I’s inclusion will undoubtedly shake up the competitive landscape.

Darius I’s Skill:

  • Skill: Inflicts Physical Damage (Damage Rate 108%) to all enemies and has a 9% chance of decreasing their Physical Damage dealt by 30% (with an additional 30% decrease when first casting the skill), lasting for 6 seconds.
  • Upgrade Preview: Darius I’s skills will evolve, increasing his Damage Rate and the trigger chance of Physical Damage decrease, making him an even more formidable force on the battlefield.
    • Damage Rate: 108%/144%/180%/216%/252%/288%/324%/360%
    • Trigger Chance of Physical Damage Decrease: 9%/12%/15%/18%/21%/24%/27%/30%

Optimizations for a Seamless Gaming Experience

Version 2.6.2 isn’t just about introducing new content; it’s also about enhancing the overall gaming experience. The optimizations included in this update are aimed at providing players with smoother and more enjoyable gameplay. Some notable improvements include:

  • Arena Battle Report Sharing: Enhancing communication between lords, this feature allows the sharing of Arena Battle Reports via the Chat Channel, fostering a stronger sense of community among players.
  • Mysterium Difficulty Adjustment: The Mysterium difficulty has been fine-tuned to ensure a more balanced and enjoyable gaming experience, catering to players of all levels.
  • King of the Hill Ranking Rewards Adjustment: Entrance requirements for stage and overall rankings in the King of the Hill event have been refined, ensuring fair competition and encouraging player engagement.
  • Battle Damage Numbers Optimization: To make battles more transparent and informative, various types of damage, such as Normal Attack Damage, Skill Damage, and Crit Damage, are now displayed in distinct colors, enhancing the overall clarity of battles.
  • Gnome Boss Search Rules Optimization: Gnome Bosses can now be directly searched for, simplifying the process and aligning it with the spawning rules of regular monsters.
  • Alliance & Academy Technology Bonus Effective in Checkpoints: Technology bonuses from both the Academy and Alliance Technology are now applicable in Legion of Frostborne Checkpoints, empowering players to overcome challenges more effectively.

As the Version 2.6.2 update unfolds, the Infinity Kingdom development team actively seeks player feedback through official media channels like Facebook, Discord, VK, and more. The Time Rift Breaker event awaits, and with Darius I by your side, you’ll be well-equipped to face epic battles and conquer the ever-expanding Infinity Kingdom.
