description: Gift of Bondings May 2025: Bundle Review and Recommendations
html:
Gift of Bondings May 2025: Bundle Review and Recommendations

Infinity Kingdom’s monthly “Gift of Bondings” bundle series continues in May 2025 with a fresh cosmetic theme and functional castle skin rewards. While past bundles have seen mixed reception, the current edition raises a few eyebrows due to the nature of its rewards and their practical value. Let’s take a closer look at this month’s offering and evaluate whether it’s worth your investment.

Bundle Structure and Contents

The Gift of Bondings event is always structured in three stages:

1. First Tier Bundle (~$5 USD)

  • Peter Avatar Frame
  • 1x Dragon Essence
  • Artifact Fragments
  • VIP Points

This initial tier is generally cosmetic-heavy and offers minimal functional value. The Peter frame is a neat addition for collectors, and the dragon essence is mildly useful if you are still progressing through your Dragon Talent Trees. However, this tier primarily serves as the entry point to unlock the more substantial second bundle.

2. Second Tier Bundle ($50USD)

  • Singular Realm Teleport Effect
  • 3% Gathering Speed

This tier is where the bundle series takes a dip. The Singular Realm teleport effect is purely cosmetic for the most part, and the functional buff of 3% Gathering Speed is extremely underwhelming. Given that gathering is largely done with downtime anyway, this bonus won’t significantly impact your gameplay. Moreover, the abundance of high resource collection buffs makes this a drop in a bucket. Most players are not keeping 100% uptime on their gatheres, I would actually venture to go as far as to say no player does. Hence you will have downtime regardless and if you truely do care about efficient resource collection, you are using better buffs from item buffs and talent trees making this not matter anyway.

3. Third Tier Bundle ($100 USD)

  • Paradeisos Castle Skin
  • 5% Prosperity Recovery Speed
  • 5% Building Speed

This tier is the highlight of this month’s Gift of Bondings. The Paradeisos skin is visually pleasing, but more importantly, offers solid functional buffs. The 5% Building Speed is particularly useful for players racing to upgrade their castles to levels 50 or 55 depending on the season. However, the 5% Prosperity Recovery Speed is the standout buff here, especially for players active in Squad Tournament formats in the Conquest season where Prosperity regeneration is a real factor.

Overall Evaluation

This month’s Gift of Bondings bundle is one of the weaker ones we’ve seen:

  • Pros: The Paradeisos skin offers decent buffs and might be worth it for players chasing server-first progression or actively participating in IB formats.
  • Cons: The third-tier reward is largely cosmetic, and the gathering speed buff is not impactful enough to justify the high price.

If you’re selective about your spending, this is one bundle you can likely skip unless you’re specifically looking to complete your castle skin collection or want that slight edge in building and recovery speed.

Final Recommendation

  • Buy the first tier only if you’re a collector or need the dragon essence.

This month’s Gift of Bondings is a pass for most players. Save your resources for higher-value bundles or strategic upgrades elsewhere.

title: Bundle from september 2025 – Thunderstorm and Bon Voyage
description: Alright, so a lot of you have been sending me DMs about the new Gift of Bondings Bundles: “What’s behind the Gifts of Bonding this time? What’s the TP skin? What’s the castle skin?”. So let us take a detailed look at the full breakdown for September’s three-bundle chain.
html:
Alright, so a lot of you have been sending me DMs about the new Gift of Bondings Bundles: “What’s behind the Gifts of Bonding this time? What’s the TP skin? What’s the castle skin?”. So let us take a detailed look at the full breakdown for September’s three-bundle chain.

Bundle 1 – $5

  • Cosmetic: Hippolyta Profile Picture Frame
  • Other stuff: Minor resources, speedups, and the new addition: a tiny unique artifact element selection chest.

Now, don’t get baited by the artifact chest. It’s nice in theory, but the amount is way too small to be efficient (compared to e.g. Sparks). You don’t buy this for efficiency. You buy it either because:

  1. You like Hippolyta and want her frame.
  2. You’re unlocking bundle 2 because you’re chasing the skins.

Bundle 2 – $50

  • Teleportation Skin: “Thunderstorm” (Lightning Dragon TP effect)
  • Buff: +3% SP Recovery Speed

Here’s where most of the questions were aimed. The Thunderstorm TP skin looks flashy and it pairs amazingly with Wrath of Thunder if you are looking to build a full lightning-themed account (perhaps even with a lightning main march). Stat-wise? Meh. The effect is certainly not the worst one (resource collection rate) but it isnt hugely impactful either.

Let’s do the math:

  • Default regen = 288 SP/day.
  • With Thunderstorm = +8.64 SP/day.

That’s literally a couple more marches per week. Not exactly meta-breaking.

If we’re comparing:

  • Death rate reduction TP effects = Best effect.
  • Resource rate = Worst effect.
  • Honor rate = Situational
  • Thunderstorm = sits comfortably in the “not terrible, but not worth it for stats” tier.

In essence, what is important to realize here is that you buy this one if you like the look. Like, I am personally holding out for the Fire Dragon TP skin, because that one just fits my fire march thematically. You should think about these as ‘pay for the cosmetics not the effect value’.

Bundle 3 – $100

  • Castle Skin: “Bon Voyage” (Pirate Festival throwback)
  • Buff: +3% Honor Gain

This is where my nostalgia kicks in. A couple years ago, when Bon Voyage first dropped during the Pirate Festival, it was the skin to get, because back then, there weren’t combat skins giving HP boosts or better combat buffs. Having +3% honor was actually useful when climbing the competitive ladders.

I remember it clearly — people who had this skin stood out. It was the king of skins for a good while. Now though? The game has shifted and a lot of skins with actual power effects that impact combat are live and easily obtainable. For comparison the best combat skins are unlocked for 50$ in the seasonal events nowadays whereas this Bon Voyage from Bondings will cost you 155$ and has no combat effects and only 3% honor gain.

  • City of Glory → +2% HP and +5% honor.
  • Corridor of Ghostflame → upgradeable to +3% HP and +15% honor.

So yeah… Bon Voyage is outdated in terms of usefulness. But style-wise? Still badass. You slap that Pirate skin on while running rat-pack style raids and you just look good.

My Take

So, is it worth the $155 total for all three bundles? If you’re efficiency-minded, absolutely not. You’re way better off buying Sparks or artifact packs.

But if you’re a collector or you just love flexing old-school cosmetics, then this lineup is actually a fun one:

  • Bundle 1: Unlocks the chain, small perk if you like Hippolyta.
  • Bundle 2: Flashy TP effect, tiny buff. Players looking to complete a lightning-themed castle, now is your time for a cosmetic upgrade!
  • Bundle 3: A straight-up throwback to when Pirate skin ruled the scene. Cool old school look, but not a good skin anymore.

Every time Gift of Bondings pops up, the same question floods Discord, alliance chats, and the forums: “What’s in this bonding?”
And honestly, it’s a fair question — because you can’t even see which cosmetics are available until you’ve bought the first bundle. It’s always that little mystery that makes players hesitate: is it worth diving in, or should you skip this one?

So, let’s take a look at what’s hiding inside this round of Gift of Bondings, which just went live today — and see if it’s time to grab a new look for your marches or castle.

🔥 The Theme This Time

This bonding is clearly themed around Halloween and Fire aesthetics — a mix between spooky and blazing visuals. You’ll see that right away with the Shriek Ghost Fiesta frame and Night Phantoms Castle Skin, both originally from older Halloween events.

And tying it together? The new Blazing Fire Teleport Effect, a flashy fire dragon-style teleport animation that really suits any Fire main who likes to go full thematic.

💎 Bundle Breakdown

Bundle 1 — $4.99

  • Shriek Ghost Fiesta Profile Picture Frame

  • 520 Gems
  • 4x Elemental Selection Unique Artifact Fragments
  • 2x Philosopher Stones
  • 500 VIP Points
  • Some basic resources

This first one’s mostly the gateway purchase — you’ll need it if you want to unlock Bundles 2 and 3 to even see what cosmetics are in this rotation. But the Halloween frame itself is actually solid if you like themed visuals for this season.

Bundle 2 — $49.99

  • 16x Elemental Unique Artifact Selection Fragments

If you’re a Fire main like me, this one’s tempting. But the price tag stings. You’re paying $55 total (including the first bundle) for a teleport effect and some decent but not game-breaking materials.

  • Resources

This one’s for collectors or anyone who wants to complete the full Halloween theme. Expensive, yes, but as usual with Bondings, you’re really paying for exclusivity and looks here.

🧩 Bottom Line

This Gift of Bondings is aesthetic-first, value-second.
If you’re buying for cosmetics, the Fire TP effect + Halloween frame can be incredibly cool from an RP perspective.
If you’re chasing efficiency or progress, skip it — the buffs and items aren’t enough to justify the cost.

Verdict: Great look for Halloween and Fire mains, but only worth it if you care about style over substance.

description: With Patch 2.8.2, Infinity Kingdom introduced a brand-new seven-day bundle system, a recurring micro-spending feature aimed at giving players daily rewards for a limited time. html:
With Patch 2.8.2, Infinity Kingdom introduced a brand-new seven-day bundle system, a recurring micro-spending feature aimed at giving players daily rewards for a limited time. The idea is simple: purchase a low-cost bundle for seven consecutive days, and if you buy five of them, you unlock a bonus chest.

On paper, this sounds like an appealing, low-commitment way to stack up on rare resources — but is it actually worth it?

Let’s break it down.

🔍 How the Seven-Day Bundle Works

The bundles come in daily rotation. Each day, for seven days, you have the option to purchase a bundle box, usually priced between $2–3 USD. If you purchase at least five out of the seven, you unlock a bonus chest at the end of the cycle.

The contents of the bundles vary by rotation and even by server season (e.g. early game vs. Conquest), and so far we’ve seen:

🧪 First Rotation – Philosopher Stones

  • Cost: $2/day
  • Contents:
    • 3x Philosopher Stones
    • 60x Saladin Fragments (bonus unlock across the week)
    • Bonus Chest: Full Saladin unlock + additional resources

This was arguably one of the better-value bundles, especially for newer players. You’re essentially getting 15 Philosopher Stones and a legendary Immortal for around $10, plus some gems and extras. Not game-breaking, but decent value — especially if you’re low on purple crystals for shop rotations.

Still, for spenders who already participate in seasonal bundles and events like Golden Path, purple crystals will come by the hundreds just from melting fragments. So this bundle, while reasonable, won’t be essential for most.

🔧 Second Rotation – Artifact Fragments

  • Cost: $3/day
  • Contents:
    • 5x Random Artifact Fragments per day
    • Bonus Chest: A non-unique full artifact
    • Some materials and gems

Unfortunately, this bundle is not recommended. Regular artifacts (i.e., not unique or legendary ones) are simply not valuable, even in early seasons like Season 1. By the time you’re chasing artifacts, you’re usually in a position where skill stones or energy-based skills are a much better investment. Spending $15 for normal artifact fragments is hard to justify.

🔥 Conquest Rotation – Dragon Talents (Dragon Essences)

  • Cost: $3/day
  • Contents:
    • Dragon Talent Stones (Essences)
    • Bonus: Additional essences or resources

This one is situationally valuable. In early Conquest, when you’re just starting to develop Dragon Talents, essences can be a limiting factor. The bundle offers a manageable way to speed up that progression. That said, over time, most active Conquest players will accumulate more than enough essences through regular gameplay — so it’s a good early boost, but not a long-term value.

💸 Verdict – Should You Buy?

Let’s be blunt — most of these bundles are not worth your money.

The $2 Philosopher Stone bundle is decent for early-game spenders who need cheap purple crystals or want a quick Immortal unlock. Even then, it’s mostly convenience, not necessity.

The $3 artifact fragment bundle is, frankly, terrible value. You’re better off saving for better bundles or spending that money on Tower of Knowledge skill shards, event packs, or VIP upgrades.

The Dragon Essence bundle for Conquest players is situationally useful, but only if you’re in the early stages of developing your Dragon Talents. Later, you’ll have more than you can spend.

🔑 Summary

  • ✅ Philosopher Stones Bundle ($2): Okay value, especially for unlocking a specific Immortal like Saladin. Decent if you’re short on purple crystals.
  • ❌ Artifact Fragment Bundle ($3): Not recommended. Regular artifacts are cheap, common, and mostly irrelevant.
  • ⚖️ Dragon Essence Bundle ($3): Good early Conquest boost, but falls off in value quickly.

Ultimately, if you’re a spender, you’re probably better off putting your money into event packs with high-end skill shards, ToK unlocks, or VIP progress. These bundles aren’t predatory, but they’re not game-changers either.

🛒 Infinity Kingdom In-Game Shops Guide: What to Buy

Whether you’re a light spender or a whale, knowing where to spend your resources is key to efficient progression in Infinity Kingdom. This guide walks through all the day-to-day in-game shops and outlines what’s worth your investment — and what isn’t. We are not going to cover all the standard bundles, since most of them are too expensive to consistently buy for normal players and you should buy from there only if you really need something. We are going to cover the in-game shops which are either free or very cheap and efficient. 

⚔️ Arena Shop

The Arena Shop can be deceptive. While it offers a variety of items, almost all of them are bad value compared to other sources. The two standout exceptions are Stardust, which is always in demand for portait levels, and the big 2400 Wind Dragon Crystals, which are priced far more rare than other dragon shards. Even if you’re not building Wind, it’s wise to collect these for potential future use or to save resources if you ever need Wind (especially with the new buff in patch 2.8.2). Small dragon crystal bundles here are a massive trap — they look tempting but offer extremely poor shard-per-cost ratios.

✅ Buy:

  • Stardust – A must-buy every time it appears.
  • Big Gold Bundle Wind Dragon Crystals – Even if you’re not building Wind, these are great value.

❌ Avoid:

  • Other dragon crystals – Horribly overpriced. For example, 40,000 arena coins may give you 800 shards vs. 6,000 in the Wind pack — over 7x less value.

🧭 Mysterium Shop

This shop rotates based on Mysterium progress and offers one of the few ways to get Elite Artifacts (EAs) without relying on luck or cash. If you’re developing an Immortal that’s missing their artifact, this should be your top priority.

✅ Buy:

  • Elite Artifacts (EAs) for Immortals you actively use.
  • Only consider other items after you’re done with EAs.

❌ Avoid:

  • Teleports on Main – Use alt-account inventories for porting instead and CoR shop.

🔄 Triss Shop (Skill Recycle Shop)

This shop is critical for developing a strong march. It lets you recycle unwanted skills into a unique currency to buy top-tier ones. Since meta skills like No Escape, Purify, Weakening Curse, define competitive play, you should always prioritize these. Artifacts are a secondary option once your core builds are complete. Avoid using this shop to grab UAs unless in very niche cases like if you cannot obtain e.g. Trajan’s elsewhere — they are often freely available from events and not worth the spend here.

✅ Buy:

  • Top-tier Skills only (e.g. No Escape, Energy Burst, etc.).
  • Artifacts only if you’re done with key skills.

❌ Avoid:

  • Low-tier skills – They offer no real advantage and waste your currency.

🛡️ Alliance Shop

Simple and essential: Space Portals are the only purchase that makes sense in this shop. These normally cost real money, but here you get them free just for contributing to alliance tech or donating during KVK. Even if you don’t currently need to teleport, having a stockpile means you’re ready for war, server merges, or emergency jumps. No other items in the shop come close in value.

✅ Buy:

  • Space Portals – Normally $5 each, totally free here with steady coin flow.

❌ Avoid:

  • Everything else – Cost per value is significantly worse than the portals.

🌟 Golden Path Merit Shop

This shop is a jackpot for mid-to-late-game players. You earn merit through Golden Path missions and can use it for powerful Immortals, AP, dragons, Stardust, and even portals. Dragon Castle Skins like Mountain can offer great utility, while Immortals like YSS are excellent long-term investments. The shop is very flexible, making it great for plugging resource gaps. You can even buy Stardust here in a pinch. Frames and chat skins are purely aesthetic but available for collectors.

✅ Buy:

  • Important Dragons – Based on your team comp (Mountain is great early).
  • Core Immortals – YSS, Trajan, etc.
  • Big AP Pots – Excellent value for long-term farming or raids.
  • Space Portals – Backup if you’re short elsewhere. Personally I like to obtain them here too as long as I am below my threshold. When I hit my count I collect only from Alliance shop etc.

Optional:

  • Stardust – Rare and useful but expensive pick here.
  • Frames & Chat Skins – If you care about cosmetics.

❌ Avoid:

  • Artifacts here – Usually more efficient to get elsewhere (Mysterium, Triss).

💠 Pearl Shop (Daily Purchase)

This is one of the game’s most flexible shops for spenders. You earn Pearls from spending and can convert them into valuable resources. Sun and Power Crystals are your best value here for building equipment. You can also grab Dust, which is rare and needed in large amounts. Occasionally, you can use Pearls to finish key Immortals (like grabbing a few shards for Alex to unlock his specialization). Avoid buying keys or Shadow Crystals unless you’re spending heavily or chasing something specific. Personally I like to stack Pearls to buy Epic Dragon Chest Keys, but only while you are in dire need of crystals as you rapidly progress in e.g. season 1 and 2.

✅ Buy:

  • Sun & Power Crystals – Excellent cost efficiency for equipment growth.
  • Dust – Needed for specializations; hard to farm.

Optional:

  • Immortals – Finish specific units if close.
  • Keys – Only in progress stage.

❌ Avoid:

  • Shadow Crystals – Overpriced for their value.

💎 VIP Shop

Reserved for long-term or heavy spenders, this shop lets you spend VIP Points on premium items. Most notably, it’s where you can unlock Holy and Shadow Dragons, but you’ll need to focus on one. Splitting between both is too expensive. Unless you’re a super whale, pick one and commit. Everything else in the shop is filler — some players grab epic chests during dragon rushes, but most regret it later. If you’re under VIP 15, you may want to push VIP using gems slowly over time — it’s a long but worthwhile goal!

✅ Buy:

  • Holy or Shadow Dragon – Best investment of your VIP points.
    • Holy Dragon is top-tier, great synergy and power.
    • Shadow Dragon has unique combos — niche but strong.

❌ Avoid:

  • Epic chests, gear, etc. – Poor long-term value.
  • Trying to get both dragons – Focus on one or you’ll stagnate.

🪙 VIP with Gems?

If you’re not VIP 15 yet:

  • Spending gems to reach VIP 15 over time is viable.
  • Especially good in big alliances where you get lots of free VIP points.

🏪 Standard Gem Shop

The “default” gem shop looks like a place to grab quick resources — but in practice, it’s just a price anchor. Almost everything here is full price and rarely worth it. Treat it as a reference point to know what’s overpriced, and only buy here in one situation: using gems to push VIP level when nearing milestones like VIP 15.

❌ Avoid:

  • Everything — It’s full price. You’ll find better deals almost anywhere else.

✅ Only exception:

  • VIP Points – If you’re gem-pushing to hit VIP milestones.

GTArcade Platform Spending Event – November 2025 – Single Purchase Milestones (with Multi-Bundle Checkout Support)

Overview

The November 2025 GTArcade Platform Spending Event introduces a milestone system that looks similar to past recharge events, but works very differently in practice. Even though the event text says “Single order ≥ X”, the key detail is how GTArcade handles checkout:

A “Single Purchase” equals one checkout transaction on the GTArcade App. You may include multiple bundles or vouchers in that one checkout, and the combined total determines which milestone rewards you receive.

Purchases made separately do not add up. Only the total value of a single finalized checkout counts toward milestone thresholds.

When a single purchase reaches a milestone tier, the reward for that tier (and all lower tiers) is sent instantly to your in-game mailbox.

How the Milestones Work

  • All rewards are tied to the total value of one checkout transaction.
  • You can add multiple vouchers or bundles to the same cart and pay once.
  • The system treats this as one purchase and checks the final combined total.
  • If the total meets or exceeds a milestone threshold, you immediately receive that milestone’s rewards.
  • Separate purchases are not cumulative and will not unlock new milestones unless a single purchase meets a threshold by itself.

Example

A player buys 6 × $4.99 vouchers in one cart and checks out for ~$30.
This single purchase unlocks:

  • $4.99 tier
  • $9.99 tier
  • $19.99 tier

Making more $4.99 purchases individually afterwards does not unlock the $49.99 tier, because each separate purchase is too small. Hence you should make up your mind as to how much do you want to spend this month and then try and make a single-purchase for that amount with the vouchers or divine coins or whatever you are currently chasing fitting the nearest threshold.

Milestone Rewards (Single Purchase Thresholds)

You receive the reward for the highest tier your purchase meets, plus all tiers below it, once per event period.

Early & Mid-Level Tiers

Single Purchase ≥ $4.99

  • Random Immortal Fragments ×8
  • Artifact Schematic Fragment Selection Chest ×8
  • Gems ×520

Single Purchase ≥ $9.99

  • Random Immortal Fragments ×12
  • Artifact Schematic Fragment Selection Chest ×12
  • Gems ×1,100

Single Purchase ≥ $19.99

  • Random Immortal Fragments ×16
  • Artifact Schematic Fragment Selection Chest ×16
  • Gems ×2,300

Single Purchase ≥ $49.99

  • Random Immortal Fragments ×24
  • Artifact Schematic Fragment Selection Chest ×24
  • Gems ×6,000

High-End / Late Game Tiers

These tiers include Holy/Shadow Immortal progress, high-tier artifact fragments, and dragon resources.

Single Purchase ≥ $99

  • Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments ×8
  • Shadow & Light Artifact Fragment Selection Chest ×8
  • Eternal Dragon Soul Chest ×20
  • Gems ×12,500

Single Purchase ≥ $198

  • Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments ×14
  • Shadow & Light Artifact Fragment Selection Chest ×14
  • Eternal Dragon Soul Chest ×40
  • Gems ×25,000

Single Purchase ≥ $297

  • Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments ×24

  • Eternal Dragon Soul Chest ×60
  • Gems ×37,500

Single Purchase ≥ $396

  • Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments ×32
  • Shadow & Light Artifact Fragment Selection Chest ×32
  • Eternal Dragon Soul Chest ×80
  • Gems ×50,000

Single Purchase ≥ $495

  • Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments ×42
  • Shadow & Light Artifact Fragment Selection Chest ×42
  • Eternal Dragon Soul Chest ×100
  • Gems ×62,500

GTArcade First Purchase Gift

Your first-ever purchase on the GTArcade App during the event will additionally grant you a one-time reward, and a quite big one! This is a very cool addition to the Gtarcade shop to keep players active. But even the smallest spenders can get value here – and its good value!

One single purchase, even of just a 1$ voucher, gets you the first-purchase gift of the month.

Contains:

  • Cleopatra ×1
  • Philosopher’s Stone ×9
  • Medium SP Recovery ×3
  • Medium AP Recovery ×3
  • Gems ×100
  • VIP Points ×100

This reward is one-time only for the event version.

Conclusion

The November 2025 GTArcade Platform Spending Event uses authentic Single Purchase Milestones, but with a flexible cart system that lets players combine multiple bundles into a single high-value purchase. Only the total amount of a single checkout matters, and separate purchases do not stack.

Stay Updated with Community Events

description: Gtarcade launched a new spender promo on the Gtarcade App for Infinity Kingdom. The title says “First Purchase Event,” but there are actually two parts running together in October:
html:
Gtarcade launched a new spender promo on the Gtarcade App for Infinity Kingdom. The title says “First Purchase Event,” but there are actually two parts running together in October:

  1. a First Purchase Reward, and
  2. a Milestone Purchase Gift that stacks as you spend more.

Event window: live now, ends October 30, 2025.
Where to buy: Gtarcade App specifically (not other platforms or the in-game shop). The App usually gives better value anyway; this just stacks extra rewards on top.

1) First Purchase Reward

On your first Gtarcade App purchase in October, you get:

  • 60× William I fragments (Fire) — Great in Season 1 while you’re ramping. If you’re doing early Fire (which I still recommend for F2P/low spenders), he pairs with Hippolyta, then later Empress Wu and Cyrus (or Qin). He’ll do work until you pivot into Trajan once Golden Path unlocks.
    OR if you’re past the William phase, take 6,000 Soul Crystals—still excellent value.
  • Plus: 100 Gems, 9 Philosopher’s Stones, 3× Medium SP, 3× Medium AP, 100 VIP Points.

How it triggers: make any first purchase in the App (the purchased item is instant; the bonus usually shows up after ~1 hour).
Example: buy a $1 voucher—you get the voucher and this whole First Purchase Reward.
Tip: if you buy daily Pearl Bundles, look for voucher + AP deals in the App to stack value.

2) Milestone Purchase Gift (October duration)

Tracks your cumulative spend through the App in October. Hit a threshold and you unlock that tier—and you keep everything from all lower tiers as you climb.

Milestone Rewards Table

Notes:
– $5–$50 tiers give Random Immortal Fragments + Artifact Selection Schematic Fragments (not unique artifacts).
– $99+ tiers switch to Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments and Holy/Shadow Selection Artifact Fragments, and add Eternal dragon Soul chests (each chest contains 10 dragon crystals for Shadow or Holy dragon).

Cumulative: You receive all lower-tier rewards once you pass each threshold.

Total Rewards if You Go to the Full $500 (the $495 tier)

From the Milestone event alone (First Purchase Reward is separate):

  • Normal Immortal Fragments: 60 total (8+12+16+24)
  • Normal Artifact Selection Fragments: 60 total
  • Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments: 120 total (8+14+24+32+42)
  • Holy/Shadow Artifact Selection Fragments: 120 total
  • Eternal dragon Soul chests: 300 total → 3,000 dragon crystals (10 per chest) for Shadow/Holy
  • Gems: 197,420 total

That’s a chunky stack, and it’s in addition to your First Purchase Reward (William or 6,000 Soul Crystals + goodies).

Player Perspective (quick take)

If you’re early/mid game, the lower tiers help immediately—random frags and artifact picks you can use right away, plus a huge gem injection to speed up account growth.
If you’re mid to late game, you’re mainly here for the Holy/Shadow fragments and the Eternal dragon Soul chests—nice push for dragon progress without touching the in-game store.

I still wouldn’t spend just for milestones, but if you’re buying anyway, do it through the App this month. App pricing already beats in-game; these milestones are free value on top.

All in all

Solid October promo. Clean First Purchase value for starters (or 6,000 SC if you’ve moved on), then cumulative Milestone tiers that ramp into Holy/Shadow progress and dragon crystals. Bottom line: if you’re spending, push it through the Gtarcade App in October to squeeze max value.

Check back in November to see if they renew the event with new versions of these rewards, to be seen in November 2025, but I expect them to continue.

New to Gtarcade? See more below

Player Perspective, i.e. what I will do:

  • Grab the free bundle immediately (Philosopher’s Stones are always high value).
  • Spend the 100 points on the Moonlit Hearth skin — not because the buff is good, but because it’s so cheap and it adds to my collection of skins. Its cute and passing it up seems a wasted opportunity given the incredibly low cost.

What if my Account is not bound to a Gtarcade account?

First of all, I recommend that you fix that immediately. Simply the risk of account deletion, forgetting the password, loosing your phone, etc. is more than enough risk to make Gtarcade Account Binding an important step for you. If this is relevant for you, read more here.

How to acces the Gtarcade App?

Using the Desktop app you find the giftpacks under “Point Shop” as you open the Gtarcade app as you would normally when starting the game. If you do not have the app, download available here.

On Mobile, you can download the App via your preferred App Store or access directly using the in-game shop which has a link at the top. See more below.

title: Best Conquest Spider build 2.8.3? (credit Yawg)
description: The Spider Boss appears twice a week, and it is available to all alliances that have unlocked the boss through alliance building progression. Once summoned, the Spider Boss becomes a shared challenge where all alliance members can contribute damage to take it down.
html:
The Spider Boss appears twice a week, and it is available to all alliances that have unlocked the boss through alliance building progression. Once summoned, the Spider Boss becomes a shared challenge where all alliance members can contribute damage to take it down.

This guide features a top-tier setup provided by Yawgmoth, who has managed to push some of the highest spider boss damage totals we’ve seen, despite not having maxed talents or fully upgraded skills yet. The potential of this composition is enormous, and it should be considered one of the premier builds for any player seeking to dominate spider raids.

The Spider Boss, formally known as the World Spider, is one of the most important PvE activities in Infinity Kingdom, especially for players looking to maximize progression through equipment upgrades and artifact enhancement.

📅 When and Where

🎯 Why You Must Do the Spider Boss

The Spider Boss is the #1 source of Enchanted Stones, the resource used to upgrade your equipment — and equipment upgrades are what skyrocket your Immortals’ stats as you move into mid- and late-game content. Without a steady supply of stones, your power will stagnate.

💎 Rewards You Can Expect:

  • Dragon Crystal Chest Keys – Used to open Dragon Crystal Chests that contain crucial dragon upgrade materials. These are essential for advancing your elemental dragon to higher stages and unlocking powerful passives.
  • Tons of Enchanted Stones – At high levels, each hit on the spider boss can net tens of thousands of stones. This is the most efficient way to collect large amounts for equipment upgrades.
  • Ranking Rewards – Philosopher stones, gems and speed-ups

This is why you need a top tier build! In the following we feature a build from Yawgmoth that has done incredibly well. He has been kind enough to share it with us all! Thank you!

💥 Core Strategy: Maximize Redirect and Burst

The Spider Boss in Infinity Kingdom remains one of the most challenging yet rewarding PvE encounters in the game. The fight is all about single-target burst damage, careful synergy between immortals, and most importantly, the Life-Link + Absolute Defense combo, which redirects massive amounts of damage back at the boss. With the right build, players can achieve incredible damage numbers.

  • Single-target damage is king in spider fights.
  • Stack damage amplification and energy regeneration to optimize ultimates.
  • Key synergy: Life-Link + Absolute Defense on your tank transfers incoming damage to the boss.
  • Battle duration allows time for ramp-up skills to fully scale.

🔥 Immortal Setup Breakdown

🧙 Mathilda (Support / Energy Engine)

  • Purpose: Energy regeneration + buffs
  • Key Skills:
    • Weakness Aura – Critical chance boost
    • Soul Synergy – Keeps Tutankhammun at high HP
    • Energy Shield – Shields also amplify Life-Link redirects
  • Synergy: Buffs team survivability and enables stronger ultimates.

🔥 Seondeok (Backline DPS)

  • Purpose: Main magic damage dealer
  • Key Skills:
    • Anger – Physical damage amplification
    • Energy Master (or Absolute Radiance/Energy Burst if unavailable)
    • Fire Protection – Crit-based bonus damage
  • Synergy: High crit rate due to Weakness Aura and low boss resilience means big numbers.

🛡 Khubilaikhan (Debuff Utility)

  • Purpose: Amplify physical damage taken by boss
  • Key Skills:
    • Guard – Support Tutankhammun survivability
    • Life-Link – Mandatory for redirect combo
    • Absolute Defense – Must-have for redirect damage
  • Synergy: Debuffs boost Tutankhammun damage output significantly.

💀 Tutankhammun (Core DPS / Redirect Tank)

  • Purpose: Primary damage dealer and tank via redirect combo
  • Key Skills:
    • Battle Stance – 100% damage boost after ramp
    • Demonic Contract – 150% boost over time
    • Blade Dodge – Additional 70% damage after 20s
  • Total Damage Scaling:
    • +100% Battle Stance
    • +70% Blade Dodge
    • +150% Demonic Contract
    • +20% Mathilda Buff
    • = 340% Total Damage Boost!
  • Tip: Start slow, ramp high. You don’t care about early damage — you’re preparing for the explosion mid-fight.

🧠 Summary Tips:

  • Focus your skill investment on Tutankhammun, he’s the damage engine.
  • Do NOT skip Life-Link or Absolute Defense; they define the strategy.
  • Let Mathilda and Khubilaikhan keep the team alive long enough to scale.
  • Aim for max uptime on critical buffs like Anger and Demonic Contract.
  • Survivability is crucial — running out of HP before scaling kills the setup.

This build, even in its incomplete form, is one of the highest potential spider boss builds tested in Conquest 2.8.3. If you’re chasing top-tier rankings or just trying to farm efficiently, this team is well worth your investment.

Happy hunting!

html:
What does “best” mean during spider event?

Means raw damage. Why? Because of three things: (1) You need to max your damage to rank top 10 in as many spider kills as possible during the day. (2) More dmg = higher chance to get the killing blow. (3) Troop-conservation PvE is impossible. No matter how you run your march, you will loose the same amount of troops. On spider it is impossible to play with minimal losses.

So the question is, how do we make the biggest and badest spider march on the playgound? We need high damage output Immortals, a damage boosting dragon (never run e.g. earth dragon!!) and we want our damage types from both Immortals and passives to have the highest possible single-target damage output (very different from gnomes or PvP).

Best spider setup

You need fire to run optimally, water is the second best alternative (if you are a whale, shadow can work okay too but is outside the scope of this article).

Dragon

You want to run Ignatius the fire dragon in your march. He deals a ton of damage with his breath.

In addition to the raw damage of his breath, Ignatius’ second ability is PERFECT for a boss-killing army. By providing a crit damage buff (an insanely strong one at that) with a high proc chance, he is a must have if you want to be the very best at killing spiders (or bosses).

Immortals

We need to run 3 fire Immortals to get that juicy damage buff

Luckily, fire also have some of the very best Immortals at dealing raw damage. You want to run:

  1. Hippo. She is tied with Yoshiu for best single-target Immortal in the game (with unique artifact she is insane, without she is tied with Yoshi for best damage dealer).
  2. William. He deals decent damage, but more importantly he buffs your Immortals with crit buff that is very strong. He will be our support while maintaining a default decent damage output.
  3. Empress Wu. She deals very nice magic damage and gives us the ability to utilize the strong magic damage passives available. Her own raw damage is quite strong also in single target, and as fire she finished the 4x elemental buff for us.
  4. Yoshitsune. He is tied with Hippo for best single-target DPS in the game. Give him the right passives, and he will blast any single target out of the waters.

Passives

We need to boost our damage as much as possible. This means, shelter, fighting will, life link, assist and all the other meta-passives for PvP are utterly useless.

Maxmium output passives are as follow:

description: Attention adventurers of Norheim, the cross-server spider competition has returned!
html:
Attention adventurers of Norheim, the cross-server spider competition has returned!

We’re delighted to unveil the long-awaited return of the Spider Competition with Round 4! As the echoes of the Legion of Frostborn (SvS) season fade away, a new era of arachnid excellence is upon us. It’s time to once again embrace the challenge and embark on a thrilling journey in the world of Infinity Kingdom.

The spider competition, briefly put on hold due to the fervor of the Legion of Frostborn (SvS) season, is reawakening across all servers. With the closure of that epic chapter, we now usher in a fresh round of the Spider Competition that promises to be even more enthralling than before.

As the grand tapestry of competition unfolds, we’ve made significant enhancements to ensure an equitable and stimulating experience for all. We present to you not one, but two distinct brackets, each designed to test your mettle and foster camaraderie:

  • The Master’s Bracket: Exclusively tailored for those who’ve nurtured their spider allies to achieve level 100.
  • The Rising Stars Bracket: Welcoming all spiders below level 100, this tier ensures that every aspiring contender can partake and flaunt their strategic prowess.

Mark your calendars for the commencement of Round 4, set to begin on Saturday the 5th of August. The fervor will persist until Sunday the 13th of August at 23.59, offering a limited-time window to showcase your spider’s finesse and secure remarkable rewards. It’s time to unravel the treasure trove that awaits:

The Master’s Bracket (Level 100 Spiders):
1st Place: 2000 gems
2nd Place: 1200 gems
3rd Place: 800 gems
4th to 10th Place: 500 gems each
11th to 20th Place: 300 gems each

The Rising Stars Bracket (Spiders below Level 100):
1st Place: 500 gems
2nd to 10th Place: 300 gems each

To partake in this illustrious competition, simply capture an awe-inspiring screenshot of your most spectacular assault (one entry per player). Attach it alongside your player credentials, Lord ID and home server information. Submissions are accepted within the competition timeframe, spanning from the 5th of August to the 13th of August at 23.59.

Remember, only assaults launched during this interval will be considered for the competition. Share your captures within the designated channel on the official Game Discord, allowing your peers to marvel at the prowess of your arachnid companion. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or a budding web-weaver, seize this moment to shine. Embrace the novelties of the brackets and establish your dominance among the elite.

With anticipation rising, prepare to dive into Round 4 of the Cross Server Spider Competition. Arm yourselves for an exhilarating clash of finesse, resolve, and unyielding determination. May the most formidable spiders emerge as triumphant legends!

Best of luck to all contenders, as you weave your destinies into the annals of greatness. May your webs be unbreakable and your triumphs resound throughout Infinity Kingdom!

Attention, Lords and Ladies of Infinity Kingdom! Get ready to embark on a thrilling new chapter in one of our most beloved events—the Cross-Server Spider Competition! After eleven intense seasons, we’re shaking things up to bring you an even more exciting and competitive experience.

What’s New?

This time around, we’re introducing four distinct brackets based on your march’s Strategic Troop Power (STP). This innovative change aims to level the playing field, ensuring that battles are matched more fairly and focus on player strategies and builds. Say goodbye to the days of David versus Goliath matchups and hello to competitions where tactics truly shine!

Bracket Breakdown:

  • Bracket A: 500K+ STP
  • Bracket B: 400K-500K STP
  • Bracket C: 300K-400K STP

title: Earn Justice Points & Enchant stones
description: Every titantula spider event you have a total of 10 free attacks over the course of the entire day. Moreover, you are able to purchase an additional 10 attacks costing you 500 gems.
html:
Every titantula spider event you have a total of 10 free attacks over the course of the entire day. Moreover, you are able to purchase an additional 10 attacks costing you 500 gems.

The spider will spawn 6 times during the day of the event. Starting at in-game reset time and then every 4 hours onwards.

This means that you have a limited amount of attack available to reap maximum rewards. Therefore you must think carefully before you engage a spider. If you use a bunch of attacks and the spider doesn’t die, you will not get any damage ranking bonus from this spider! Only killed spiders reward the participating players with a bonus.

When you fight the spider earn both Justice Points and Enchant stone. Justice points are the primary objective of this event and is what is used to compete for event ranking (and awesome rewards) as well as to earn the event participation rewards.

In addition to justice points, you also earn a lot of Enchant stones by participating in the spider event. These are used to upgrade equipment for your Immortals.

Earn Justice Points and Enchant stones

You get a lot out of a single attack on the spider. Moreover, you should always use your attacks to reach a top 10 ranking on the spider. I usually do 3 or 4 spider a day and simply make sure I am within the top 10 on the kill, then try and snipe with a late attack.

You should always try and get the last hit. Beware, that you must remain top 10 for the kill, but once that is secured, you should try and hit the killing blow. Be slow with it, it is better to miss your hit because someone else got the kill than to use an attack on a spider where you would have ranked top 10 anyway. The attack is refunded if you hit after the spider is dead.

Only exception to this, is if you are in close competition with someone and can see you will likely end on the same number of ranking points (event ranking). Then you want to hit quickly and get the point cap you both will reach – you want to do this, because if two players are tied in points, the player who got the points first wins.

Tips n tricks

Getting killing blows require some finess and a good bit of luck.

You need to make yourself a march that deals around 1% in damage, reliably. See my guides on marches.

When the spider is active, you need to watch carefully who in your server turns up, watch the damage meter and how much power the attendees have. Based on this you can aproximate their damage dealt per hit and count down to the killing blow.

I usually use the last 30% to take note of the attacks. I move quickly from each of the three spider spawns and simply count attacks landing on the spider (take note if high power people are idle untill last min you wanna adjust accordingly). When the spider have droppedn from 30% to 20% I note how many attacks were made – e.g. let’s say 15. If from 20% to 10% takes 13 hits, I will then make sure that my last attack is made as the 13th attack move towards the spider.

If powerful people are at spider trying to snipe it, I will subtract a chunck of hits and go when I have seen 10 armies marching.

description: Time Rift Breaker – A Game-Changing Event
html:
Time Rift Breaker – A Game-Changing Event

The Time Rift Breaker event is unquestionably one of the most anticipated additions in Version 2.6.2. It promises to be a game-changer, reminiscent of the beloved Spider event, but on a grander scale. This cross-server event invites lords from the same season to unite and confront a formidable adversary. It introduces a dynamic twist to the gameplay, where lords must strategize based on elemental weaknesses, adding an extra layer of depth to battles. With different elemental weaknesses and a prolonged cross-server format, it’s an event that holds immense promise and anticipation.

Time Rift Breaker 101 – A Cross-Server Challenge

One of the standout additions to Infinity Kingdom in Version 2.6.2 is the Time Rift Breaker event. This is a cross-server event that allows lords from the same season to come together and challenge a formidable adversary. To access the event, simply tap on the “Well of Time” located in the bottom-right corner of your screen.

Event Requirements:

  • Your server must have entered Season 2.
  • Your Castle Level must be equal to or higher than Level 15.

Event Period:

  • The event starts every Monday at 00:00 (UTC) and concludes every Sunday at 24:00 (UTC).
  • During the first two days (Monday to Wednesday), the enemy is in the recharge and incubation stage and cannot be attacked.
  • The challenge stage begins every Thursday at 00:00 (UTC) and runs until Sunday at 24:00 (UTC). During this period, you can attack the enemy. If defeated, the enemy will resurrect after a certain time or escape if not defeated.

Event Rules:

  • Each lord has three challenge attempts daily.
  • All battles in this event are automatic.

title: How to beat Amplify
description: Mastering the Challenge: A Guide to Dominating the Time Rift Breaker Boss – Amplify
html:
Mastering the Challenge: A Guide to Dominating the Time Rift Breaker Boss – Amplify

Greetings, valiant commanders! In our relentless pursuit through the Time Rift, today’s focus is on the fearsome adversary known as Amplify. Unlike the previous boss, Venom, who showered us with continuous magical damage, Amplify opts for a different approach—delivering colossal physical blows in a few decisive strikes. In this guide, we’ll unravel the intricacies of Amplify’s tactics, weaknesses, and share strategies to maximize your damage potential.

Amplify’s Mechanics:

Amplify specializes in dealing massive physical damage, primarily targeting your front-left tanking Immortal. His energy skill, Furious Bite, inflicts substantial damage, but the real threat lies in its 20% damage increase per active buff, potentially doubling the damage output. Furthermore, Furious Bite may trigger Crush, an immensely powerful ability activated after specific conditions are met, posing a severe threat to your Immortals.

Weakness Exploitation:

Amplify is susceptible to Fire, Water, and Earth damage, offering a 25% damage boost when exploiting weaknesses. While weaknesses play a crucial role, the deciding factor for success lies in adapting your strategy to counter the boss’s mechanics effectively. Fire builds are particularly advantageous against Amplify, making Alexander Khubilai and Hippolytta a potent combination.

Control Tactics:

In a surprising turn of events, control strategies are rendered ineffective against Amplify. The boss seems entirely immune to control effects, making Loki builds less effective this week. Remove instigation, root, and similar effects from your builds, and focus on alternative strategies.

Proven Strategies for Amplify Showdown:

  1. High Energy Regeneration: Equip Immortals like Hippolytta and Khubilai Khan with high energy regeneration to enhance offensive capabilities.
  1. Utilize Single Target Damage Skills: Optimize your physical damage-dealing frontliners with combo and other single-target damage skills for maximum impact.
  1. Exploit Weakness Crits: Always leverage weakness to gain a consistent high crit rate, amplifying the effectiveness of each hit.
  1. Strategic Defensives: Deploy Hippolytta to hard counter Amplify’s energy and attack speed. If Hippolytta isn’t in your setup, prioritize Absolute Defense and Life-Link on your tank to withstand the boss’s burst damage.
  1. Dodge Rate Strategies: Given Amplify’s physical damage focus, incorporate dodge rate to mitigate his abilities. Misleading and a Manco UA can grant substantial dodge chances, significantly reducing incoming damage.

Customizing Your Build:

While there are numerous effective builds against Amplify, certain fundamentals remain crucial:

  • Prioritize Hippolytta for energy control.
  • Utilize Absolute Defense and Life-Link for tank survivability.
  • Maximize dodge rate for additional defense.
  • Experiment with damage boons and skills for increased damage output.

My three different builds for this week (work in progress)

I do not have too many Immortals to choose from – no Mathilda or Ragnar for this week – but here is what I’m running. My holy is performing terribly this week without any advantage and an overkil on AOE survivability and low single-target damage. This setup could do better as most anything else to be honest. But it’s what I have!

Fire and Earth-Khubilai did very well this week.

Earth Khubilai: 182.6M – 219M

Fire w Yoshi: 88.4M – 111.7M

Holy w. Herald: 32.3M – 57.5M

There was a lot of big fluctuations in performance this week, mainly because of how this boss operates mechanically. He deals massive damage in bursts, meaning just a few good or bad luck’s on your Absolute Defense + Life-Link setup can make a massive difference.

Likewise, if you get lucky with your dodges and get them on Crush you can stay alive for a long time! These RNG elements are profound this week. Last week had control as the RNG element, this week has Dodge and Life-Link+AD as the main defining RNG factor.

In conclusion, Amplify demands a strategic approach that balances offense and defense. Adapt your build to counter the boss’s mechanics, exploit weaknesses, and lead your Immortals to victory. May your strategies be sound, and your hits be colossal, commanders!

title: How to beat Vampirism
description: Conquering Vampirism: A Comprehensive Player Guide
html:
Conquering Vampirism: A Comprehensive Player Guide

In this guide, we will examine the Rift Breaker Boss named Vampirism, exploring his abilities and strategies for achieving the most significant hits possible. In our previous guides, we delved into Venom and Amplify – two bosses that are complete opposites.

With Vampirism, we encounter a unique boss that balances continuous damage and high burst damage, without being immune to control but not particularly weak to it either. Unfortunately, defeating this boss requires a considerable investment in pay-to-play skills and setups, along with very high power to outscale the damage output. Personally, it is my least favorite of the three bosses.

Firstly, let’s cover the basics

Vampirism possesses an active skill and two passive skills to engage in battle. Its active skill, ‘Super Spiderweb,’ inflicts massive Magical Damage to enemies while absorbing health equal to 50% of the damage dealt. Despite my attempts to test wounds against this effect, I did not observe any healing negation. However, wounds debuffs are worth further investigation for future encounters with Vampirism. Please try this out yourself and share your results!

In addition to the active burst skill, the boss has a passive skill called ‘Counterattack.’ This ability poses a significant threat as it counters the high damage output required for a boss-killing build. The boss cannot regenerate passive energy, but every time it takes damage, it gains energy.

Once it reaches 300 energy, it uses Torment, inflicting additional damage on your team.

Consequently, setups like Alexander Berserk, Wind Rage, Combo, and Wind Rage + Adrenaline Rush regen builds are not effective due to the high frequency of damage instances, causing setups to rapidly self-destruct. To counter this, focus on building more damage into attacks rather than increasing attack speed. For example, on Alexander, consider using Anger or even Duel Master over some attack speed-boosting skills.

Weaknesses: Shadow, Lightning, Wind
While exploiting weaknesses for an added 25% damage is beneficial, it is not the sole determinant of what works best. The weakness to lightning can be advantageous if wounds prove effective, but using lightning requires a Charles to avoid quick demise. Although a leech shadow team might work, I have not witnessed any build achieving sustained power high enough to combat Vampirism as effectively as Holy Energy Shield builds.

Control strategies

Control strategies can be effective against Vampirism. Stuns, roots, and confusion effects can mitigate incoming damage. However, achieving awe-inspiring results with control builds is challenging, and luck plays a significant role, especially with perfect confusion procs around important skill triggers. Loki holies are top-tier for this boss. While I experimented with Instigation builds, I found the value to be lacking compared to running other defensive or offensive buffs on my support Immortals.

What you should be doing:

There are numerous spider-killing builds, and my setup is continually evolving. However, some fundamentals remain consistent:

  • Running high energy regen on Immortals like Hippolytta and Khubilaikhan provides substantial offensive capability. Note that Wind-Rage regen builds are weaker on this boss than on others, but you may still want to use them for the additional damage. Be aware that you will need to enhance offensive capacity with more sustain due to triggering more regen effects with increased damage instances to the boss.
  • Utilize combo and other single-target damage skills on your physical damage-dealing frontliners. While Combo still yields good results, consider running it in combination with Anger instead of Wind Rage to maximize damage per hit.
  • Always apply Weakness. Bosses have relatively low resistance, and with weakness, you gain a consistently high crit rate, crucial for maximizing damage.
  • Incorporate defensive strategies. Against Vampirism, shield effects are essential due to continuous damage. Charles is an MVP Immortal for this boss fight. Additionally, tower of knowledge skills like Energy Shield and Jade Barrier are potent against Vampirism.
  • Regarding Life-Link + Absolute Defense combos, this is recommended against Vampirism. While it yields better results than against Venom, it has less impact than against Amplify. The boss deals considerable damage to your tank Immortal, but the main threat is the AOE damage. This combo is strong enough to be recommended, and I achieved varying results in battles. I also experimented with an Assist + Absolute Defense + Life-Link combination on my tank, which worked well, but the usefulness of Assist depends on your build and backline reliance.
  • This week, prioritize defensive ToK skills such as Resist over control slots. This allows for more damage boons instead of control, but also necessitates prioritizing defense and sustain over some offensive capacities used in Amplify builds.
  • The best defenses against Vampirism include:
    • Charles, the Earth tank Immortal, due to powerful shields.
    • Life-Link + Absolute Defense on your tank.
    • Resist, a powerful effect against Magical Damage.

Note that dodge rate and attack speed reductions are almost worthless for this boss. Additionally, Hippolytta is ineffective for Vampirism, as her ability to remove energy is useless against this boss.

Here are my notable builds for Vampirism

  • Khubilaikhan – Alexander – Qin – Zeno builds still top my list with 97.6M damage. However, they are noticeably weaker due to the high attack speed of the build, making it challenging to sustain the damage being dealt back.
  • I experimented with a holy pure build, achieving decent results with 79.7M damage. However, this setup required removing Khubilaikhan from the earth team. I then changed it to a Himiko-Alexander-Charles-Zeno earth team, which performed well with Charles’s exceptional sustain, achieving 78.4M damage.
  • My fire build performed poorly, as expected, with 35.9M damage hits. Fire lacks sustain, leading to troop losses and reduced damage output. If fire or lightning is your main in PvP combat, it’s advisable to use them for bosses as well, running Charles and considering swapping out Hippolytta this week for better sustain.
  • None of my attempts came close to the whale holy setups. A holy team achieved top ranking on my server with 188M damage, showcasing the boss’s reliance on raw power and healing capability. With a maxed Theo, energy shield, Vitality Touch, and Spring of Life, these builds can sustain high troop counts for extended periods, allowing low single-target builds to still deal significant total damage.

I can only imagine what the biggest holy whales can achieve on this boss if they tried hard for it. Definitely not a F2P or light spender friendly boss.

Infinity Kingdom Guide: Conquering the Time Rift Breaker Boss – Venom

Understanding Venom’s Tactics:

Venom, the Time Rift Breaker Boss, poses a significant threat with frequent Magical Damage to all enemies. Additionally, his Dark Harvest ability inflicts massive damage once your Immortal accumulates 2 stacks of Venom.

To maximize your success against Venom, you must carefully plan your strategy and capitalize on his weaknesses.

Exploiting Weaknesses:

Venom is particularly vulnerable to Holy, Lightning, and Fire damage. While Holy and Lightning perform admirably, Fire can lack sustain and succumb quickly to continuous damage.

If opting for a Fire-based strategy, ensure sustainability to withstand Venom’s onslaught. Remember, exploiting weaknesses is beneficial, but a robust overall build is crucial for success.

Optimal Team Compositions:

While exploiting weaknesses is advantageous, certain builds prioritize immense single-target damage over weaknesses.

Consider a lineup like Khubilai-Alex-Qin-Zeno for exceptional results, relying on Alex’s potent single-target damage.

Incorporating Control Strategies:

Controlling Venom is paramount for achieving high scores. Stuns and confusion are particularly effective.

Utilize Immortals with Instigation or Loki (for advanced players) for powerful control. Stuns grant additional fighting time and interrupt abilities, while confusion prevents the boss from hitting your Immortals, reducing damage to zero.

Essential Tips for Venom Showdown:

  1. High Energy Regeneration: Equip Immortals like Hippolytta and Khubilai Khan with high energy regen to enhance offensive capabilities.

  4. Utilize Instigation: Incorporate Instigation for crucial confuse procs, significantly impacting the damage dealt to Venom.
  5. Embrace Weakness: Always exploit Venom’s weakness. Use Weakness for a consistent high crit rate, enhancing each hit’s value. Blessing of War is essential for maximizing initial damage when troop counts are high.

An In-Depth Analysis of the Time Rift Breaker Event in Infinity Kingdom

Greetings, fellow commanders! As the first week of the Time Rift Breaker event in Infinity Kingdom comes to a close, it’s time to delve into the intricacies of this exciting weekly event. With the latest patch, the Time Rift Breaker event has made its debut in the world of Infinity Kingdom. This event is not to be missed, as it offers a unique and rewarding experience. The Rift Breaker makes its appearance in every server within the same Legion of Frostborne season, with the caveat that the server must have reached at least season two to participate.

Rules

Rift Breakers emerge every Monday, ready to face the onslaught of fearless commanders. The battle window extends from Thursday to Sunday, providing ample opportunities for players to engage. Each player is granted three daily attacks to take down these formidable foes. While Immortals can only be deployed once a day, dragons can be utilized more liberally. If you possess a maxed-out dragon, you can use it consecutively on all three teams.

Team Compositions

Crafting the ideal team composition is crucial for achieving victory in the Time Rift Breaker event. We’ll assume access to all free Immortals and King of the Hill Immortals for our examples. Additionally, perusing the damage rankings and observing other players’ choices can offer valuable insights.

Checkout my YouTube Channel for build compositions as well as the boss-build section here on the wiki.

Notably, rare single-target skills may outperform epic skills in certain scenarios. For instance, consider using skills like Root and Poison Thorn for Hammurabi, as they prove more effective than Annihilation and Death Breath. While Immortals can only be used once per battle, skill changes can be made as frequently as desired. To streamline the process, it’s advisable to have multiple formation presets, sparing diligent players from constant skill adjustments.

There are three distinct types of Rift Breakers to contend with: Venom, Vampirism, and Amplify. Each presents unique challenges and demands tailored team compositions:

  • Venom Rift Breaker: Inflicts magical continuous damage and is weak against Holy, Lightning, and Fire elements. An example team might feature Hippolyta, William, Empress Wu, and Hammurabi, focusing on single-target damage and exploiting the Rift Breaker’s elemental vulnerabilities.
  • Vampirism Rift Breaker: Deals magical damage while healing itself and is susceptible to Shadow, Wind, and Lightning. An effective lineup could consist of Hannibal Barca, Alexander, Hammurabi, and Qin, capitalizing on synergies despite Alexander’s elemental mismatch.
  • Amplify Rift Breaker: Unleashes buffed physical damage and is vulnerable to Water, Earth, and Fire elements. A well-rounded team may include Hippolyta, Alexander, Yoshitsune, and Empress Wu, benefiting from elemental strengths and prioritizing single-target damage.

Rewards

The Time Rift Breaker event boasts a treasure trove of rewards that are well worth the effort:

Daily Attempts: Each attack can yield a maximum of 1,500 Glory Points, totaling 4,500 Glory Points per day. Accumulated Glory Points unlock chests containing badges once you reach specific thresholds: 1k, 3k, 5k, 8k, and 12k points per week. These chests offer 1.5k, 2.5k, 4k, 5k, and 7k badges, culminating in a weekly total of 20,000 badges.

Total Damage Ranking: Players earn badges based on their total damage output at the end of the week. Rankings determine badge rewards, ranging from 20,000 to 40,000 badges. To maximize your standing, strategically distribute your strongest Immortals to complement each other and achieve the highest total damage.

Highest Damage Ranking: A separate ranking is awarded for the highest damage dealt in a single attack. Players can earn between 12,000 and 25,000 badges based on their ranking. Concentrate your most potent Immortals on one attack team to secure a top spot in this category.

Kill Count Rewards: The event also encourages teamwork, as rewards are distributed based on the number of Rift Breakers collectively defeated during the week. Individual achievements contribute to a team objective, with players earning 1k, 1.5k, 2k, 2.5k, and 3k badges for 1, 3, 5, 8, and 15 kills, respectively.

Summary

The Time Rift Breaker event offers a captivating extension of the Infinity Kingdom experience, blending individual and team dynamics. While it demands continuous skill adjustments for optimal damage output, the event provides an opportunity to unlock exclusive artifacts and amass Glory Points with ease. With rewards aplenty and a collaborative element, every commander should participate and strive for excellence.

Participating in this event rewards you with point for each hit made. The amount of points given is scaled comparatively to the damage that you deal. However, the points are capped pretty low, at 1250 points as the maximum reward per attack.

Hey, have you heard about the new game mode, Squad Survival, that’s coming to the conquest servers in Infinity Kingdom? This is going to be a game-changer, and I can’t wait to try it out! It’s not just another addition; it’s a fresh, adrenaline-pumping battleground that brings a whole new level of excitement. If you’ve been around for features like Illusion Battlegrounds or Prime League, you know how much those spiced things up. Now, get ready for a true king-of-the-hill experience. Let me break it down for you!

This is a huge deal, we are getting a brand new battleground and new game within Infinity Kingdom. In the past, additions like Illusions Battlegrounds and Prime League and others have proven hugely succesful and given the game a lot of energy and drive – particularly for older players who has been playing the games current contents for years. Thus it’s awesome to see that the developers keep making new additions to the game, and even better, they are adding new awesome gamemodes inspired by the best games out there. Introducing, a true king of the hill battlegrounds: Squad Survival! Awesome! Let’s have a look at what we know so far.

With the news article from the 27th of december, we can learn a lot about this new battle royale format battleground.

Read the official news article here: https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7021798.html

Overview of Squad Survival

First off, Squad Survival is a ranked player-versus-player battleground that’s introducing a battle royale-style gameplay. Think of games like PUBG or Warzone, but with our favorite Infinity Kingdom twist. Brand new player versus player ranked battlegrounds where players will be ranked and rewarded based on the highest single-match score. The battles last three days and a total of 6 matches, squads can choose to participate in just a single battle or more up to six.

Key Points:

  • Players are ranked and rewarded based on their highest single-match score.
  • Tournaments span three days with six matches total.
  • Flexibility to participate in one or multiple matches.

Squad Setup Phase

The setup phase is where you build your squad. You can team up with your friends to create your dream squad, or if you’re flying solo, the in-game matchmaking system has you covered.

Each squad consists of 1-3 members and squad leaders may freely adjust the members and setting during the team-up phase. Once the battle stages begin, your squad will be locked in as the battlegrounds begin.

There will be two battlefield skills to choose from, I expect these to work like the IBL skills we are used to and most likely you want to strategize in your squad who chooses what.

In battle you are going to be using your own immortals and dragons and tok skills but will have a fixed troop count for this game mode, akin to Illusion Battlegrounds.

Key Points:

  • Squads consist of 1-3 members.
  • Squad leaders control team adjustments during setup.
  • Squads are locked once battles begin.

Dynamic Gameplay Mechanics

Now, the actual gameplay—this is where things get spicy. When the match begins, you and your squad spawn together on the map. The battlefield is dynamic, with zones that shift over time.

There are no bubbles / castle shields in this gamemode and no bloody rage effects. Furthermore, there are no teleports of any kind, instead relocation speed is greatly increased and cooldown is just 1 minute.

Zone Breakdown:

  • Green Zones: Safe areas.
  • Purple Zones: Danger areas that will soon be flooded.
  • Dark Zones: Lava-filled areas causing rapid prosperity loss.

If your prosperity hits zero, you’re “downed,” and your squadmates must rescue you by restoring a bit of prosperity. If the whole squad is eliminated, it’s game over.

Basically, it is a King of the Hill styled battleground, think of PUBG or Warzone. Players of a squad spawn close to each other at random on the map and the map will gradually shrink as lava floods the map killing anyone in the lava through a gradual prosperity loss. There are three different zones on the map, green safe zones, purple areas are areas that are safe for now but will soon be flooded in lava and dark zones where your castle rapidly lose prosperity from the lava floods.
If you are reduced to 0 prosperity through lava or combat, you are “downed” meaning you will be eliminated if not rescued fast. Your team members can send troops to you and rescue you, giving you back a bit of prosperity to escape certain death. If you are not rescued you are eliminated. If all squad members are eliminated your squad is out of the game. Last ones to stay alive wins. You cannot replenish prosperity using gems while in this gamemode.

Key Points:

  • Shrinking battlefield due to lava adds strategic pressure.
  • No shields, bloody rage effects, or teleports.
  • Faster relocation speeds with a one-minute cooldown.
  • Rescue “downed” team members before they are eliminated!

Boost Nodes and Strategy

Another cool feature is the boost nodes scattered across the map. These structures grant your squad special bonuses like increased attack, defense, or healing. Your squad can occupy multiple structures and the boosts will stack. I expect this to be key in strategies to win the game by getting advantages.

Key Points:

  • Occupying nodes grants stackable boosts.
  • Strategic decisions are vital—go for nodes, survival, or combat.

Battle Duration and Scoring

Each battle lasts for maximum 30 minutes or until only one squad remain. If multiple squads are left at the 30 min. mark, their “squad Points” will determine the winner (up to five winners). Squad Points consists of Battlefield Points, i expect these to be earned as if they where honor. You can gain multiple points through winning streaks or by killing enemies with a win-streak bonus active. Survival Points based on the squads survival ranking and time they stay alive.

Squad Points:

  • Battlefield Points: Earned by defeating enemies and achieving streak bonuses.
  • Survival Points: Based on how long your squad stays alive.

Battlefield Points are converted into honor for your lord after the battle, capped at 2 million points.

Reward Structure

There are very good rewards from this game mode: Random Holy/Shadow Immortal fragments, Artifact fragments and healing speedups. Moreover, the rewards structure is very good as it rewards up to 10000 players with ranking rewards, and good rewards for all making it a game mode that anyone should participate in and enjoy. While whale squads will likely win out, there will be very good battles and rewards for all levels of players, this is a huge thing and very important as I think this will drive the event to be a big success. There is nothing worse than good game events where only a very select few can earn rewards. Here we see a ranking mechanic that ensures good battles and a reward structure that offer rewards for everyone. Very good!

Key Rewards:

  • Random Holy and Shadow Immortal fragments.
  • Artifact fragments.
  • Healing speedups.

The ranking rewards benefit up to 10,000 players, making it accessible and rewarding for all.

Conclusion

So, what do you think? Doesn’t this sound like the most exciting addition to Infinity Kingdom in ages? Squad Survival is bringing the thrill of battle royale to our favorite game, and I’m ready to jump in and see what it’s all about. Let’s get our squads together and make history in this brand-new tournament. See you on the battlefield!
