html:
In the mystical realms of Infinity Kingdom, mastering the art of magical damage can turn your immortals into formidable forces to be reckoned with. Understanding the skills that enhance magical DPS is crucial for crafting a powerful strategy. In this guide, we’ll explore the skills designed for magical DPS and the heroes who can harness their arcane might to devastating effect.

1. Annihilation

Annihilation is a skill that truly shines when bestowed upon magical backline DPS immortals such as Merlin, Baldwin, and Himiko. These heroes are known for their prowess in dealing magical damage from a safe distance. Annihilation enhances their destructive potential by increasing their magic attack damage, turning their spells into devastating attacks that can decimate enemy forces.

For heroes who rely on the power of their spells to dominate the battlefield, Annihilation is an essential skill to consider. It transforms them into formidable spellcasters capable of obliterating foes with their arcane might.

2. Toxin Nova and Fire Nova

Toxin Nova and Fire Nova are skills perfectly suited for magical backline DPS immortals like Wu, Merlin, and Baldwin. What sets these skills apart is their synergy with abilities like Chase. The damage-over-time (DoT) effects from Toxin Nova and Fire Nova provide an excellent opportunity for Chase to trigger, thanks to their continuous damage output.

Chase is especially efficient when paired with skills like Nova or Death Breath, which reliably proc magic damage. Additionally, combining Chase with Weakness can further increase your critical hit rate, making it a potent addition to your magical DPS arsenal.

3. Chase

Chase is a versatile skill that can benefit any magical backline DPS immortal, but it truly excels with heroes like Wu. Wu’s increased crit rate from William or Trajan, coupled with her high energy regeneration, allows her to cast her ultimate more frequently, increasing the chances of Chase triggering.

Chase becomes especially effective when used in tandem with other skills that reliably proc magic damage, such as Nova or Death Breath. Its three-second cooldown adds an additional layer of strategy to consider when planning your attacks, making it a skill that requires precise timing and coordination.

4. Spell Disintegrator

Spell Disintegrator is a skill that finds its place with Wu and any other magical backline DPS immortals. Its effectiveness is further amplified when paired with Chase, thanks to the possibility of a three-second proc.

This synergy ensures that your magical DPS immortals can consistently deal significant damage, wreaking havoc on your enemies.

5. Stormeye

Stormeye is a skill suitable for any magical backline DPS immortal. It can be particularly effective when combined with Fighting Will, further enhancing the durability of your heroes.

By increasing their attack and crit rates, Stormeye empowers your magical DPS immortals to unleash devastating spells with precision and efficiency.

6. Death Breath

Death Breath is a skill that can benefit any DPS backline immortal, including those specializing in magical damage. It adds an extra layer of versatility to your hero’s abilities, making them more formidable in both close and ranged combat.

7. Poison Thorn

Poison Thorn is a skill that greatly benefits both the damage output and the utility effect of your magic damage immortals. In addition to providing excellent single-target damage, it also automatically targets the enemy with the highest physical attack attributes. This means that the damage deal carries greater value than random targeted damage, because we are reducing the troop count of one of the most powerful and important enemy Immortals on the playingfield.

Lastly, Poison Thron also applies a healing debuff to the enemy, one which dampens healing recieved by 50%. This can be a significant boost to your combat prowess against powerful sustain setups and it is the only tower of knowledge skill with a healing reduction effect.

In conclusion, harnessing the power of magical DPS skills is essential for conquering the diverse challenges of Infinity Kingdom. Whether you’re empowering magical backline DPS immortals with Annihilation, Chase, or Nova skills, or enhancing their survivability with Stormeye and Spell Disintegrator, these skills can turn your heroes into unstoppable arcane warriors.

So, delve into the arcane arts, refine your strategy, and watch as your magical DPS immortals become the champions of Infinity Kingdom, wielding the very forces of magic to shape the battlefield in your favor.

Published: 05-10-2023

Unleashing the Fury: Skills for Physical DPS in Infinity Kingdom

In the battlefields of Infinity Kingdom, the power of physical damage is a force to be reckoned with. Mastering the skills that enhance physical DPS can transform your immortals into relentless warriors. In this guide, we’ll explore the skills designed for physical DPS and the heroes who can utilize them to unleash chaos on the battlefield.

Please make note that the Physical Damage skills relating to normal attack immortals can be found here. This guide will cover the remaining more diverse set of physical attack skills.

1. Chaotic Blade and Garrote

Chaotic Blade and Garrote are skills that excel in the hands of physical backline DPS immortals, with Seondeok being a standout example. These skills come with damage-over-time (DoT) effects, making them particularly effective at reliably triggering Seondeok’s ultimate ability. The continuous damage output from Chaotic Blade and Garrote ensures that Seondeok’s ultimate ability is unleashed more often than with most other skills.

When paired with a hero like Seondeok, Chaotic Blade and Garrote allow for a relentless barrage of attacks that can quickly wear down enemy defenses and turn the tide of battle in your favor.

2. Desire of Life

Desire of Life is a skill tailor-made for Khan, the formidable warrior of Infinity Kingdom. When equipped on Khan, this skill becomes especially potent. Khan’s inherent tankiness combined with Desire of Life makes him a formidable force on the battlefield. The skill’s effectiveness is further enhanced when paired with Duel Master, allowing Khan to not only endure more damage but also deal out significant punishment to his foes.

Desire of Life turns Khan into a nearly unbreakable bulwark, capable of withstanding the fiercest of assaults while dealing devastating blows to his enemies.

3. Blade Vortex

Blade Vortex is a skill that finds its place with physical DPS immortals in marches running Loki. This skill enhances the damage output of physical attackers, making it a valuable addition to their arsenal.

When paired with heroes who rely on physical damage, Blade Vortex ensures that their attacks are even deadlier, decimating enemy forces with precision and power. Being one of only three effects to provide debuffs for Loki, makes this a powerful skill for late-game whales running Loki setups.

4. Death Breath

Death Breath is a versatile skill that can benefit any DPS backline immortal, whether they specialize in physical or magical damage.

This skill adds an extra layer of versatility to your hero’s abilities, making them more formidable in both close and ranged combat.

5. Sniper

Sniper is a powerful and simple skill. You have a good chance to deal a massive blow to your enemy’s backrow. As the name suggests, this is a single target snipe that deals massive damage to the enemy troop count and if set up right you can do a lot of harm to one of your enemy’s most valuable combat tools.

Perhaps the strongest aspect of this skill is the fact that it deals 50% increased damage against enemies at more than half their troop count. This makes it extreemly powerful at reducing enemy troop count in the critically important fase of any combat: the first 12-18 seconds.

6. Spear Impale

Spear Impale is another powerful skill dealing a high amount of damage to the enemy in front of the Immortal. Running this against a frontline of powerful immortals will make quick work of the enemy troop count as well as provide a solid boost to all physical damage.

Powerful took in setups like earth and holy.

In conclusion, mastering the art of physical DPS in Infinity Kingdom is all about understanding the skills that can amplify your hero’s capabilities. Whether you’re unleashing the relentless damage-over-time effects of Chaotic Blade and Garrote with heroes like Seondeok, turning Khan into an unbreakable fortress with Desire of Life, enhancing physical attackers with Blade Vortex, or adding versatility with Death Breath, these skills can turn your heroes into relentless warriors on the battlefield.

So, dive into the chaos of battle, refine your strategy, and witness as your physical DPS immortals become the unstoppable force that carves a path to victory in the world of Infinity Kingdom.
